izzyondroid:com.jabstone.jabtalk.basic.name: JABtalk
izzyondroid:com.jabstone.jabtalk.basic.summary: help non-verbal children and adults communicate
izzyondroid:com.jabstone.jabtalk.basic.description:
JABtalk is a free speech communication application designed to help non-verbal children and adults communicate. Speech therapists commonly refer to JABtalk as an easy and effective augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) device. By combining personalized voice and images with an extremely simple user interface, JABtalk delivers a speech solution that is both fun to use and easy to learn. Originally designed as a communication tool for children with special needs, JABtalk has evolved into a communication tool used by special needs children, stroke patients, toddlers, speech-language pathologists, and others.
 Some of JABtalk features include…
 Navigation designed to be intuitive for toddlers
 Build sentences from words
 Organize words into user-defined categories for simple navigation
 Heptic feedback (vibration) when touching a word or category for immediate physical feedback
 Ability to rearrange and resize pictures
 Download unlimited number pictures from internet directly into JABtalk!
 Ability to capture pictures directly from your device’s camera
 Ability to import pictures from your device’s memory card
 Ability to record your own audio for words using your devices microphone.
 Ability to import audio files from a memory card
 Supports text-to-speech if you don’t want to record or import your own audio files
 Easy to use passcode protected administrative tools for managing words and categories
 Fullscreen mode to prevent kids from easily exiting app
 Easily backup/restore your data to preserve your changes or move your entire dataset to a different device
 Online tutorials at https://www.jabstone.com/videos 
 If you are using JABtalk as an AAC device for an individual with special needs (down syndrome, autism, etc...), we strongly recommend having the individual assessed by a speech-language pathologist to ensure JABtalk is the most appropriate solution for the the individual’s needs.

izzyondroid:com.jvdegithub.aiscatcher.name: AIS-catcher
izzyondroid:com.jvdegithub.aiscatcher.summary: Turns your android phone with a cheap DVB-T dongle into a portable AIS receiver.
izzyondroid:com.jvdegithub.aiscatcher.description:
AIS-catcher turns your Android device into a portable dual channel AIS receiver with a RTL SDR dongle and an OTG cable. With these inexpensive dongles you can pick up AIS signals broadcasted by nearby vessels, even if offline! The App directly accesses the USB device and does not need additional drivers. Output can be send via UDP to plotting Apps like Boat Beacon or OpenCPN. A lightweight AIS receiver system when travelling. For a short manual see github.com/jvde-github/AIS-catcher-for-Android .
 AIS-catcher is compatible with DVB-T dongles and AirSpy devices connected with an OTG cable.

fdroid:com.w2sv.wifiwidget.summary: Monitor your Wi-Fi connection at a glance with a sleek, customizable widget.

Keep your Wi-Fi connection details right where you need them: on your home screen.
WiFi Widget is a free, open-source Android app that displays detailed Wi-Fi information in a customizable home screen widget. Choose what to show, arrange it your way, and check or copy connection details directly in the app.
 Wi-Fi and network details 
• Connection: SSID, BSSID, frequency, channel, link speed, RSSI, signal strength, Wi-Fi standard, generation and security protocol

• Tap property values to copy them to the clipboard
• Enjoy a Material 3 Expressive interface with light, dark and AMOLED black themes
• No ads
Some information requires internet access or Android location permissions. Available properties may vary by device and Android version.
WiFi Widget is open source under the GPL-3.0 license.
Source code: https://github.com/w2sv/WiFi-Widget

fdroid:de.monocles.chat.name: monocles chat
fdroid:de.monocles.chat.summary: is a full-featured XMPP chat client
fdroid:de.monocles.chat.description:
monocles chat is a modern and secure XMPP chat client for Android. It is based on Conversations, includes features from blabber.im and Cheogram, and adds many changes and features of its own to improve usability and security.
Connection security and the protection of personal data are very important to us. We enforce encrypted connections between the app and the server, which makes it almost impossible for strangers to intercept and read your messages. For this reason we removed outdated cipher suites. The remaining ones are tuned for the monocles chat server, but stay compatible with other XMPP servers that follow today’s standards.
If that is not enough for you, you can use end-to-end message encryption such as OMEMO or OpenPGP. Messages are then encrypted on the sending device and can only be decrypted by the devices they are meant for.
Features:
* End-to-end encryption with OTR , OMEMO or OpenPGP 
* Experimental post-quantum end-to-end encryption (PQ OMEMO2)
* Encrypted connections only, TLS 1.3 required by default
* DNSSEC-verified server lookup and DANE certificate checks (can be enforced)
* Protection against login downgrade attacks (channel binding, SCRAM downgrade protection)
* Encrypted local database with an optional startup password
* Send and receive images and other files
* Send and receive locations
* Send and receive voice messages
* Message styling: bold, italic, strikethrough and code
* Profile pictures (avatars) of your contacts
* Synchronize message history with other clients
* Group chats and channels
* Address book integration (your address book is never shared with the server)
* Audio and video calls
* Very low battery consumption
* Status messages
* Daily backup of the database to local storage
Need help? Join our support group chat support@conference.monocles.eu .
fdroid:de.monocles.chat.category: Internet, Messaging, Push, Voice & Video Chat

fdroid:de.nodomain.tobihille.seniorlaunc.name: Senior Launcher
fdroid:de.nodomain.tobihille.seniorlaunc.summary: Launcher reduced to the essential, intended for elderly people
fdroid:de.nodomain.tobihille.seniorlaunc.description:
What does this app do?
* It registers as app launcher (that means it is called when the phone boots and the home button is pressed).
* It lets the user decide if they want to call someone or want to watch images.
* It reads the contact list and displays all contacts that have an image and a phone number (only the first number is used!).
* Every contact is displayed as a large button with the contact's image on it.
* On click either a call to the contact is initialized or the SMS app is opened to show images sent via MMS
* In image-mode the gallery can be opened
* Calling the ambulance is added on top of the list in the call-screen.
* Language: English and German. (911 and 112 for calling the ambulance is translated of course)
Why is MMS used for images?
* Because it is available everywhere and every phone has an app installed that can use it
* Because it is the only way (that I found out) to direct the user right to the newest images
I recommend the use of https://f-droid.org/packages/com.moez.QKSMS as a SMS/MMS app because it
copies all images automatically to the gallery and because it's free.

fdroid:edge.roll.name: Edge Roll
fdroid:edge.roll.summary: Tumble a cube across a crumbling tile bridge. One-thumb 3D arcade.
fdroid:edge.roll.description:
Edge Roll is a minimalist one-thumb arcade game. Swipe to tumble a cube end over end along a narrow bridge of floating tiles suspended over an abyss.
Every tile you step off begins to crumble and drops away a second or two later — and that grace period shrinks the higher you climb, so hesitation is fatal. The bridge wanders left and right, splits into branches, and is dotted with gem spurs worth bonus points and gaps that end the run if you roll into them.
Score one point for every new tile you reach; gems are worth three. The whole world drifts through the colour spectrum as you progress, and a single misjudged roll sends the cube spinning off into the dark.
Features:
* One-thumb controls: swipe to roll, tap to roll forward.
* A procedurally generated bridge — no two runs are alike.
* Tight, tactile feedback with synchronised sound and haptics.
* A local high score. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network access.
* Tiny download and fully playable offline.
Edge Roll is built with libGDX and is free and open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

fdroid:io.github.intelognatanael.qetara.name: Qetara
fdroid:io.github.intelognatanael.qetara.summary: Share files and messages between nearby devices on your local network
fdroid:io.github.intelognatanael.qetara.description:
Qetara shares files and messages between Android devices and a computer on the same local network, without an account. Android devices can also connect through Wi-Fi Direct.
 Available in English and Spanish. Qetara follows your device language; on Android 13 and later, you can choose its language in Android's app settings.
 Select several files and track, cancel or retry transfers.
 Open, share and find received files in your downloads.
 Send files to Qetara from Android's share menu.
 Use a session code and PIN for regular sharing and messages.
 Use Flash to exchange text and files with nearby devices. Compare the verification code and confirm each message or file batch on both devices. Copy sent or received text and paste into a new draft. Flash starts disabled and expires after 30 minutes.
 Choose a light or dark appearance and adjust the reading size.
 File contents and messages travel through an encrypted connection between devices. Compare the verification information with the intended recipient. Discovery depends on the local network; some networks isolate devices or block discovery.
 Sharing with a computer requires the Qetara desktop application. Wi-Fi Direct is available between supported Android devices. Qetara does not provide cloud storage or transfers to devices outside your local connection.

fdroid:io.github.omegadestroyer.pairfree.name: PairFree
fdroid:io.github.omegadestroyer.pairfree.summary: One light app for earbuds of many brands. No account, no internet, no tracking
fdroid:io.github.omegadestroyer.pairfree.description:
PairFree aims to be one app for the settings of nearly any earbuds and headphones. It replaces heavy, brand-specific apps with a light, fast one that talks to your earbuds directly over Bluetooth.
Why PairFree:
• No account and no internet: the app has no internet permission, so it cannot go online
• Nothing leaves your phone unless you share it, such as a device report or an equalizer profile. No ads, analytics or crash reports
• One app for every brand: the same screens, instead of one vendor app each
• Few permissions: Bluetooth for paired earbuds, and notifications for the optional status notification. For some LE-only models (JBL, QCY, Sennheiser, Skullcandy), finding nearby devices, asked for only when you open one, never used for location. No contacts
• Small and quick: about 6 MB
• Needs Android 12 or later (the PC version: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit)
• Open source (GPL-3.0), every protocol documented and tested
• Your equalizer as files: save, export and share your own curves
• Translations: a language picker, and a new language is one file added by pull request (right-to-left is mirrored)
Supported brands (models; tried on):
• SOUNDPEATS: 88; H3, Air5 Pro+, C30, T3 Pro, TRUEFREE Clip C10
• Soundcore (Anker): 83; Space A40, AeroClip, Q20i, Sleep A20, P30i, R50i NC. With the open-source OpenSCQ30
• Samsung Galaxy Buds: 16, from the 2019 Buds to the Buds4 Pro
• Sony: 24, WH-1000XM2 to XM6; WF-1000XM5, WF-1000XM6
• Bose: 22, QC35 to QC Ultra 2, without Bose's cloud
• AirPods and Beats on Apple's chips: 30; AirPods Pro 3. AirPods need Android 17, or a Pixel on 16 QPR3, or a OnePlus, OPPO or realme phone on 16; the Beats need no particular version
• JBL: 112; Live Buds 3
• Nothing and CMF: 19; Nothing Ear
• Google Pixel Buds: 5; Pro
• QCY: 194; H3 Pro, T13 ANC2
• 1MORE: 48
• EarFun: 26
• Cambridge Audio: 8, the Melomania earbuds and headphones
• OnePlus and OPPO: 53; Buds 4. From HeyMelody
• Sennheiser: 28, from the Accentum, Momentum and CX ranges to the older HD, PXC and IE models, none tried yet
• Jabra: 34, Elite and Evolve2; Elite Active 75t
• Skullcandy: 56 earbuds and headphones, none tried yet
Each is built from the brand's own app, checked against open-source projects and users' device reports.
What it controls, on the models that have each:
• Battery for each earbud and the case
• Noise control: off, noise cancelling, transparency or ambient sound, with their scenes and levels
• The equalizer: the brand's presets, your own curves and saved profiles
• Touch controls: what each tap and hold does on each earbud, and turning touch off
• Game mode, two devices at once, LDAC and LE Audio
• The ear tip fit test, a seal check with tones from the phone, find my earbuds, voice prompts and water drain
• A hearing test that turns what you hear into an equalizer curve, and an A/B sound finder that tunes a curve by choosing between two sounds
• Settings only one brand has, such as Sony's speak-to-chat, Bose's listening modes, JBL's TalkThru, Sennheiser's Auracast or the AirPods' Conversation Awareness
• A status notification with the battery and buttons for noise control and game mode
• A home screen widget with buttons for noise control choices and EQ profiles
PairFree shows only what your earbuds support. Models not marked as tried rely on the brand's own app and on your reports: the Device tab copies a device report you can send. Record from the official app saves, on your phone, what the brand's app sends your earbuds, so PairFree can learn it; it keeps only those messages, with the address and serial number masked.
Close the brand's own app before using PairFree: only one app can control the earbuds at a time.

fdroid:org.mqvpn.app.description:
mqvpn is an open-source multipath VPN client. It combines multiple internet
connections (Wi-Fi + cellular) for bandwidth aggregation and seamless
failover, speaking standards-based MASQUE CONNECT-IP (RFC 9484) over
Multipath QUIC — no proprietary tunnel format.
The app uses Android's VpnService to route the device's network traffic
through the tunnel; Android asks for your consent before the first
connection. Traffic goes only to the server you configure; the app contains
no analytics or telemetry. Privacy policy: https://docs.mqvpn.org/privacy
Features:
* Multipath: bond Wi-Fi and cellular, seamless failover between them
* Standards-based: MASQUE CONNECT-IP (RFC 9484) over QUIC
* Pre-shared-key auth over TLS 1.3
* Requires a self-hosted mqvpn server (see the project README)

fdroid:org.venkado.relagent.name: Relagent
fdroid:org.venkado.relagent.summary: Trustworthy AI assistant that runs 100% on your hardware
fdroid:org.venkado.relagent.description:
Relagent is a private and selfhosted AI assistant that runs on your hardware. In addition to this app, you need to run the Relagent engine.
To get started, please have a look at the project's readme at https://gitlab.com/RmMsr/relagent.
The goal of the Relagent project is an accessible solution for agentic AI services with full control over your data. Setting up your own installation should be within reach without considerable technical knowledge or financial investment. The software is designed to be resource-efficient without any hidden costs.
What Relagent brings you:
* 🗨️ Chat interface : Chat with your AI assistant and manage sessions.
* 🌐 Persistent sessions : Open new sessions and continue them on any device. Data stays on your systems only.
* 🎤 Speech Integration : Input and Output on-device with about 40 languages.
* ⚖️ Use any open-weights model : By using the OpenAI-compatible chat completions protocol, you can choose the inference service that works best for you. No external service is needed - but you can use one.
* 🔒️ API Key Authentication : Restrict access to your data. Combine with an HTTPS proxy or a VPN to protect your data while accessing it from anywhere.
* 🧰 Agentic tools : For example, web search. You can decide in which cases you want to be asked for permission based on your selected privacy level.
What you do NOT need :
* Register for a third-party service (unless you want to use a commercial LLM provider)
* Pay for any usage or access (but I appreciate donations)
* Fear that your data ends up in big data silos or model training
What you CAN do :
* Host the Relagent engine yourself (start on your computer, switch to permanent installation when you are ready)
* Run a Large Language Model yourself (needs one additional app, there are several free options with or without a graphical interface to choose from)
* Protect the API with HTTPS, Basic Auth or using a VPN.
Permissions on your device:
* In order to send data between the app and the engine and to download speech models, internet access is needed
* For the voice input (ASR) and output (TTS) features several permissions includiing bluetooth and background processing are required. Relagent won't continuously listen on the microphone unless you explicitly activate it
For more information:
* Find the Relagent source code at https://gitlab.com/RmMsr/relagent.
* Have a look at the related Blog at https://venkado.org/.
* Follow the author @guesser (https://sigmoid.social/@guesser) on the Fediverse.

fdroid:ru.nsu.bobrofon.easysshfs.name: EasySSHFS
fdroid:ru.nsu.bobrofon.easysshfs.summary: Sshfs with ssh client and interface for Android.
fdroid:ru.nsu.bobrofon.easysshfs.description:
SSH Filesystem is a filesystem client based on the SSH File Transfer Protocol.
Fuse 3.10.5.
Sshfs 3.7.1.
Ssh client from OpenSSH-portable 8.9p (with OpenSSL 1.1.1n).
For using public key authentication add "IdentityFile= " to sshfs options. Password-protected keys are not supported.
Rooted device required (/dev/fuse in android is not allow for users except root).
Application source code: https://github.com/bobrofon/easysshfs
WARNING:
If you just want to have access to the files on your PC from your Android phone, then sshfs is a
VERY bad solution for that problem. You really need to know some internal details about Android
storage implementation to make something useful with sshfs. And EasySSHFS is not intended to hide
all these details from its users. Please try to use any implementation of Android document provider
for sftp protocol (or any other solution to work with sftp) before trying to use sshfs.
NOTE:
- If you are using SuperSu to manage root access and have no effect after mounting done, try to disable "mount namespace separation" option in SuperSU.
- It is highly recommended to create mount points in /data/media/0 on Android 4.2 and /mnt/runtime/default/emulated/0 on Android 6.0 and above.

flathub:cc.craftos_pc.CraftOS-PC.name: CraftOS-PC
flathub:cc.craftos_pc.CraftOS-PC.description:
CraftOS-PC is a fantasy terminal that allows you to write and run 
 programs inside an '80s-style text console.
 CraftOS-PC emulates the popular Minecraft mod "ComputerCraft", which 
 adds programmable computers to Minecraft using the Lua programming 
 language. CraftOS-PC takes this experience outside Minecraft to allow 
 you to run the same programs anywhere you go.
 CraftOS-PC provides a set of functions (called APIs) that make it super 
 easy to do simple tasks such as write text to the screen, read files, 
 and more. The simplicity of these functions makes CraftOS-PC great for 
 new programmers, but their power makes it possible to write all sorts of
 complex programs with less code.
 If you aren't ready to write programs yet, there's already a large 
 number of programs for ComputerCraft that will work in CraftOS-PC, 
 ranging from simple games to whole graphical operating systems. These 
 can be downloaded through the built-in Pastebin and GitHub Gist clients.

flathub:ch.dragondreams.delauncher.name: Dragengine Launcher
flathub:ch.dragondreams.delauncher.description:
Supports running games and applications based on the
 Drag[en]gine Game Engine distributed as DELGA files.
 DELGA files can be run directly by clicking them.
 Launcher can be used to create and modify game
 profiles for example to fine tune performance.
 In general creating profiles is not required.

flathub:dev.tchx84.Gameeky.name: Gameeky
flathub:dev.tchx84.Gameeky.description:
Gameeky lets young learners and educators create and explore cooperative games and learning experiences.
 More specifically:
 Play and explore games with friends
 Create new games without writing any code
 Tell stories through these games
 Nurture artistic skills by designing game objects and creatures
 Grasp the basics of programming using Python in a LOGO-like experience
 Mature programming skills by extending games with Python plugins

flathub:io.github.avomar.dev-toolbox.description:
A collection of tools and utilities for developers. Following tools are currently available:

 Base64 Encoder/Decoder
 GZip Compressor/Decompressor

flathub:io.github.dosbox-staging.name: DOSBox Staging
flathub:io.github.dosbox-staging.description:
DOSBox Staging is a modern continuation of DOSBox with advanced features and current development
 practices. It emulates an Intel x86 PC running the MS-DOS operating system with the primary aim
 of running games, but most application programs will work as well. It is meant as a (mostly) drop-in
 replacement for older DOSBox versions. Your existing configurations will continue to work, but
 you will have access to many advanced features. For the full list of supported features, please
 visit the DOSBox Staging website.

flathub:io.github.huderlem.porymap.name: Porymap
flathub:io.github.huderlem.porymap.summary: A map editor for the Pokémon generation 3 decompilation projects
flathub:io.github.huderlem.porymap.description:
Porymap is a cross-platform map editor for the Gen 3 pret decompilation projects. Its primary functions are to allow editing map tiles, collision, events, connections, and properties. Porymap provides additional functionality, such as tileset editing and region map editing.
 Those familiar with traditional Gen 3 binary ROM hacking can think of it as the Advance Map equivalent for the decompilation projects. Porymap supports the same features as Advance Map, so Advance Map users shouldn’t have much difficulty learning how to use Porymap. There are many usability improvements in Porymap. The most notable is undo/redo when painting map tiles.
 Porymap reads and writes files in the decompilation projects. It does not read or write ROM files. Therefore, it is highly recommended to use Git for version control when working with Porymap.

flathub:io.github.itprojects.MasVisGtk.summary: Audio analysis tool for your music
flathub:io.github.itprojects.MasVisGtk.description:
Detect audio mastering defects. Based on pymasvis app/module, using numpy, scipy, pyplot (matplotlib).
 Waveform plotting
 Overview of files (by-folder support)
 Frequency plot
 Dynamic Range estimation
 Peak estimation
 Crest Factor estimation
 Histogram plot
 Peak vs. RMS plot
 Loudness analysis, EBU R128 plot
 Multi-channel audio support

flathub:io.github.paulwedeck.settlers-re.name: JSettlers
flathub:io.github.paulwedeck.settlers-re.summary: A Remake of "The Settlers III" for Windows, Linux, Mac and Android
flathub:io.github.paulwedeck.settlers-re.description:
JSettlers is an open source remake of the game The Settlers III by BlueByte. The main goal of the game is to build an economy and fight other players.
 JSettlers needs the graphics files from an original Settlers III installation. The demo version work as well but only contains Roman and Amazon graphics files.

flathub:org.bunkus.mkvtoolnix-gui.description:
MKVToolNix is a set of tools to create, alter and inspect Matroska files under Linux, other
 Unices and Windows.

flathub:org.hikounomizu.HikouNoMizu.name: Hikou no mizu
flathub:org.hikounomizu.HikouNoMizu.description:
Hikou no mizu is a 2D fighting game with anime-inspired graphics.
 Fights take place in interactive arenas of various sizes.
 Both networked multiplayer and local games are possible.
 Joysticks are supported and a simple AI is included for solo playing.
 Playable characters fight using natural powers such as water, lightning, or fire.
 Currently, three characters are playable: Hikou, Takino and Hana.

flathub:org.kde.ktimetracker.name: KTimeTracker
flathub:org.kde.ktimetracker.description:
KTimeTracker helps you track your personal time spent on various tasks and projects.
 It is useful for tracking billable hours and can report the hours logged by task and day.
 With KTimeTracker, you can organize a broken-down project as subtasks with unlimited nesting.
 The standard keyboard and mouse shortcuts are simple and make the tool really comfortable and intuitive
 to use.

flathub:org.kde.tellico.name: Tellico
flathub:org.kde.tellico.description:
Tellico is an application for organizing your collections. It provides default templates for
 books, bibliographies, videos, music, video games, coins, stamps, trading cards, comic books, and
 wines. It allows you to enter your collection in a catalogue database, saving many different properties
 like title, author, etc.
 Features:
 Supports default collections of books, bibliographic entries, videos, music, video games,
 comic books, coins, stamps, trading cards, wines, board games, and file catalogs
 Supports user-defined custom collections
 Supports any number of user-defined fields, of several different types: text, paragraph,
 list, checkbox, number, URL, date, images, and combinations
 Handles entries with multiple authors, genres, keywords, etc
 Automatically formats titles and names
 Supports collection searching and view filtering
 Sorts and groups collection by various properties
 Allows customizable entry templates through XSLT
 Imports MODS, Bibtex, RIS, CSV, PDF metadata, and many other formats
 Exports to Bibtex, ONIX, CSV, HTML, and other formats
 Imports information directly from Amazon.com, IMDb, z39.50 servers, PubMed, SRU servers,
 CrossRef.org, various other websites, and from external scripts
 Imports CDDB data for cataloging audio CDs
 Scans and imports audio file collections, such as mp3 or ogg

flathub:org.linuxshowplayer.LinuxShowPla.name: Linux Show Player
flathub:org.linuxshowplayer.LinuxShowPla.summary: Cue player designed for stage productions
flathub:org.linuxshowplayer.LinuxShowPla.description:
Linux Show Player, LiSP for short, is a free cue player, mainly intended for sound-playback in stage productions,
 the goal is to provide a complete playback software for musical plays, theater shows and similar.
 Some highlights:
 List layout
 Cart layout
 Concurrent cues playback
 Pre/Post wait
 Undo/Redo changes
 Realtime sound effects
 Peak and ReplayGain normalization
 MIDI and OSC support

flathub:page.codeberg.petsoi.words.name: Words!
flathub:page.codeberg.petsoi.words.description:
Words is a popular word puzzle game, similar to Wordle, where players try to guess a hidden word within six attempts.
 It's simple yet addictive, combining logic, vocabulary, and deduction.
 The game supports different word lists and lengths in multiple languages. Currently, English and German are available.
 Want to see your language in the game? Feel free to send me a word list!

firefox-addons:2822818.name: Auto-On Video Controls
firefox-addons:2822818.summary: Automatically turns on the browser's native video controls on HTML5 videos, so you never right-click "Show Controls" again. You choose the sites. Light on resources, private and open source.
firefox-addons:2822818.description:
Stop right-clicking "Show Controls" on every video.
Some pages play a video but hide the playback controls: no pause button, no seek bar, no volume, no fullscreen. This extension automatically turns on the browser's own native controls on HTML5 video elements, including videos that a page adds while you scroll.
HOW IT WORKS
• Open a page with a video and the controls are there. Nothing to click, nothing to set up.
• It uses the browser's built-in controls. It does not replace the site's player or add a playback engine of its own.
• Controls that a site provides itself are never touched.
YOU CHOOSE WHERE IT RUNS
• On all sites (default), except the sites on your list. Or only on the sites on your list.
• Each mode keeps its own list, and a base domain such as example.com also covers its subdomains.
• Changes apply right away to pages that are already open, with no reload.
LIGHT ON RESOURCES
• On a site where it is off, the extension does no work on the page.
• Where it is on, it only looks at newly added content, in small batches, and it keeps no background process running.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No analytics and no tracking. The extension itself makes no network requests.
• Your site lists, autoplay choice, language and theme are stored locally in your browser.
• Open source under the GPLv3, so you can read exactly what it does.
ALSO INCLUDED
• Optional "Block autoplay", off by default: videos start paused and play when you press play.
• Light, dark or system theme.
• Interface in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
• Small fixes for 9GAG and Instagram, where overlays can cover the controls.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Some sites use custom players that hide or replace the native controls. The extension cannot help there.
• It is off by design on YouTube, Netflix, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Hulu, Twitch, Rumble, Facebook and TikTok.
• Browsers do not allow extensions on their own internal pages or on extension stores.
Found a site where it does not work? Open an issue with the page address and your browser version: https://github.com/FelipheMP/auto-on-video-controls/issues 
If it makes your browsing easier, you can support development at https://github.com/sponsors/FelipheMP or https://ko-fi.com/coreboolean 
Based on "Show Video Controls by Default" by marcintracz.official. Adapted and maintained by FelipheMP.
Works on Firefox for desktop and for Android.

firefox-addons:947990.name: Tab Unloader for Tree Style Tab
firefox-addons:947990.summary: Tab unload options for Tree Style Tab.
firefox-addons:947990.description:
⚠ This addon extends and works only with Tree Style Tab .
This extension allows you to click on a tab in Tree Style Tab's sidebar to unload it. You can set conditions for which clicks will be used. It is also possible to block Tree Style Tab's default action for a click.
Conditions for clicks:
 Hold certain modifier keys while making the click. (Such as: ctrl, shift, alt, meta/command.)
 Tab is/isn't double clicked.
 Tab is/isn't long-pressed.
 Tab is/isn't long pressed without tab being dragged. (special event from Tree Style Tab's API.)
If the tab that should be unloaded is the current tab then you can control what tab should be selected instead with the following options:
 Select the last focused tab instead of the closest.
 Ignore hidden tabs.
Context menu items that can be added to the context menu in Tree Style Tab's Sidebar:
 Unload tab.
 Unload tree.
 Unload tree descendants.
 Unload other tabs.
 The context menu items can be added after a slight delay to ensure that they are the last items in the menu. If there are more than one item they will be grouped under a parent item.
This extension can also:
 allow keyboard shortcuts to unload tab/tree (requires Firefox 60 or later).
 Dim unloaded tabs in the Tree Style Tab Sidebar.
 Hide all unloaded tabs so that they aren't visible in the toolbar and can't be selected with keyboard shortcuts. Hidden tabs are also not selected when you close the current tab. Useful to prevent accidental loading of unloaded tabs.
 Show hidden tabs in the Tree Style Tab Sidebar. Useful when combined with the option to hide unloaded tabs.
 Fix some bugs with Firefox unload method. For example tabs that aren't restore correctly after being unloaded by an extension or tabs that are marked by Firefox as loaded when they are unloaded. These fixes work for other tabs that are unloaded by other extensions as well. (This is a workaround for a Firefox bug that is fixed as of Firefox 62.)
 Unload tabs via the Auto Tab Discard extension. (Can be useful to change the icon of unloaded tabs)
When using the default configuration:
 Hold the alt key and click tabs to unload them.
 Middle click on loaded tabs to unload them. (Not possible in Tree Style Tab v2.4.18 or earlier.) (Also you can double middle click or middle click while holding a modifier key to close tabs that can't be unloaded, such as addon option pages.)
 Hold a modifier key and right click tabs to unload them.
 Unloaded tabs are dimmed.
 Unload tab context menu item in Tree Style Tab Sidebar context menu.
Note that all functionality is fully customizable in the options page.

bluejetty:00187129:ios.description:
Just say it. TaskFire is the to-do list that works with the new Siri. Say a task with its date and list in one sentence, and it's there.
Then open the app and everything is sorted: overdue, today, and the next seven days, shared with the people you share a life with, on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.
SEE WHAT MATTERS
Overdue, today, tomorrow, and the next seven days, in the order it matters. Smart lists pull tasks together by due date, star, tag, or person, so the right things are always in front of you.
ADD A TASK IN A TAP
Type it, pick a date and a list, star it, tag it, done. Add notes, checklists, and attachments when a task needs more.
NOW WITH SIRI
TaskFire works with the new Siri. Say "Hey Siri, in TaskFire add call the dentist tomorrow at 3pm" and it's on your list with the date and time. Say several tasks in one sentence. Looking at an email, message, or note? "Hey Siri, add this to TaskFire." Ask Siri what's on a list and it reads it back. Ask Siri to remind you when you get somewhere, like "remind me to get toilet paper when I get to Costco."
SHARE A LIST
Invite family, roommates, or coworkers to a list. Assign tasks so everyone sees who's on what.
TASKS AND CALENDAR TOGETHER
See your tasks and your week on one screen. Connect Google Calendar for two-way sync.
EVERY DETAIL A PLANNER COULD WANT
- Repeating tasks, based on the due date or the day you finish
- Multiple reminders per task
- Location reminders that alert you when you arrive
- Start and due dates and times
- Notes, comments, and checklists
- Email tasks straight into your TaskFire inbox
- Dark mode
ALWAYS IN SYNC
One account on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web. Your tasks are backed up to our secure cloud and follow you everywhere.
TaskFire is free to use. Try Premium free for 14 days, then keep the basic app free or subscribe monthly or yearly.
Siri features require an iPhone with Apple Intelligence running iOS 27 with the new Siri turned on.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00032639:ios.name: Bowling Club: Realistic 3D PvP
bluejetty:00032639:ios.summary:
Bowling Champions aren’t born, they are made in the fire of competition. 
“Bowling Club” opens up its gates! Step into virtual alleys and experience the thrill of live matchmaking, skillful ball rolling and competitive pin-smashing simulat
bluejetty:00032639:ios.description:
Bowling Champions aren’t born, they are made in the fire of competition. 
“Bowling Club” opens up its gates! Step into virtual alleys and experience the thrill of live matchmaking, skillful ball rolling and competitive pin-smashing simulation like never before!
Best of Both Worlds
Beauty and skill? Yes, please! Now, that’s a game loaded with beautiful content: from superbly designed Arenas, to a slew of equipment, to the player avatars - the eye-catching elements will make you marvel. At the same time, the game is focused on the skill you will master with intuitively easy-to-use controls. No fuss, just fun!
High-end 3D graphics
Without question, Bowling Club is gorgeous with its balls rolling ablaze and the funny pin smashing animations. However, unlike competition, our game offers fully customizable 3D avatars! You’re getting a unique opportunity to express yourselves with customization: get your 3D avatar the coolest gear and stand out from the crowd!
Game On, Anytime
It’s perfect for passing the time while waiting or on-the-go. The multiplayer matches don’t take long and the enjoyment never drops in this fast-paced sport!
Real Multiplayer Madness
Our game is the real deal. Challenge players from across the globe in thrilling PvP matches, or gather your friends to form a club and dominate the lanes together! With real-time multiplayer action, this competitive simulation never stops.
Competitive Edge
There are multiple challenges you may set for yourself and your crew. Similarly to the real-life sport, there are leaderboards to climb for individual players and clubs. The ranked seasons and the battle pass are intertwined and go along with each other. You’ll never get tired as there’s always a prize to set your eyes on!
The Spice
The secret sauce to Bowling Club are Special Events and Skillshot. The former ones offer various game modes so that you never get bored and the latter one is exactly as the name advertises: rolling the ball so skillfully that you knock down the most pins possible. There are plenty of rewards just waiting to be won! And if that wasn’t enough, we’ve got the Lucky Wheel: a game of chance where you can get awesome prizes!
Quest for Growth
You will most certainly feel how satisfying it is to level up, unlock new bowling alleys, and conquer the leagues and divisions. You will unlock achievements and get rewards along the way. The healthy diet of daily missions and weekly challenges will keep you motivated. With the multiplayer bouts fought, your gear upgraded, and practice under your belt, the bowling king mastery is for the taking!
Join our Player Community on social media and share your accolades with fellow pin-smashing enthusiasts! Let the ball roll! Let’s strike up some fun together!
Discord: https://bit.ly/ClubGamesOnDiscord
FB: https://www.facebook.com/BowlingClubOfficial
IG: https://www.instagram.com/_club_games_/
TT: https://bit.ly/ClubGamesOnTikTok
Ready to roll? Download Bowling Club now and unleash your inner bowling champion!
Terms of Use: https://boombit.com/tos/
IGRS rating: 13+

bluejetty:00093802:ios.description:
Orunaye brings the tradition of Ifá and Osha (Regla de Ocha-Ifá, Lucumí Santeria) together in one app: the treatises, the patakís, narrated audiobooks and an AI counselor that takes you to the exact text.
The app and its content are in Spanish. English content is on the way.
IFÁ
• All 256 odu of Ifá, each with its treatise: what Ifá says, proverbs, prohibitions, what is born in the sign, and its patakís.
• The major and minor odu, in order and easy to look up.
• The okpele and the basics to understand the system.
OSHA
• The diloggun: the odu of the cowrie shells, with their meaning, proverbs and advice.
• The orishas and deities: their paths, attributes, colors and place in the tradition.
• The eshus, with their names and descriptions.
AUDIOBOOKS AND PRAYERS
• More than 50 narrated audiobooks, over 10 hours of teaching to listen to anywhere.
• A prayer library with favorites and your own list.
THE ELDER, YOUR AI COUNSELOR
• Ask about a sign, an orisha or a patakí: it answers from the app's content and opens the treatise it is talking about.
• It remembers your sign to talk to you about it.
• It respects the tradition: it does not replace your godparent or prescribe works; anything that needs divination leads you to a consultation.
CONSULTATIONS
• Request a consultation with a babalawo from the app.
MADE FOR EVERYONE
• The content works offline: ideal in Cuba and wherever the network fails.
• For aleyos who are starting out and for initiates who want their treatise at hand.
EXPERT SUBSCRIPTION
Unlimited access to the content and the Elder, with no ads. Monthly or yearly (the yearly plan saves 17%).
Maferefún. Download Orunaye and carry the wisdom of Ifá and Osha with you.

bluejetty:00068131:ios.description:
Hadith Collection (All in one) is an Ultimate Collection of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The app contains 41000+ hadith from 14 Most Accepted and Authentic Hadith books.
The 14 books included are:
1) Sahih al Bukhari صحيح البخاري - Hadith collected by Imam Bukhari (d. 256 A.H., 870 C.E.)
2) Sahih Muslim صحيح مسلم - Hadith collected by Muslim b. al-Hajjaj (d. 261 A.H., 875 C.E.)
3) Sunan an-Nasa'i سنن النسائي - Hadith collected by al-Nasa'i (d. 303 A.H., 915 C.E.)
4) Sunan Abu-Dawood سنن أبي داود - Hadith collected by Abu Dawood (d. 275 A.H., 888 C.E.)
5) Jami' at-Tirmidhi جامع الترمذي - Hadith collected by al-Tirmidhi (d. 279 A.H, 892 C.E)
6) Sunan Ibn-Majah سنن ابن ماجه - Hadith collected by Ibn Majah (d. 273 A.H., 887 C.E.)
7) Muwatta Malik موطأ مالك - Hadith compiled and edited by the Imam, Malik ibn Anas
8) Musnad Ahmad - Hadith compiled by Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal
9) Riyad us Saliheen رياض الصالحين
10) Shama'il Muhammadiyah الشمائل المحمدية
11) Al Adab Al Mufrad الأدب المفرد - Hadith collected by Imam Bukhari (d. 256 A.H., 870 C.E.)
12) Bulugh al-Maram بلوغ المرام
13) 40 Hadith Nawawi الأربعون النووية - Hadith collected by Abu Zakaria Mohiuddin Yahya ibn Sharaf al-Nawawi (631–676 A.H)
14) 40 Hadith Qudsi الحديث القدسي
Features:
● 41000+ Ahadith from the Sunnah
● Hadith grade (Sahih, Hasan, Daif etc.)
● Powerful Search
● Narration Chain and Compare Isnad
● List of Similar Hadith
● Share option
● No Ads
● Start reading from where you left off (last read)
Reference and Courtesy of Sunnah.com
If you find any errors/issues in the hadiths, kindly report it to us.
May Allah have mercy on the collectors and translators of the Hadeeth!
Share and Recommend this Beautiful Hadith app to your friends and family. May Allah bless us in this world and hereafter.

bluejetty:00090286:ios.description:
Azizi Bank continues to redefine the way banking is done in Afghanistan. With strong technology-driven solutions Bank is continuously bringing the new services which ride on the mantra of convenience and security. Azizi Bank is proud to launch the first mobile-based wallet solution in the country with a brand name AZI-PAY. AZIPAY is AZIZI Bank's mobile wallet on your smartphone. It is a prepaid wallet which can be used to transfer money to other wallet users, load money from bank accounts, make merchant payments, Cash Out from ATMs, make your bank Account Inquiries, make bill payments, and request money anytime, anywhere.
Features Available :
Add Money through Debit Card/Branch channel
View Your Bank Account Balance/Statement
ATM Cash Out
Send Money
Scan and Pay – Merchant Payments
Prepaid Mobile Recharge
Pay Your Bills
Requests Money
Open Account Request
E KYC
Registration:
You can sign up/register with (Mobile Number (mandatory), email ID (optional) & MPIN). Download and install the AZIPAY wallet on your smartphone.
To sign up, you need to do the following -
a) You will have to enter mobile number (mandatory)
b) You will have to enter OTP sent on Mobile and set MPIN. If OTP is not received by you, then use the 'Resend OTP' link to resend the OTP to your mobile number
c) You have to enter Your Name and Date of Birth and Email ID.
d) Then, you have to select a security Question from the dropdown and type your answer as prompted & submit the request.
e) Upon successful registration, you will be registered for AZIPAY Mobile Wallet. A success message will be sent on your mobile.
You can even withdraw cash from ATM using your Azipay wallet. No card required for ATM withdrawal now. You can even send money to the mobile number of the beneficiary and he can withdraw that amount from the ATM.
Azi-Pay brings a plethora of services on your Mobile Phone.

bluejetty:00033859:ios.name: Sensor Logger
bluejetty:00033859:ios.summary: Sensor Logger collects, records and displays data from a range of sensors on iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad and AirPods — including accelerometer, gyroscope, GPS, audio, camera and Bluetooth devices. You can log device properties such as screen
bluejetty:00033859:ios.description:
Sensor Logger collects, records and displays data from a range of sensors on iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad and AirPods — including accelerometer, gyroscope, GPS, audio, camera and Bluetooth devices. You can log device properties such as screen brightness, battery and network state. Select and preview desired sensors in a few taps. A single tap initiates the recording function, which works even when the app is in the background. View and manage recordings within the app via interactive plots. The app supports many export formats, including Zipped CSV, JSON, Excel, KML and more. For advanced use cases, stream data via HTTP or MQTT, resample measurements from multiple sensors, create Studies to collect data from other users systematically and write custom automation rules based on sensor, time and location. Once you have collected your data, you can create Stories — data-driven dashboard with your recordings, hosted online for effortless sharing.
Sensor Logger is designed for researchers, educators, and anyone interested in collecting or monitoring sensors on their smartphone. It serves as the ultimate toolbox for exploring various fields, including physics, science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM).
- One-tap logging
- Background recording
- Recordings on interactive plots
- Stream data via HTTP & MQTT
- Intelligent, custom rule engine
- Zipped CSV, JSON, Excel, KML & SQLite exports
- Resample and aggregate measurements
- Enable & disable specific sensors
- Scan and log nearby Bluetooth devices
- Add timestamp-synchronised annotations during recording
- Adjust sampling frequency for sensor groups
- Custom recording workflow
- Raw and calibrated measurements available
- Live plots and readings for sensors
- Organise, sort and filter recordings
- Control & track recording session from Watch
- Bulk export & delete recordings
- Resources to help you analyse your data
- Data stays on-device and private
- Create and share dashboard-style, data-driven Stories using your recordings, hosted online. 
Studies & Sensor Logger Cloud
Create Studies to collect data from other Sensor Logger users efficiently. When activated, Studies use the investigator's specified sensor configuration for consistent data collection. Participants can upload their recordings to a secure cloud and join, pause, or switch Studies anytime. Studies include clear data usage descriptions, privacy statements, and contact details to ensure privacy compliance. Customize Study size, duration, sensor configuration, and export formats.
Optional Paid Features (Plus, Pro & Ultimate)
- No limitations on the number of stored recordings
- Additional export formats
- Combined CSV export
- Customise recording workflow
- Advanced sensor configurations
- Custom naming templates
- Theme and icon customizations
- Unlimited Bluetooth beacons and no limit on the minimum RSSI
- Create larger Studies with more participants
- More allocated storage on Sensor Logger Cloud
- Email support
- Advanced study customization
Supported Measurements
- Device Acceleration (Accelerometer; Raw & Calibrated)
- Gravity Vector (Accelerometer)
- Device Rotation Rate (Gyro)
- Device Orientation (Gyro Raw & Calibrated)
- Magnetic Field (Magnetometer Raw & Calibrated)
- Compass
- Barometric Altitude (Barometer)
- GPS Coordinate, Altitude, Speed & Heading
- Audio (Microphone)
- Loudness (Microphone)
- Images (Front/Back)
- Video (Front/Back)
- Depth
- Pedometer
- Activity
- Heart Rate (Watch)
- Wrist Motion (Watch)
- Location & Barometer (Watch)
- Annotations (Timestamp and text)
- Device battery level and state
- Device screen brightness level
- Nearby Bluetooth beacons (advertised data)
- Headphone Motion (AirPods)
- Network
Heart rate logging requires integration with the Health app on the watch. Permission to access the heart rate from HealthKit on the watch is needed for the app to log the measurements.
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

### Scan & import ###
• Scan with your camera (automatic document detection & automatic angle correction)
• Import existing images
• Import existing PDF files
• Organize your documents in folders
### OCR (text recognition) ###
• Professional-quality OCR on images and existing PDFs
• Make documents searchable with text integrated into PDFs (search, select, copy, paste)
• Automatic language detection and dictionary matching for highly accurate results
### SIGN ###
• Add signatures to your documents
• Create signatures with your finger, Apple Pencil, or import existing signatures
• Adjust size and color for a polished look
### Automate ###
• Automatic document/file naming with patterns (e.g., document date, title, issuer, time, text, counter)
• 'Export Favorites': Automatically export to preconfigured locations (cloud, email, etc.) with custom settings (color, black & white, filename, format)
• 'Export Groups': Export to multiple locations simultaneously by grouping Export Favorites
• Automatic deletion of documents after successful export
• iOS Home screen & Lock screen Widgets & Control Center controls. Associate an Export Favorite to the widget for instant export to that favorite after the scan started by tapping the widget.
• Place document automatically in the configured folder when the scan is started from a Widget/Shortcut associated to an Export Favorite
• Siri Shortcuts compatible
• Launch scan directly from the home screen with a long press on the app icon (or using a widget)

• Export in PDF with the recognized text integrated (very advanced feature). This allows to search/copy & paste into the generated PDF.
• Export recognized text as a .txt file
• Export as images with optional filters (grayscale, black & white)
• Save to cloud services with Favorites (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, WebDAV, paperless-ngx, pCloud, NAS, SMB, NextCloud, and more)
• Export anywhere (to Files, to any Drive, E-mail, message, Airdrop, …), or to the cloud

bluejetty:00175651:ios.description:
"Ultimate City Bus Simulator" is an immersive and highly detailed simulation game that puts you in the driver's seat of a city bus, allowing you to experience the challenges and excitement of navigating a bustling urban environment. In this game, you'll have the opportunity to explore a meticulously crafted virtual city with realistic traffic patterns, weather conditions, and a wide variety of passenger types.
Key Features:
Realistic City Environment: Explore a sprawling and vibrant city with detailed streets, intersections, landmarks, and neighborhoods. The city comes to life with a dynamic day-night cycle and changing weather conditions, adding to the realism.
Authentic Bus Models: Drive a selection of meticulously modeled city buses, each with its own unique characteristics, including size, capacity, and handling. Experience the intricacies of operating different bus types, from traditional city buses to articulated vehicles.
Challenging Routes: Take on a variety of challenging routes that will test your driving skills, including regular bus lines, express routes, and special event services. Navigate through traffic, adhere to timetables, and ensure passenger safety.
Passenger Interaction: Interact with a diverse range of passengers, each with their own behavior and requests. Collect fares, assist passengers with boarding and alighting, and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.
Realistic Traffic and Pedestrian AI: Encounter realistic traffic flow and pedestrian behavior, making every drive a unique experience. Deal with traffic jams, accidents, and unexpected roadblocks as you strive to keep to your schedule.
Customization Options: Customize your buses with various paint jobs and liveries to make them stand out on the streets. Upgrade and maintain your vehicles to ensure they run smoothly.
Immersive Sound Design: Enjoy realistic engine sounds, ambient noise, and passenger chatter that enhance the overall immersion of the game.
Career Mode: Take on the role of a professional bus driver and progress through a dynamic career mode. Earn rewards, unlock new routes and buses, and strive to become the ultimate city bus driver.
Free Roam Mode: For those who prefer a more relaxed experience, explore the city at your own pace in free roam mode. Take in the sights, practice your driving skills, or simply enjoy the open world environment.
"Ultima

bluejetty:00073321:ios.description:
Calling all pool sharks! Test your skills in 8 Ball Strike, an exciting billiards game you can compete in to win real cash and other prizes! Enjoy smooth controls and a high-quality interactive pool experience, with unique features that will have you on the edge of your seat with each strike!
Download for free! Compete in a wide variety of tournaments with REAL CASH prizes and more in cash matches. Enjoy real competition across different match types, including classic 8 ball formats that reward smart strike choices. We're committed to providing a secure gaming platform based on social competition for all our players.
HOW TO PLAY
Simply tap or drag to aim the cue stick and pull back the power bar to shoot. Each pocket and ball has a different bonus, so strategize before taking the shot! Race against the clock to earn the highest score you can, and outperform opponents to claim match prizes. Anyone can play this simple pool game, but it takes skill to strike accurately and walk away a champion who can win consistently.
EXPLORE FUN FEATURES
PLAY CASH MATCHES, WIN REAL CASH!
-Use Coins to play free matches, or participate in Cash Matches to win real cash. Earn free in-game items daily by logging in and participating in various in-game events that help you improve your 8 ball pool skills.
EXCITING MULTIPLAYER TOURNAMENTS
-Play in 8-ball tournaments of different match modes with multiple other players. The higher you rank, the bigger the prize! Practice for free before playing Cash Matches, then choose from a variety of prize pools to win REAL CASH and/or in-game items through precise 8-ball shots and clean strikes.
SAFE AND SECURE WITHDRAWALS
-It's safe and easy to withdraw your winnings with PayPal. We also work with trusted partners, including Apple Pay, Visa, Venmo, and more, to make the deposit and withdrawal process secure and smooth, giving you a real and reliable way to access what you win.
PLAY MINIGAMES, WIN IN-GAME ITEMS 
-Win extra in-game items through our classic minigames and other fun features that add more ways to strike real rewards and enhance your pool gameplay.
NON-INTRUISIVE AD EXPERIENCE
-Once you start an 8-ball match, a truly immersive gaming experience begins with no ads that interrupt your gameplay or your chance to win!
Cash matches are not available in the following states: Arkansas, Delaware, Louisiana, Michigan, South Dakota, or U.S. territories, including Puerto Rico. However, players in these states can still enjoy the fun with free pool games!
Players must be at least 18 years of age. In some jurisdictions where Cash Matches are not available, players can compete in our free games. See our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for more information.
Ready to join the latest 8-ball pool sports game and experience an exciting take on billiards to win real cash? Download 8 Ball Strike now and start your next winning strike!
Questions or concerns? Please contact us at: helpcenter@aviagames.com

bluejetty:00071080:ios.summary: ViewExif is a powerful metadata tool for your photos. With the help of ViewExif, you can not only view metadata of photos, but also edit and remove metadata in photo. Besides, it has an app extension, so you can view metadata right in Photo
bluejetty:00071080:ios.description:
ViewExif is a powerful metadata tool for your photos. With the help of ViewExif, you can not only view metadata of photos, but also edit and remove metadata in photo. Besides, it has an app extension, so you can view metadata right in Photos app. 
Being able to read exif tags can be of great importance not only for beginners, but also for other photographers who want to find out what settings and tools were used to create a particular photograph. 
For those people who want to protect privacy, this app is useful for you as well. When you send photos via email or share on social network, your personal information (geo location, taken date etc) is shared as well. If you upset to share those information, ViewExif is able to remove it before sharing.
Features:
* Display EXIF tags: Dimensions, Taken Date, ISO Speed, F Number, Exposure Time, Focal Length and more.
* Display IPTC tags: Star Ratings, Keywords, Description etc.
* Display geo location on map.
* Add star ratings, keywords and description on photo
* Remove metadata from photo
* Supported image formats (JPG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC) and RAW formats (CR2, NEF, DNG).
* Share photo w/o metadata on Twitter, Facebook, email.
* App extension for Photos app and 3rd-party apps such as Dropbox, FileExplorer etc.
* Dark Mode
===== CONTACT US =====
Email: support@skyjos.com
Twitter: @SkyjosApps

The Canadian Citizenship Test is a written examination that serves as a requirement for individuals seeking Canadian citizenship. The purpose of the test is to demonstrate that the applicant has adequate knowledge of Canadian society and satisfactory proficiency in the English language. The exam comprises 20 questions that address Canadian values, history, politics, and daily life topics.
You’ll be tested on information in the official Discover Canada: The Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship handbook included in this app - this is the only book recommended to prepare for the test. You’ll have 30 minutes to answer 20 questions.
Prepare for your Canadian Citizenship Test with over 700 practice questions designed to help you pass with flying colors. Download now and be confident for your test day.
Our Mock Tests are intentionally designed to be more challenging than the real exam to help you better prepare and build confidence.

Learning Module: Study Canadian history, government, rights and responsibilities, and more at your own pace with our comprehensive learning modules that include audio lessons. Assess your understanding of the learning modules with level tests and track your progress.
Practice Tests: 700+ exam-like questions based on the official Canadian citizenship study guide. Instant feedback included.
Exam Simulator: Experience the real Canadian Citizenship Test with random questions generated each time.
Question Bank: Keep track of your mistakes for future reference.
Progress Tracker: Monitor your progress and know how likely you are to pass the test.
Test Date Setting: Set and track your test date.
Saved Progress: App remembers where you left off.
Clean UI: Simple and easy to use.

bluejetty:00121245:ios.name: Epic Summoners: Monsters War
bluejetty:00121245:ios.summary:
The alliances of Good and Evil have been forged. The final battle between epic warriors and heroes on both sides is about to start. Ride the crest of the Idle RPG wave with Epic Summoners! 
Prepare your best summoner heroes for the fight.
bluejetty:00121245:ios.description:
The alliances of Good and Evil have been forged. The final battle between epic warriors and heroes on both sides is about to start. Ride the crest of the Idle RPG wave with Epic Summoners! 
Prepare your best summoner heroes for the fight. Join friends and players from across the globe as you embark on an epic journey of enchantment to explore the Magic Ladder and the secrets contained deep within. Lead your action heroes and warriors into the light and overcome all battle challenges that lay before you to emerge victorious in an epic war! The world's destiny is in your hands!
ENGROSSING ACTION RPG GAMEPLAY
Your summoner heroes can’t wait to fight auto-battles against the enemy on your behalf! Recruit and gain experience with every powerful hero in the battle in this idle game!
Epic equipment and legendary summoner heroes and warriors waiting for you to collect!
Earn awesome combat rewards even when you’re offline. No need to stress when life calls!
ENDLESS TACTICAL AND STRATEGIC FUN
Plan your battle tactics with your hero to secure victory in this action RPG!
Collect, upgrade and use your equipment wisely to show off your strength as leader on an epic adventure!
Simple, yet effective strategy combat allows you to enjoy this RPG at home or on the go! Plan your characters tactics and dominate the battlefield to defeat evil heroes and enemy warriors troops!
THRILLING ACTION BATTLE CONTENT TO KEEP YOU ON YOUR TOES
Summon and recruit summoner heroes and warriors troops, deploy, defend, fight, collect and upgrade to accomplish your RPG goals!
Between the Expedition Airship, Arena, Magic Ladder and Wishing Pond, there’s a huge world to explore in this idle game and new creatures to find!
Your interest will never waver with our steady stream of great war content! Challenge your friends and defeat players from all over the world in this action RPG!
A HIGH QUALITY VISUAL AND AUDIO FEAST
Exquisite aesthetics and creatures artwork in this action RPG full of fun!
Jaw dropping epic combat animations in the arena and awe inspiring battle skill effects!
THROW DOWN WITH PLAYERS AND FRIENDS
Step into our battle RPG Arena and compete with skilled players from all over the world! Recruit new summoner heroes and warriors troops with different abilities to defeat every evil enemy!
Change your tactics and action maneuver against rivals to see your name climb the rankings and beat your friends best scores!
Win awesome battle rewards on your way to claiming the ultimate victory wih your army in this war idle game!
Start now this epic journey with your best action hero and powerful warriors in a fantasy adventure with different creatures and battlegrounds in a non-stop RPG! Lead your magic summoner heroes guild army in a battle to the death! 
Contact us:
Email: legendarysummoners@feelingtouch.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/legendarysummoners2017/

bluejetty:00005143:android.description:
Welcome to the world of Asterix and his friends. Build your own Gaulish village in Asterix’s world. Embark on an epic adventure, explore the world, join forces with your friends and create powerful guilds to fight back the Roman army. Complete funny and challenging quests while making your way through Roman legions and camps and reach Egypt with Asterix, Obelix, Dogmatix, and other new and classic characters!
BUILD YOUR OWN VILLAGE IN THE WORLD OF ASTERIX
Hunt wild boars, fish out the best quality seafood to prepare a delicious meal for Obelix, or just slap it in the face of your opponents! Gather wood, stone, wheat, and many more resources to re-build your village and lead Asterix and Friends to victory!
FIGHT JULIUS CAESAR AND BEAT UP HIS ROMAN ARMY
Explore the power of a vast array of potions, craft weapons and armors. Reunite your favorite characters, equip and train them to be ready to strike back at the Roman Empire!
TRADE AND BATTLE SIDE-BY-SIDE WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Join a guild, or make your own and help your fellow Gauls to fight off the invading legions! Engage in hilarious village brawls with your friends or foes to reach fame and glory in Gaul’s history!
EXPLORE ASTERIX’S WORLD AND COMPLETE EXCITING QUESTS
Fulfill the many quests Asterix and Friends will challenge you with, and they will reward you abundantly and even join you in the battle to free Gaul from the Roman armies and help you sail to new shores.
WHAT’S NEW IN ASTERIX& FRIENDS?
A lot of new game content is waiting for you! Send the villagers on journeys and experience exciting adventures with them in Corsica, Spain and Britain. Look forward to a brand new character in the game: Grenadine, the blacksmith's wife. She is the first female villager and brings with her her own garden and many new tasks. In addition to new visual building improvements that are automatically unlocked at certain levels, you can now also make various embellishments in and around the village: from new palisades to flowering bushes and meadows to water lilies in the river, Asterix & Friends Remastered offers you many ways to customize the look of your Gaulish village according to your preferences.

bluejetty:00075646:ios.description:
Think Smarter. Search Deeper. Discover More.
OneSearch: DeepSearch Finder is an advanced AI-powered search app designed to help you explore information, analyze profiles, and conduct in-depth research with clarity and confidence.
Unlike traditional search engines that simply show endless links, OneSearch: DeepSearch Finder turns AI-powered searches into organized insights—helping you move from raw information to real understanding.
AI Deep Search – A Smarter AI Search Engine:
Deep Search is the core of OneSearch: Deep Search & AI Chat. It goes beyond simple keyword results and generic summaries.
Instead of manually checking multiple sources, this app analyzes and organizes information for you by:
– Conducting web searches with AI contextual understanding
– Analyzing information from diverse sources
– Synthesizing key insights into clear and structured summaries
– Comparing perspectives and explaining complex relationships
– Exploring public profiles and digital presence
– Helping you review and understand available personal information
Whether for academic research, professional background checks, or simple curiosity, this AI Search Engine turns information into meaningful insights.
AI Chat Assistant – Your Smart Follow-Up Tool:
Beyond Deep Search, OneSearch: Deep Search & AI Chat also offers a powerful AI Chat Assistant to help you engage with results and refine your thinking.
With AI Chat Assistant, you can:
– Ask follow-up or complex questions based on your search results
– Get structured explanations and deeper overviews
– Continue conversations with contextual awareness
– Generate ideas and explore topics step by step
OneSearch also includes extra smart tools:
– AI Math Solver: Solve math problems step-by-step with clear explanations, from basic calculations to advanced topics.
– Image-Based Search: Upload images to extract text, identify content, or search visually using AI analysis.
– AI Voice Chat: Interact naturally using your voice for hands-free searches and questions.
These tools complement Deep Search and support research, productivity, and daily problem-solving.
Designed for Focus, Speed, and Trust:
– Clean, intuitive interface optimized for Apple devices
– Fast AI-powered searches and contextual responses
– Perfect for research, profile exploration, learning, and informed decision-making
OneSearch: DeepSearch Finder is an independent app using officially licensed AI technology. We respect your privacy and do not collect personal data.

• Upgrade to Premium to unlock the full power of OneSearch:
• Unlimited Deep Search and AI chat
• Faster response times
• Ad-free experience

The IdentityForce Mobile App, brought to you by IdentityForce, Inc., enables active members to take their Identity Theft Protection anywhere – world-class capabilities empowering you to spot fraud quickly with a snapshot view of all critical alert notifications. Depending on the IdentityForce Plan selected, members get access to Advanced Fraud Monitoring, 3-Bureau Credit Report Monitoring, and identity restoration experts. Designed and influenced by our members through surveys and a preview community, IdentityForce has built and released a mobile app that features intuitive navigation with a zero-tolerance policy for advertising or promotional materials. IdentityForce’s top priority is security, and the mobile app features both Two Factor Authentication (2FA) and Touch ID. So no matter whether you are traveling overseas, away on vacation, or you just don’t want to be tethered to your desktop computer, IdentityForce Mobile makes sure you are protected anywhere, anytime.
For nearly 40 years, IdentityForce, Inc. has provided best-in-class, highly scalable, award-winning identity theft, privacy, and credit protection solutions to consumers, businesses, and government agencies. A pioneer of identity protection, IdentityForce’s innovation and customer-centric approach has made the company a trusted partner for both organizations and individuals. 
Take your fraud protection to the next level with…
• Convenient and confidence-boosting security
• Encrypted anywhere-access
• Interactive identity alerts
• Secure storage edits & uploads
• Timely fraud news & tips
• Comprehensive device scanning including an encrypted virtual private network (VPN)
To download the IdentityForce Mobile App, you need to be an active IdentityForce Member. You must be at least 18 years of age to access or download this app. If you are under 18 years of age, you are prohibited from accessing or downloading this app. Read more in our Terms of Service below.

Апп-аар авах боломжтой үйлчилгээ:
• Дата багц авах, интернэт хэрэглээгээ хянах
• Нэгж, датаны үлдэгдлээ шалгах
• Яриа, дататай дижитал карт худалдан авах
• Төлбөр төлөх, төлбөрийн үлдэгдэл шалгах
• Шинэ дугаар авах, багцаа ахиулах
• Аяллын SIM / eSIM авах, роуминг идэвхжүүлэх
• Зөвхөн танд зориулсан урамшуулал, онцгой санал авах

• mobihome үйлчилгээ захиалах
• mobilife даатгал идэвхжүүлэх

mobicom апп нь аюулгүй, найдвартай, хэрэглэгч төвтэй шийдэл юм.Апп-аа татаж, шинэчилж, бүх үйлчилгээгээ үйлчилгээний салбарт очихгүйгээр хаанаас ч, хэзээ ч аваарай.

• Purchase data packages and monitor internet usage

• Purchase Travel SIM / eSIM and activate roaming services 
• Receive personalized promotions and exclusive offers

The mobicom app is secure, reliable, and designed around customer needs. Download or update the app today and manage all your services without visiting a service center anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00088345:android.description:
Welcome to Zoomex - the world's premier digital asset trading platform, providing users with derivative trading services for a wide range of assets, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Dogecoin (DOGE), and many more.
Zoomex is a crypto trading app designed for futures and margin trading.
Trade Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies with advanced trading tools.
This crypto exchange app offers fast execution and real-time market charts.
Zoomex currently supports trading pairs such as Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Chainlink (LINK), Litecoin (LTC), Cardano (ADA), Polkadot (DOT), EOS (EOS), Ripple (XRP), Uniswap (UNI), DASH, DOGE, FIL, and XLM. Additionally, high-performing assets like Solana (SOL), Decentraland (MANA), and Avalanche (AVAX) are also available for both spot and derivative trading.
Features Supported by Zoomex:
- Spot Trading: Professional settings for limit orders, allowing simultaneous stop-loss and take-profit settings when placing orders.
- Perpetual Contract Trading: Supports up to 120x leverage to maximize returns, with one-click closing for easy management of all positions.
- Copy Trading: Follow professional traders worldwide with one click. Even beginners can earn stable returns with zero entry barriers.
Why Choose Zoomex?
Seamless User Experience
We cater to the needs of both beginners and professionals. New users can quickly get started with contract and spot trading through a clean and intuitive interface, while professionals can take advantage of Zoomex's powerful trading tools to track market trends in real-time and seize profit opportunities.
Diverse Trading Options
At ZOOMEX, users can easily trade spot assets like BTC, ETH, LINK, ADA, SOL, DOT, XRP, MNT, WLD, AVAX, MEME, USDC, PEPE, and many more. Additionally, there are various perpetual contracts to explore, enriching your investment choices.
Zero Barrier to Stable Returns
Our platform supports one-click copy trading, allowing beginners to automatically trade by following the world’s top cryptocurrency traders and achieve stable and substantial returns with no entry barriers.
A Safe and Reliable Cryptocurrency Trading Platform
Protecting your assets is our top priority. We are committed to optimizing platform security to provide robust protection for investors amidst uncertain external changes.
- ZOOMEX ensures your privacy, security, and anonymity.
- Utilizes a multi-signature cold/hot wallet system as a financial asset protection mechanism.
- Implements two-factor authentication to safeguard your account security.
24/7 Support Anytime, Anywhere
We provide 24/7 customer service to offer comprehensive trading support. If you encounter any issues while using our platform, please contact us at support@zoomex.com.
About Zoomex
Zoomex: Simple, Fair & Transparent Crypto Trading
Join over 3 million users on Zoomex, a global crypto platform built on the values of “Simple × User-Friendly × Fast.” We offer 600+ trading pairs with a focus on fairness and high-speed execution, delivering a trustworthy environment for both beginners and pros.
Proof Over Promises: Experience unmatched transparency with our “Position = Account” logic. Every trade is traceable, ensuring a fair and open market.
Minimalist Interface: Trade with ease. Our clean design and intuitive controls allow you to manage assets with just a few taps.
World-Class Backing: As an Official Partner of TGR Haas F1 Team and global ambassador Emiliano Martínez, we bring racetrack precision to your trading.
Certified Security: Audited by Hacken and licensed by U.S./Canada MSB, we provide industry-grade protection.
Crypto Life: Bridge digital assets to real-world spending with the Zoomex Card.

bluejetty:00139804:ios.description:
MoM is a cultist simulator in the idle clicker genre created by two indie game designers who love pixel art and the dark fantasy world of H.P. Lovecraft. Take on the role of a devoted acolyte, seeking to awaken Cthulhu in his ruined temple. Tap to gather souls or summon eldritch horrors to do it for you. Your cultists and minions ensure that both tapping and automation remain powerful as you grow incrementally.
As indie developers, we believe in a fair, ad-free experience. All ads in MoM are optional and everything can be earned just by playing. No paywalls, just pure strategic gameplay.
We've spent years refining Masters of Madness Incremental to create a deep and rewarding experience:
◆ Draw occult sigils to unleash powerful bonuses
◆ Collect artifacts that unlock unique abilities
◆ Decorate your shrine with idols to gain strategic buffs
◆ Master the ascension & transcension system for endless progression
◆ Participate in regular events with special modifiers
◆ Immerse yourself in the atmospheric dark-fantasy world with handcrafted pixel game art
Step into Cthulhu's temple and awaken the Great Old One!
Contact us at support@antiway.net for any questions and feedback.

bluejetty:00041982:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00041982:ios.description:
Story introduction of “Heaven Travel”
Lofn, a little girl who wakes up on an ethereal grassland, sets out on an adventure in order to save the Memory Tree. While she collects different memory pieces, she also discovers the surprising truth of her life. Other than unexpected plot twists, the story is presented in a unique way which we hope will stimulate the reader to look at life from a different perspective.
The art style of “Heaven Travel”
The art team has tried to imitate chalk with pastel colors in order to create the image of Heaven. Characters and souvenirs are designed according to their planet of origin to establish a unique and intriguing world. 
Game characteristics of “Heaven Travel”
If players pay careful attention to the storyline, they will realize the amount of effort that has gone into each line. Other than adding humorous elements to the story, the author also wishes to let the player have a different perspective and deeper understanding of the world.
Although each storyline seems to be individual, they are in fact intertwined and the player will be faced with different surprises and reflections as it unwinds.
Gameplay may seem simple but it is in fact complex. Different choices that the players make at different times with different equipment will bring different results. By choosing their souvenirs tactically and dispelling the curse will decrease the amount of time required to collect memory pieces. Simply speaking, everyone will find their own form of entertainment from this game. 
Thoughts behind “Heaven Travel”
Yan Wong is the producer of the game “Heaven Travel”. He discovered that most of his friends were pessimistic, too busy to enjoy their lives, or believed in nothing after death. Even if some of his friends felt that they would go to heaven, they had never really thought about what heaven would be like.
Therefore, Yan Wong pictured the heaven he has in mind through Lofn’s adventures, and he would like to provoke his audience to view their lives from a different perspective.
As long as there is faith, any dream can become a reality.

bluejetty:00131000:ios.description:
Ontario 511 app provides near real-time highway and traffic information to Ontario drivers to help them safely plan their route. This includes information on construction, truck and public rest areas, incidents and road closures, weather alerts and the location of snowplows on highways across the province. 
This app features a scrollable, zoomable map that displays: 
• Traffic speeds 
• Incidents and closures, such as collisions and other road hazards 
• Over 600 cameras 
• Construction and roadwork 
• Rest area information 
• Road Conditions 
• Seasonal loads 
• Track My Plow to locate snow plows on Ontario highways 
• Weather alerts from Environment Canada 
The app also features Drive Mode Alerts that notify drivers with an audio alert of incidents, closures, weather warnings, and rest areas ahead. 
The app provides information and support in both English and French
Looking to provide feedback on how we can improve the Ontario 511 app? Please email Ontario 511 at 511Feedback@ontario.ca
