bluejetty:00026985:ios.summary: Whether you are wing foiling, wavesailing in breaking waves, or windsurfing the gnar on your local bay, river, or lake, you want and need the best possible forecasts and live wind reports… and iWindsurf has them! We have deployed over 90,00
bluejetty:00026985:ios.description:
Whether you are wing foiling, wavesailing in breaking waves, or windsurfing the gnar on your local bay, river, or lake, you want and need the best possible forecasts and live wind reports… and iWindsurf has them! We have deployed over 90,000 proprietary Tempest Weather Systems, giving you real-time local weather right where you sail. With exclusive iWindsurf stations on near shore markers, buoys, piers, breakwaters, and key waterfront spots, we have a terrific number of local windsurfing areas covered. Our Tempest Rapid Refresh Model delivers the most accurate Nearcast predictions to our customers. We supplement our proprietary data with information from government agencies including: NOAA, NWS, and bring in reports sets including the AWOS, ASOS, METAR, and even CWOP. iWindsurf creates a complete view of the weather with radar, forecast maps, and customized alerting.
Why you should download iWindsurf:
- Coastal observations from proprietary Tempest Weather Systems along with all public domain marine forecasts and reports (NOAA, NWS, METAR, ASOS, CWOP) including all major airports creating over 125,000 unique stations.
- Our exclusive Tempest Weather Systems deployed at coastal buildings, and at beaches, with haptic rain sensors, sonic anemometers, along with local barometric pressure sensors, provide ground truth observations.
- Apple Watch compatibility
- Live wind from our systems provides a better windy conditions flow map – augmented by current station reports with advanced quality control.
- Our Proprietary AI-enhanced Nearcast provides enhanced forecasting for temperature, wind gust, speed, direction, humidity, dewpoint, precipitation rate, probability of precipitation, and cloud cover percentage.
- Public domain forecast models including High Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR), North American Mesoscale Forecast System (NAM), Global Forecast System (GFS), Canadian Meteorological Centre Model (CMC), Icosahedral Non Hydrostatic Model (ICON).
- Free subscription for unlimited wind alerts with customizable thresholds to email, text, or in-app.
- Create your own Favorite station list to keep an eye on your go-to weather stations at your foiling, windsurfing, and surfing spots.
- Maps - Live and Forecasted Wind, Temperature, Radar, Satellite, Precipitation and Clouds, as well as Nautical Charts.
- National Weather Service (NWS) Marine Forecasts & Marine Warnings / Alerts
- Also:
 - Tides charts
 - Wave height, wave period
 - Water temperature
 - Sunrise / sunset
 - Moonrise / moonset
 - Historical wind statistics
 - Wind direction distribution
Want more weather?
- Upgrade to Plus, Pro, or Gold membership to gain access to more weather stations and forecasts.
- Access our exclusive ultra high-quality array of meteorologist-sited Pro stations at tip top coastal locations.
- Unlock access to iWindsurf’s second-to-none meteorologist-written hyper-accurate Pro forecasts written daily for windsurfing hotspots coast-to-coast.
- Detailed weather info, gusts, rain radar, satellite, NOAA, NWS, at spots of interest to coastal residents and property owners near the ocean, rivers, and other bodies of water.
- On the water features
 - Sea surface temperatures
 - Sea surface currents
 - Detailed historical wind statistics
 - Historical wind speed average by year
What else can you do?
- Get a Tempest Weather System for your house, business, windsurf club, pier, or backyard.

bluejetty:00127294:ios.description:
A frog in the tribal is on the road of revenge for Marble Bubble Shooter.
Frog Blast belongs to the family of casual match-3 shoot games for a wide range of users. 
The meaning of the game is to prevent the penetration of balls of different colors into the black skull. 
These balls are steadily moving in its direction along a spiral trajectory. The balls are destroyed by other balls of different colors that are emitted from the Frog, 
located in the central part of the playing field. 
Thus, to attack you need to shoot the ball of the same color into the group of at least two same colored balls. ttherwise, the impact ball is stuck in a spiral. 
During the game you need to destroy as many balls as possible, to collect the maximum of gold coins and various bonuses
To prevent the penetration of the balls into the skull.
The frog is in fact, the main hero of the game. Thanks to your efforts it accurately attacks the groups of moving balls.
The game has many levels. Each of them is given specific time.Having fun more than classic match 3 games.
How to play
1.Tap screen where you want to shoot marbles.
2.match 3 or more same color marbles to make blast.
3.Swap the shooting ball by touching the emitter.
Enjoy this fun frog bubble shooter puzzle game for relieve stress, relax and spend casual time !

bluejetty:00077011:ios.name: PoolFit
bluejetty:00077011:ios.summary:

OVER 225 POOL & IN-HOME WORKOUTS
PoolFit currently has over 225 water exe
bluejetty:00077011:ios.description:
Exercise in your own pool. Advanced to beginner, achieve your fitness goals with a wide variety of low-impact, challenging water workouts led by top instructors. 
OVER 225 POOL & IN-HOME WORKOUTS
PoolFit currently has over 225 water exercise workouts to choose from. There are also in-home fitness workouts for when you can’t get in the pool. Two to three new videos are posted each month. Select from a wide variety of at-home water workouts, including water aerobics, deep water fitness, aqua boot camp, pool HIIT workouts, aqua arthritis, water walking, aqua Pilates & yoga, as well as pool workouts with noodles, foam dumbbells, Aqualogix equipment, webbed gloves and more. 
DOWNLOAD & GO
Select your daily pool workout video, download to your device and then head to the pool and follow along with water fitness classes led by trained experts. NEW! You can now create a playlist of your favorite workouts that will play consecutively. Visit the PoolFit Mobile App page and watch some short video tutorials on how to use the Poolfit App features and resources, along with tips for exercising poolside with mobile & tablet devices, as well as Chromecast and Airplay enabled TVs. 
TOP WATER FITNESS INSTRUCTORS
All PoolFit videos are led by certified fitness professionals, many of whom educate water fitness instructors across the globe. PoolFit is all about water exercise workouts for all fitness levels and we strictly adhere to safety and industry guidelines.
TRY THE APP FOR FREE
You can subscribe and receive a 7 day free trial. Just want to dip your toes into PoolFit? You can try out 8 sample workouts for FREE before subscribing for the trial period.
SUBSCRIPTION/7 Day Trial & PRICING TERMS
PoolFit offers two auto-renewing options:
$15.99 monthly 
$159.99 yearly (12 months for the price of 10, or $13.34/month billed annually ) 
These prices are for subscribers in the USA and pricing may vary in other countries due to currency conversion.
The subscription will automatically renew after your trial period until you cancel. You can cancel at any time in your iTunes Account Settings. You must cancel at least 24 hours before your next renewal date to avoid charges.
Read more about our terms of use here:
Terms & Conditions: https://poolfit.tv/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://poolfit.tv/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00121129:ios.description:
OM NOM IS HUNGRY — AND HE WANTS CANDY!
It is up to you to help him in 425 physics-based puzzle levels across 17 themed boxes in this GOAT puzzler! Cut ropes, use clever gadgets, and collect stars to feed the adorable green monster Om Nom with a massive sweet tooth. Each box brings new puzzle mechanics and challenges, like:
• Toy Box – bouncy platforms and unpredictable surprises
• Magic Box – magic hats and the trick of teleporting the candy
• Steam Box – valves, steam and mechanical fun
• Cosmic Box – gravity switches and clever twists
HOW TO PLAY:
• Cut ropes to guide candy to Om Nom
• Use bubbles, air cushions, valves and even bees to solve tricky puzzles
• Defy the laws of physics with superpowers
• Collect stars and coins to unlock new boxes, gain rewards, and get Om Nom new sweets to eat
FEATURES:
• Super satisfying physics-based gameplay
• Fast-paced, addictive single-player brain teasers
• Hilarious cartoons about Om Nom “Om Nom Stories”
• Play offline anywhere, anytime
• Fun for all ages, from kids to the young at heart
Feed Om Nom, collect stars, and enjoy the award-winning, globally loved puzzle adventure that has captivated millions of players worldwide!
Cut the Rope is free to download and play, however, some in-game items can be purchased for real money, including randomised items. For more information, please see our Terms of Use (https://www.zeptolab.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.zeptolab.com/privacy).

bluejetty:00069485:ios.description:
The award-winning app for kids full of 1000s of hours of bedtime stories, sleep sounds, music & white noise. With lovingly crafted original audio content for Kids set in the BAFTA-award winning world of Moshi Monsters. Designed by experts and scientifically proven to help kids sleep faster*, stay asleep for longer and reduce night wake-ups.
Why Moshi?
- We’re committed to creating safe, calming digital experiences for kids
- Our content is created by a BAFTA award-winning creative team & recommended by child-care & sleep experts
- We’re 100% ad-free & Kid-Safe, trusted by parents, physicians & experts around the world as a space for children to play, listen, learn or relax day or night 
- Our app includes daily content recommendations tailored to your child's age & interests
- Featuring special guest stories & meditations narrated by Goldie Hawn and Patrick Stewart
SLEEP
- 100s of hours of sleep content tailored for kids aged 0-12, with Bedtime Stories, White Noise, Sleep Sounds, Lullabies & Music
- Recommended by sleep experts & physicians
- Proven to improve bedtime: studies at New York University demonstrated that Moshi helps kids fall asleep 28 min earlier, stay asleep 22 min longer & experience 50% less night wakings*
- 97% of parents surveyed agree that Moshi helps their kids fall asleep faster than usual, & 95% said using the app makes bedtime less stressful**
RELAX:
- 100s of guided meditations & breathing exercises designed for kids to turn moments of stress into moments of calm using science-based relaxation techniques
- Helps kids regulate their minds and bodies through audio content that teaches breathing exercises and grounding techniques like body scanning, tapping and guided imagery
- 100s of Stories that help children relax, stay engaged, reduce anxiety, and manage negative thoughts
- Tames tantrums & supports emotional regulation through audio-based storytelling which helps kids improve focus & concentration, gain confidence and manage their emotions
AWARDS
- National Parenting Product Awards Winner
- BAFTA Children’s Award
- Tech for good impact awards
- Loved By Parents Awards: Best Family App
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Subs renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hrs before the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will be charged 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. If you’ve previously had a free trial, payment will be taken immediately. To manage your subscription & auto-renew settings, go to your icloud Account Settings after purchase.
Cancel anytime in settings at least one day before the end of the subscription period for cancellation to take effect at the end of the current subscription period. Deleting the app won't cancel your subscription.
Terms & Conditions: https://www.moshikids.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.moshikids.com/privacy-policy/
Get in touch: support@moshikids.com
Follow @playmoshikids on IG, Twitter, TikTok, Facebook
*Experiment conducted by researchers at NYU Grossman School of Medicine in Aug 2020. Study used 30 children over 10 days.
**Poll of 600 users, Apr 2019

Feeling overwhelmed, isolated, or just need someone to talk to?
TalkCampus is a global peer support network designed just for students, offering a safe space to share what you’re going through, connect with others who get it, and feel heard any time of day or night.
Join students worldwide who use TalkCampus to find connection, support, and a sense of belonging. Whether you're dealing with academic pressure, personal challenges, or just want to talk about life, you're not alone.
Why TalkCampus?
+Built for Students – This is your space. Only students can join.
+24/7 Global Community – There’s always someone around to listen and support.
+Real Talk, No Judgment – Share what’s on your mind and be met with empathy.
+Multiple Ways to Connect – Group chats, private messages, and public posts – choose how you want to engage.
+Support Through the Highs and Lows – Celebrate wins, talk through struggles, and be part of a supportive student network.
Important Information
TalkCampus is a peer support platform, not a substitute for professional mental health services. If you’re in crisis or need expert guidance, please contact a mental health professional or crisis service in your area.

bluejetty:00126414:ios.description:
NOTE: You'll need to have an active merchant account established in order to utilize this App. You must also be approved by FNS in order to accept SNAP transactions.
TotilPay Go allows any authorized merchant in ANY STATE to wirelessly process Credit Card, Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), EBT Cash, and Loyalty transactions using their iOS device.
Benefits:
- Low Cost and flexible peripheral support makes solution ideal for farmers markets and small store retail outlets
- 24/7/365 U.S. Based Customer Support
- Supports SNAP EBT transactions in accordance with USDA regulations
- Accepts Credit Cards (including EMV contact) for increased revenue and payment flexibility
Features:
- Supports EMV contact (chip) Credit Card transactions using the new Walker secure EMV/swipe audio-jack reader (EMV Level 1 & 2 certified)
- Fully EMV Level 3 certified through WorldPay to Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover
- Supports Credit Card Sale, Refund, and Void transactions, including on-screen signature capture
- SNAP EBT, EBT Cash (TANF), and Loyalty program support
- Supports Walker/Chipper/Chipper BT card readers 
- Supports the Woosim WSP-R240/R241 for printing receipts and the Blue Bamboo P25i/P25i-M for printing receipts,
- Provides the ability to print, email, and text receipts to cardholders
- Includes reconciliation reports that can be viewed directly on the device, printed, or sent via email and text message
- Supports multi-merchant/multi-user login to allow device sharing
- User-selectable merchant locations for multi-site markets
- Touch ID login for Market Manager on supported devices
- SSL/TLS encrypted; PCI PA-DSS compliant to ensure safe and secure processing
For more information about this application or about becoming an authorized merchant, visit www.fns.usda.gov/snap/ebt/fm.htm or www.MobileEbt.com.

bluejetty:00176445:ios.description:
Authenticator App provides a secure and convenient way for users to protect their accounts by adding an additional layer of security. The app generates time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs) that are used in conjunction with a user's login credentials to access online accounts, services, and applications.
With its simple set up process, support for a wide range of services and applications, and high level of security, Authenticator App is an ideal solution for anyone looking to enhance their security and protect their online identity.
Features:
-Easy to set up
Authenticator App is incredibly easy to add a new account. Users simply need to scan a QR code provided by the service or enter a secret key, which generates a unique six-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. This code is then used as a TOTP to access the account.
-Highly secure
The app uses time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs) to generate unique, time-sensitive codes that cannot be guessed or reused. Additionally, the app is protected by a PIN code or biometric authentication, such as Touch ID or Face ID, ensuring that only authorized users can access the app and view their codes. With these security features, users can be confident that their accounts are protected from unauthorized access and hacking attempts.
-Password storage protection
Password storage protection is a secure and convenient way to store and manage your passwords for various online accounts. With advanced security measures, ease of use, and automatic syncing, it allows you to keep your sensitive information private and protected from unauthorized access.
-Password generator
A random password generator is a tool that creates unique, strong passwords for online accounts. It generates passwords using a combination of letters, numbers, and symbols, making them difficult for hackers to guess or crack.
-Supports 1000+ Apps
Authenticator App supports a wide range of services and applications, including Google, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and more.
-Backup and sync
With Auto-Sync on, you can easily back up your 2FA accounts to your iCloud.
Subscription:
Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and will identify the cost of renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://ws.wisdomalls.com/log/wisdom/privacy_policy
Terms of Use: https://ws.wisdomalls.com/log/wisdom/terms_of_use

bluejetty:00146937:ios.name: Pregmate Ovulation Tracker
bluejetty:00146937:ios.summary: Pregmate is an ovulation tracker, period tracker, and pregnancy app for women who want to know what's happening with their cycle, not guess. Track your period, find your fertile window, scan your ovulation tests, and follow your pregnancy w
bluejetty:00146937:ios.description:
Pregmate is an ovulation tracker, period tracker, and pregnancy app for women who want to know what's happening with their cycle, not guess. Track your period, find your fertile window, scan your ovulation tests, and follow your pregnancy week by week. All in one app.
What's inside
Pregmate tracks your full cycle from period to pregnancy without asking you to switch apps. Your data stays in one place from the first period you log to your due date.
• Ovulation test scanner that reads any LH strip and shows your T/C ratio, a number that tells you how close you are to your LH peak
• Ovulation tracker with predictions that learn from your real test results, not just calendar averages
• Period tracker with cycle forecasts that get more accurate the more you log
• Pregnancy test log to save photos with date and DPO context, so you can compare line progression cycle to cycle
• BBT charting, cervical mucus, and 30+ symptoms
• Intercourse log for TTC timing
• Pregnancy mode that activates after your positive test
• Reminders for tests, fertile window, and period
Stop second-guessing faint lines
You don't have to decide whether a line is dark enough. Open the scanner, point your phone at your LH strip, and Pregmate reads both lines for you. You get a positive or negative right away, plus the T/C ratio. Every scan is saved with the photo, cycle day, and date, so you can watch your surge build day by day.
The scanner is built primarily for Pregmate strips, but works with most standard LH strips on the market.
How does Pregmate help you get pregnant?
The more you log, the better your fertile window predictions become. Pregmate combines your real test results, BBT, cervical mucus, and cycle history to find your most fertile days. That's the timing window TTC users care about most.
What happens after a positive pregnancy test?
Pregmate switches into pregnancy mode. Your due date gets calculated from your last period, you track each week as your pregnancy progresses, and your TTC history stays right where it was. You don't start over, and you don't need a separate pregnancy app.
Your data stays private
Pregmate doesn't sell your data. Every scan, photo, and log is yours, and you can delete any entry whenever you want.
About Pregmate test strips
Pregmate ovulation and pregnancy test strips are a popular fertility test brand on Amazon, at Target, Walmart, and CVS.
Medical note
Pregmate is a tracking and education tool. It can help you predict your fertile window but doesn't replace medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for fertility, pregnancy, or health decisions. Pregmate is not a method of birth control.
Pregmate Premium
Premium unlocks advanced cycle reports, symptom analysis by cycle phase, and exclusive features.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account on purchase confirmation. Subscription auto-renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings. Any unused trial portion forfeits when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://pregmate.app/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://pregmate.app/terms.html
Support: support@pregmate.app

Current Products:
DigiSave - DigiSave offers you the flexibility to invest towards your medium to long term goals while having access to your money within the shortest possible time to meet expenses that sneak up on you in the short-term. 
Contributions are automatically invested in the Plus Income Fund - A regulated mutual fund managed by Blackstar Advisors (the "Fund Manager"), and held with Stanbic Bank for safe keeping.
App Features:
1. Sign up in a few simple steps.
2. Subscribe to carefully curated financial solutions.
3. Log In whenever, wherever at your own convenience.
4. Verify your ID information to keep safeguard your account against identity theft and fraud.

8. Add and manage your Momo Wallet for easy transactions.
9. Withdraw cash from Achieve into your Bank Account or Momo wallet without any hustle. You always have access to your money, no matter what.
10. Reset your password when you forget it.
11. Deposit into your account and watch your savings grow!!

bluejetty:00185788:ios.description:
Get ready for an online epic warfare game in blocks' and cube men's world!
It's a live pocket game that you can battle with real people that you can always carry on with you. Control your pixel hero character in a pixel designed pleasant world environments.
Castle Crafter game will be your best friend in your spare time. Fight against real people as a team or single in well designed castles. Try to defend your castle or conquer enemies' castle with using your weapons like, sword, pickaxe, bow and arrow. Moreover, you can dig tunnels, open secret gates, build bridges and ladders, construct shelters and make shields by using crafted stones, rocks and dirts from real world. You can also bring your insidious plans with scuba diving under water.
Share your tactics with your team friends during the game by using voice chat. The game is optimized for high performance for your best game play experience.
There are 4 game modes in the game:
First game mode is Flag Capture. Players choose a team to themselves. Defenders or Attackers. Regarding to the selected team, players prevent and stop enemies to intrude their castles and fight against attackers to keep their flags in safe. Otherwise attack to the castle and try to capture the flag. Moreover they can use common weapons like Catapult, ballista and fire arrows during the game. If blue team can take the red flag and bring it near blue flag before the time runs out, blue team wins.
Second mode is Team Deathmatch. Player choose a team first at the beginning first. Reds or Blues. The most enemy killer team wins at the en of the time.
Third game mode is Deatchmatch. In this game mode, every player fight for himself only. The most enemy killer player wins the game.
Fourth mode is World Exploration. Players explore battlefields and castles offline. Players are free to play and make strategies in the world as long as they desired. There is no winning or losing in this game mode. There is no any internet connection required in this mode.
In this war game, you are going to struggle to survive against real players for hours without any restraint. You will be witness to the battle and survival techniques in the time of Steve's ancestors with a different game mechanics and graphics from other common craft games.
Why are you waiting for? Download and play.
GAME FEATURES:
- 4 different game modes: Capture The Flag, Team Deathmatch, Deatchmatch, Offline World Explore.
- Completely free
- Play with real people
- Voice chat
- 5 different weapons
- 6 different environment and castle
- Simple and Plain interface
- HD graphics and high performance

bluejetty:00045360:ios.description:
BayFirst National Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with BayFirst National Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the BayFirst National Bank app, you must be enrolled as a BayFirst National Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and log in with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00061735:ios.description:
Welcome to your digital home in Abu Dhabi. TAMM is Abu Dhabi's official government services app – your trusted companion for everything you need as a citizen, resident, business owner, or visitor. We've created a seamless digital experience that brings all Abu Dhabi Government services right to your fingertips.
Your one-stop government services platform. Access 1000+ smart government services from Abu Dhabi Police, Abu Dhabi Municipality, Department of Health, Department of Economic Development, and more – all in one beautiful, unified app.
What you can do:
· Pay bills effortlessly (ADNOC, Etisalat, du, TAQA utilities, Traffic fines, Parking, Tolls)
· Book medical appointments and access healthcare services
· Handle housing, property, and UAE residency services
· Apply for work permits, business licences, and employment services
· Discover entertainment, events, and tourism experiences
Smart features designed for your life:
· TAMM AI Assistant: Get personalised, real-time guidance for any government service. Ask questions, apply for services, and visualise your data with interactive insights.
· TAMM Spaces: Explore curated areas for housing, business, healthcare, and more – everything organised exactly how you need it.
· Flexible payments: Choose from Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, Credit/Debit cards, or TAMM Wallet.
Your secure digital government experience. Every interaction is designed to feel personal, helpful, and completely secure. We're here to make government services work beautifully for your everyday life.
Access all features by logging in with your UAE PASS account or register directly through the app.
Experience Abu Dhabi's vision for digital government – where technology enhances lives, simplifies business, and supports our vibrant community.

bluejetty:00177965:ios.description:
Want to remove that pimple or acne from your face? Or how about clearing away some of those wrinkles from under your eyes? With Blemish remover photo tool, you can simply target a certain area that you would like to fix, and use our copy skin tool to replace the area. Unlike other editors that "BLUR" your blemishes, this tool allows you to exactly control where and how the blemish is removed. You can remove multiple blemishes per photo to save and share.
You can also use this tool to remove unwanted objects in your photo and is also great at smoothing out your skin tone.
Thinks you can fix with this tool :
- Remove Pimples
- Hide unwanted objects in photos
- Remove Wrinkles
- Smooth Skin
- Hide Scars
- Clear away Blemishes
- Hide blotchy skin
- Hide Acne
- Even out your skin tone
-------------------------------
PREMIUM FEATURES
Upgrade to premium for even more great features to modify your photos :
- Unlimited Edits Per Photo
- High Quality Photos Enabled
- Remove all Watermarks
- Ad Free Experience
* Choose the length of subscription: 1 Month / 3 Months / 1 Year.
* Choose from different subscription options.
* Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel your subscription in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term.
* Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
* You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by cancelling your subscription through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service.
*This app is intended for entertainment purposes only and does not provide true pimple removal functionality, only functionality to remove them from a photo not your real face.*

bluejetty:00185216:ios.name: MadOut 2: Grand Auto Racing 3D
bluejetty:00185216:ios.summary: - Welcome to the Action racing world of MadOut 2 - a groundbreaking fusion of Role Playing Sandbox, action, shooter and racing games, set against the backdrop of Eastern Europe's visceral landscapes. Prepare to dive into a realm where up to
bluejetty:00185216:ios.description:
- Welcome to the Action racing world of MadOut 2 - a groundbreaking fusion of Role Playing Sandbox, action, shooter and racing games, set against the backdrop of Eastern Europe's visceral landscapes. Prepare to dive into a realm where up to 200 Massive multiplayers can shape their destinies, forging alliances, engaging in epic battles in rp games, and competing in exhilarating races across a vast, open world filled with endless possibilities. 
- Embark on an epic journey through more than 30 immersive story missions, each brimming with intrigue, danger, and high-stakes racing action. Immerse yourself in the rich narrative tapestry as you navigate the treacherous underworld of crime and deception, with mafia RP elements inspired by the legendary series role playing sandbox games. 
- Forge your own path to glory with a wealth of online games jobs, where collaboration is key to success in a dynamic, living world teeming with opportunities for wealth, power, and adventure. Whether you choose to climb the ranks as a ruthless gangster boss or carve out a niche as a respected entrepreneur, the choice is yours in this ever-evolving landscape of danger and opportunity. 
- Explore a vast open world that spans from bustling urban metropolises to rugged desert wastelands, each location offering its own unique challenges and rewards. Immerse yourself in the gritty realism of post-Soviet aesthetics, where every street corner tells a story of struggle, resilience, and survival. 
- Take command of over 70 meticulously detailed racing cars, from sleek sports cars to rugged off-road vehicles, each offering its own unique blend of speed, handling, and style. Customize your ride to perfection with detailed technical options, and engage in heart-stopping races against other players as you vie for dominance on the streets. 
- But MadOut 2 is more than just a Sandbox game — it's a role-playing MMO adventure sandbox RP that puts you at the center of the action games. Create your own character from scratch, customizing every aspect of their appearance and personality to suit your unique vision. Dive into a world of intrigue, betrayal, and alliances as you forge friendships and rivalries with players from around the globe. 
- And when you're ready to put your skills to the test, why not take part in exhilarating races against other players? Whether you're tearing through the streets of the city or navigating treacherous off-road terrain, the thrill of competition awaits as you race against the clock and other PvP to prove your dominance. 
- In MadOut 2 the possibilities are endless, and the action MMO adventure never ends. Whether you're a seasoned veteran of the theft series or a newcomer looking for your next gaming obsession, prepare to embark on the ultimate sandbox-style, role-playing, racing adventure of a lifetime. Welcome to the world of MadOut 2 — where the only limit is your imagination. Join us and experience the ultimate fusion of action, RP, and grand auto mayhem!

• Securely message your provider
• Request a prescription renewal

• Pay your bill
• View visit summaries
• Upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app, when enrolled in self-tracking programs.
For diabetic patients, the eGuthrie blood sugar tracking tool can help you better manage your diabetes care.

bluejetty:00030924:ios.description:
The Patient Portal app, powered by InteliChart, offers a simple and convenient way to access your medical records, manage appointments, and interact with your health care providers.
With the app, you can:
* Schedule and view upcoming appointments
* View lab results, details and history
* Request medication refills
* Send secure messages to your provider
* Complete forms
* Easily manage your account or dependent accounts
* Receive push notification reminders
* View and pay your medical bills
Important Notes:
Before using this app, you will need to acquire an account PIN number directly from your provider. You will not be able to log-in to the Patient Portal without this PIN number. If you need assistance with your account PIN or the app itself, please contact your healthcare provider directly. InteliChart does not have access to this information.

bluejetty:00186154:ios.description:
**Make Learning Fun and Super Simple**
Trusted by parents and educators worldwide, our app offers a safe, ad-free environment packed with beloved nursery rhymes, educational content and interactive games—perfect for helping toddlers learn English in a fun and natural way.
*** Winner of the Creative Child Awards ***
- App Of The Year
- Parent Teachers Choice Award
- Mom’s Choice Award
- Family Choice Award
- The National Parenting Centre’s Seal Of Approval
**All Your Favorites for Preschool**
Whether it’s Noodle & Pals, The Bumble Nums or Caitie’s Classroom, you’ll find all songs, shows and educational and entertaining content that will help your little ones with early learning.
**Play and Learn**
Count bubbles, run Carl’s Car Wash, play sports, collect food for a picnic and match pictures all in one app. Children have so many options with a growing library of games and interactive storybooks full of their favorite characters from Super Simple.
**Features**
- No ads, ever, just fun!
- Download videos to watch anywhere, anytime, even without internet.
- Early learning about animals, language, gestures, counting, ABCs and more!
- Every week we add new kid-safe educational songs, shows, and games.
- Create your own custom playlists with your favorite nursery rhymes and singalongs.
- Watch all our kids songs from YouTube like Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Wheels On The Bus, This Is The Way, and Baby Shark!
- All your favorite Super Simple shows like Carl’s Car Wash, The Bumble Nums, Caitie’s Classroom, and Finny The Shark.
- Navigating is easy for little ones. They’ll have fun exploring and finding all their favorite content.
- See our new content here first!Get started today for free and unlock full access to all your favorite content.
**About Super Simple**
We started as teachers using music and dance in our classroom, and we’re proud to be able to continue that tradition with this fun, ad-free app. With over 67 billion views, Super Simple is now home to some of the most well known and most loved children’s content.

bluejetty:00122948:ios.summary: Military Retirement is a stand alone application intended to assist military personnel from all branches of military service by informing them of their benefits upon retirement from military service. Military Retirement gives assistance by
bluejetty:00122948:ios.description:
Military Retirement is a stand alone application intended to assist military personnel from all branches of military service by informing them of their benefits upon retirement from military service. Military Retirement gives assistance by calculating an estimation of retirement pay based on the data you enter. This data is secure and does not leave your device and is not tracked in any way. Military Retirement incorporates highly detailed algorithms to calculate your retirement pay to the highest level of accuracy possible. Compare multiple scenario options to determine which retirement option is best for you. 
No login required. No personally identifying information to enter. No demographic tracking of who you are. No spam.
Military Retirement works for Active Duty and Reserve/Guard for the following types of retirement plans: Final Pay, High-3, BRS, and CSB/REDUX personnel. 
Specifically, Military Retirement will calculate
• RETIREMENT PAY : Based on Rank, Years and Months of Service, and Date of Retirement. Also works for time in rank of less than 3 years.
• SURVIVOR BENEFIT PLAN : Benefit and Premium
• TRICARE MEDICAL INSURANCE : Options and Premium
• DISABILITY PAY : Based on disability rating
• VETERANS GROUP LIFE INSURANCE : Coverage and Premium
• FEDERAL TAXES : Based on filing status
** Note **
Information provided by Military Retirement should be used for educational and initial informative purposes only. Should not be used to plan retirement budget, as actual financial figures may slightly differ.
Military Retirement supports retirement dates from 2012 onwards.
Lynnfield LLC is disabled-veteran owned.

Military Retirement incorporates highly detailed algorithms to calculate your retirement pay to the highest level of accuracy possible. Compare multiple scenario options to determine which retirement option is best for you. 

No login required. No personally identifying information to enter. No demographic tracking of who you are. No spam.

Military Retirement works for Active Duty and Reserve/Guard for the following types of retirement plans: Final Pay, High-3, BRS, and CSB/REDUX personnel. 

Specifically, Military Retirement will calculate
• RETIREMENT PAY : Based on Rank, Years and Months of Service, and Date of Retirement. Also works for time in rank of less than 3 years.
• SURVIVOR BENEFIT PLAN : Benefit and Premium
• TRICARE MEDICAL INSURANCE : Options and Premium
• DISABILITY PAY : Based on disability rating
• VETERANS GROUP LIFE INSURANCE : Coverage and Premium
• FEDERAL TAXES : Based on filing status

** Note **
Information provided by Military Retirement should be used for educational and initial informative purposes only. Should not be used to plan retirement budget, as actual financial figures may slightly differ.
Military Retirement supports retirement dates from 2012 onwards.

Lynnfield LLC is disabled-veteran owned.

bluejetty:00145492:ios.description:
Sprout helps you apply to jobs faster, while improving the quality of your applications.
Instead of filling out repetitive forms or sending generic applications, Sprout guides you through a simple flow that balances speed, personalization, and control.
How it works:
1. Swipe to discover jobs
Browse millions of roles and swipe on the ones you’re interested in.
2. Answer a few targeted questions
For each job, Sprout compares your profile with the role and asks a small set of focused questions designed to surface missing details, clarify your experience, or highlight strengths that matter for that position.
3. Get tailored documents
Using your profile and answers, Sprout generates a resume and cover letter customized for that specific job.
4. Review if you want—or apply instantly
You can review and edit everything if you choose, or skip review and let Sprout apply automatically. Review is always optional.
5. Sprout applies on your behalf
Once approved—or if review is skipped—our AI agent completes the application directly on the employer’s website for you.
Why Job Seekers Choose Sprout
• Swipe-to-apply job discovery
• Job-specific questions that improve quality
• Tailored resumes and cover letters for each role
• Optional review and editing before submission
• AI agent applies directly on employer websites
• Full end-to-end application tracking
Sprout is built to remove friction, save time, and help you apply with confidence—on your terms.
Questions or feedback? Reach us at support@usesprout.com
Please note that our core features such as swipe to apply, job search, tailored resumes & cover letters, AI agent applying, all require a subscription.
Note: We do not offer career counseling or guaranteed job placements. All recommendations are suggestions—please do your own research and consult career professionals for specific guidance.

bluejetty:00063330:ios.description:
A puzzle a day keeps the boredom away! How about turning your family photos, travel pics and any snaps from the camera into beautiful jigsaws? bluejetty:00014283:ios.description:
HOUSTON TEXAS FIRE FIGHTERS FCU MOBILE BANKING APP
With HTFFFCU Mobile, banking has never been easier. It's the safe, easy and FREE way to conduct your financial business online. Manage your accounts from your mobile phone when it's convenient for you. HTFFFCU Mobile combines the benefits of Internet banking with the power of the iPod®, the iPad® and iPhone®, providing quick access to account information.
FEATURES:
HTFFFCU Mobile is fast, convenient and free and allows user to:
Deposit checks
Check account balances
See recent activity
View transaction history
Transfer money between accounts
Locate and get directions to ATM and branch locations using GPS
REGISTER:
To use HTFFFCU Mobile, you must be an HTFFFCU Internet Banking user. HTFFFCU Mobile allows you to access your accounts using your existing CU Online username and password. To register for CU Online, please visit www.htfffcu.org 
SECURITY:
Houston Texas Fire Fighters FCU protects your financial information from unauthorized users by including:
Security questions to verify your identity
Secure login with user name and password
Advanced encryption technology
No transmission of complete account numbers
Federally Insured by NCUA

bluejetty:00148964:ios.description:
The Angelcam app is a cloud-based IP camera viewer that enables you to monitor and control your home and/or business security. Thanks to its remote access, you can view all of your connected cameras, including CCTV and IP, from anywhere in the world. With Angelcam, there’s no need for an expensive camera system as you have all of the tools and functionality you need to keep what matters most always safe and secure no matter where you are.

With it, users are empowered to react immediately, ensuring an optimal appropriate response and the end of false alarms for good.
LIVE VIDEO MONITORING
Access your cameras online anytime, from anywhere.
CONNECT ANY SENSOR/S
Connect and integrate any sensor/s to enhance your functionality.
SHARE WITH ANYONE

Back up your video to secure cloud storage (Cloud Recording subscription required).
CONNECT NEARLY ANY IP CAMERA
We support 90% of camera brands.
HELP IS ONE CLICK AWAY
Reach out to our friendly and knowledgeable support whenever you need or try our community support.
BANK-LEVEL ENCRYPTION
Rest assured knowing your camera feeds are secure and that only you, as well as the people you choose, can access them.
MULTI-CAMERA VIEW
Get an instant overview and immediate control of all your streams at once whether you have IP cameras or CCTV cameras (quality may vary based on your internet connection).
360° REAL-TIME SECURITY
Get a more comprehensive, real-time means of monitoring and investigating issues as soon as they arise, ensuring an optimal appropriate response and the end of false alarms for good.

Download one of the fastest-growing weather apps for neighborhood-level weather, local weather cameras, and accurate hyperlocal conditions. 
The Ambient Weather Network App is an ad-free weather app that offers a true hyperlocal forecast p
bluejetty:00131471:ios.description:
Download one of the fastest-growing weather apps for neighborhood-level weather, local weather cameras, and accurate hyperlocal conditions. 
The Ambient Weather Network App is an ad-free weather app that offers a true hyperlocal forecast powered by over 300,000 professional and personal weather stations and sensors.
When you open the app, you will encounter multi-layered interactive maps of weather stations, weather cams, and measurements that provide an incredibly detailed and hyper-local view of current conditions. With this data, you can easily find information about localized temperature, "feels like" temperature, humidity, pressure, windspeed, and precipitation levels from actual points like the start line of a marathon or the north end of a beach. 
Easily access your current live conditions along with hourly, daily, and weekly forecasts by selecting your location or any weather station on the map. While viewing the map, toggle on and off several map layers for wind speed, temperature, and storm-tracking radar. Locate and select the play button icons on the map to view time-lapse videos of local weather conditions.
And for even more detailed information, connect a compatible personal weather station and weather camera. For weather station owners, our network provides a platform to manage your data, customize your dashboard, record your weather history, and share your forecast and weather imagery with the community.
To find the perfect weather station and join our growing community, visit www.Ambientweather.com 
AD FREE - Enjoy the weather without any distractions or interruptions.
HYPER-LOCAL - With data from nearby personal weather stations and weather cameras, this app gives you a true hyper-local view of conditions. The weather data is so hyperlocal you can find the exact conditions at your child's soccer game or the finish line of a marathon. 
LOCAL WEATHER VIDEOS AND IMAGERY - Select the play icons on the map to view time-lapse videos from local weather cameras or select the chat bubble on the bottom menu to view your local community posts.
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY - Connect your Ambient Weather Weather Station and AWN Camera or compatible hardware to our hyperlocal network. 
Your Weather, Everywhere

https://nkhome.com/privacy

bluejetty:00152909:android.description:
VidMasti is a smart HD video player and user-controlled media saver that helps you watch, organize, and manage your videos in one place. Enjoy smooth 4K playback, save permitted clips with your action, and keep your library organized with a modern interface.

✔️ Smooth playback with hardware acceleration
✔️ Supports MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV & more
✔️ Watch movies, short clips, story-style videos, statuses (where allowed), and personal media
✔️ Easy controls: brightness, volume & playback speed

✔️ Works only for user-owned or authorized content
✔️ Keep saved videos offline for later viewing
✔️ Reliable and manual saving flow — no auto-downloads

✔️ Full-screen mode with auto-rotation
✔️ Multi-format support
🌍 Made for Everyone
✔️ Simple and intuitive design
✔️ Multiple language support

✔️ Works smoothly on low & high-end devices

【新闻频道】
提供全天候国内外权威信息，跟踪最新经济政策动向，深度剖析财经大视野。为用户提供实时专业全方位的财经金融新闻资讯、事件报道及财经深度分析，覆盖宏观经济、金融市场、商业动态、产业经济、上市公司、投资理财等财经领域。
【股票频道】
关注中国资本市场，围绕券商、监管层、上市公司、投资者等，做好证券市场资讯内容生产，为做好市值管理、提升上市公司可投性，提供内容服务。
【银行频道】
全面、及时传递银行业新闻动态，深入解读行业政策，致力于为读者提供实用行业资讯及产品服务。
【保险频道】
一站尽览保险产品与保险资讯。致力于为广大用户提供全面、深入的保险行业新闻、市场动态、产品评测以及专业保险知识的普及。
【基金频道】
提供专业、及时而全面的基金资讯，打造顶级基金经理聚合地。汇聚最新的基金新闻、基金公告、基金评级、全面详尽的基金行情数据；涵盖了最新基金产品的市场评论和研究报告，做用户身边贴心的基金投资专家。
【期货频道】
专业、全面、准确的提供7X24小时期货资讯及期货行情，覆盖期货知识，国内外期货品种，期货报价，期货操作技巧，期货评论等，帮助投资者把握期货市场投资先机。
【理财频道】
围绕理财产品、理财投资、理财规划以及理财工具等，提供理财资讯，整合各类理财项目精髓及理财投资门道，引领时尚潮流的科学理财生活前沿，为个人理财者打开通往财富的大门。
【消费频道】

LBB is your one-stop lifestyle app to explore what’s cool, new, and trending in Home, Fashion, Beauty, Local Living, Travel & More!
Read & Watch Trusted Reviews
Our community of 100+ editors, experts and insiders share their best Fashion, Home, Beauty & Electronics recommendations and reviews only on LBB. Watch fun videos of our editors & experts reviewing products, restaurants, stores, trends & all things internet-breaking on our app.

Exclusive Launches
From H&M Home and Uniqlo, to even IKEA, find out what’s new at popular highstreet stores & keep yourself updated with all the latest trends. Get a sneak peek into offline stores like Westside, CAI, Pinklay & more on LBB’s YouTube channel.

bluejetty:00135655:ios.description:
Hi, I’m Toby and I created Brightmind.
If you’re here, you probably already know meditation is valuable. The real question is: why Brightmind?
Most people try meditation… and don’t get very far. Either it’s explained in a way that’s overly complex and abstract, or it’s so simple it feels nice, but doesn’t really change anything.
That’s the problem Brightmind solves. Everything here is built on a single principle: as simple as possible, but no simpler.
I’ve spent years training in monasteries and over two decades teaching meditation. This approach comes from what actually works. I’ve stripped away the unnecessary complexity, while keeping the depth that makes meditation truly transformative. You’ll feel that in three places.
First, the guided meditations. Most apps give you hundreds of sessions that blur together. Focus on the breath, notice thoughts, relax. That’s a good start, but it lacks precision.
Brightmind is a complete meditation system. You’ll learn a wide range of techniques, carefully organized so it feels approachable, not overwhelming.
Second, the app design. Other apps give you a big library, so every time you open it, you have to decide what to do. And your learning never really builds.
Brightmind gives you a single, expert-designed Journey. Just open the app and press play. Each session builds on the last, so learning sophisticated practices is a breeze over time.
Third, the community. Meditation isn’t just about feeling calm, it’s about changing your life. And that’s hard to do alone. Brightmind helps you make meditator super friends with:
-- Live daily sits
-- Community chat
-- 1-on-1 coaching
-- Immersive retreats
Put all this together, and something different happens. You don’t just relax. You build real skill. You actually get good at meditation.
Brightmind is meditation made simple, but not simplistic. Let’s get started.
ABOUT TOBY SOLA
Toby Sola is dedicated to helping you build a feedback loop between your practice and your ability to make the world a better place. The more you meditate, the more effective you are. And the more effective you are, the deeper your practice becomes.
Toby has been teaching meditation for two decades. His craft as a teacher has been refined through years of monastic training and close collaboration with the world-renowned teacher Shinzen Young. Toby is an award-winning designer and the founder of Brightmind.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Brightmind offers one auto-renewing subscription:
$99.99 per year
This price is for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary. Actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renewing subscriptions at any time from your Apple ID Settings. Refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy: https://www.brightmind.com/terms-and-privacy

bluejetty:00038458:ios.description:
Why you will love this game?
• Play for Free - Enjoy the full game with no purchase necessary!
• Easy to Learn - Three simple rules to learn, infinite strategies to discover!
• 3 Players version - Different strategy and tactics! It is Rummy on steroids!
• Raise the Stakes - Play combos to multiply the pot, reach 10X or more!
• Fast & Intense - Finish a game in just two minutes! Will you win big or go bust?
• Real-time Multiplayer - Test your wits against millions of real people from all over the world!
• Challenging - Plan tactically and execute your combos to trap your opponents' jokers
• Play with the Best - The higher the lobby, the stronger the players
• Challenge your Friends - Who is the true King of Rummy?
• Weekly Tournaments - Will you be the champion for this season?
• Daily Bonuses - New rewards and bonuses daily!
Additional information:
• The game is free to play; however, in-app purchases are available for additional content and in-game currency. 
• Use of this application is governed by Playtato’s Terms of Service, at https://autumninteractive.com/tos
Rules:
• Objective 
End the game with the least number of points in hand by playing as many cards as possible or 
race to be the first to play all their cards.
• 4 Players Gameplay - 
Rummy 4P is a card game played with 4 people. 
The deck is made up of 2 full sets of 52 poker cards and 12 Jokers (116 cards). 
At the start of a match, each player is dealt with 20 cards and the rest are then put away.
• 3 Players Gameplay - 
Rummy 3P is our special version of Rummy for 3 people. 
The deck is made up of only the Heart and Spade suits from 2 decks and 6 Jokers (58 cards). 
At the start of a match, each player is dealt with 14 cards and the rest are then put away.
Scoring: 
• At the end of a game, each card on a player’s hand contributes to 
the total number of points based on the table below:
A: 15 points
10, J, Q, K: 10 points
2-9: Their respective numbers
Joker: 20 points + Joker Penalty(each Joker doubles your total points)
Pop! Multipliers: 
Certain actions will increase the Pop! multiplier for that match:
• For playing each card above a Set of 3 cards
• For playing each card above a Run of 4 cards
• For playing each Joker past the first
• For any completed Run on the table (13 cards)

A: 15 points

bluejetty:00182431:ios.name: EasyPark - Parking made easy
bluejetty:00182431:ios.summary: EasyPark has been making cities more livable since 2001. With millions of drivers, businesses, and operators using our services in more than 20 countries, we continue to develop convenient, easy-to-use solutions to save you time, and money
bluejetty:00182431:ios.description:
EasyPark has been making cities more livable since 2001. With millions of drivers, businesses, and operators using our services in more than 20 countries, we continue to develop convenient, easy-to-use solutions to save you time, and money and remove the unnecessary stress of car parking.
EasyPark is the nr. 1 parking app in Europe when it comes to coverage. With our mobile parking solution, you can pay for parking in a garage or find a parking spot in the street, in the city center or in the airport, at home or abroad - wherever life takes you! You can also charge your EV, and go even further.
Price: In most locations, we charge a service fee on top of the parking cost the operator charges. The total price and fee breakdown are shown in the EasyPark app when you set your end time and before you start to park, as well as in your parking receipt when the session has ended, so you are confident about how much you’re paying. Please see your local easypark.com site for more details.
With the EasyPark app, you can:
- Start your session from your mobile phone.
- Stop your session at any time, paying for the active time.
- Remotely extend your session if you need more time.
- Find parking near your location or destination before traveling.
- Charge your electric car with the same app.
- Pay for parking, whether privately or for work.
- Split your private and work-related parking or charging costs.
- Pay with secure methods such as Visa, Mastercard, ApplePay, or monthly invoices for business accounts.
- Get notified when your parking is close to expiration.
You can pay for parking and EV charging with the EasyPark app in: Rome, Madrid, Melbourne, Berlin, Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam, Stockholm, Helsinki and so many more!
Please note that the EasyPark app is unavailable in the United Kingdom. To park in the UK, please use the RingGo app instead.

bluejetty:00179769:ios.description:
MyTracks – GPS Tracker, Route Recorder & Navigation Tool
MyTracks is a professional GPS tracking app designed for hiking, running, walking, cycling, trekking, and outdoor navigation. It helps you accurately record routes, manage waypoints, and analyze location data using advanced GPS technology. Whether you are exploring trails, training outdoors, or recording travel routes, MyTracks provides precise tracking and reliable navigation support.
Key Features
1. GPS Route Tracking: Record your GPS tracks in real time and display your route on an interactive map. Suitable for hiking, running, cycling, walking, trekking, and skiing.
2. Save Favorite Locations: Save important places as favorites or waypoints for quick access anytime.
3. Import and Export Data: Supports GPX, KML, KMZ, and CSV formats for easy data sharing, backup, and analysis.
4. High Accuracy GPS Tools: Improve waypoint accuracy using static GPS observations for more precise tracking results.
5. Compass Navigation: Built-in compass provides waypoint direction guidance for easy navigation to selected locations.
6. Waypoint Management: Add custom waypoints manually or import from saved locations. Supports vector input using angle and distance.
7. Coordinate Conversion: Convert between Decimal, DMS, MGRS, and UTM coordinate formats instantly for mapping and field use.
8. Advanced Mapping Features: Includes MGRS grid overlay, route planning before tracking, and full track replay with detailed history.
9. Detailed Track Analytics: View distance, speed, elevation, and route statistics. Customize track colors for better visualization.
Important Notice: 
Continuous GPS usage in the background may significantly reduce battery life.
For feedback or questions, contact: miaozhi.ai@gmail.com

Save money effortlessly! Spendee is a FREE budgeting app already loved by almost 3.000.000 people around the world that track their spendings and optimize their budgets.
Seeing all your financial habits enables you to stick to your goals and be organized in what's important. Take responsibility and know exactly where your money goes. With Spendee, you can be your own money manager. It's that easy!
MAKE YOUR MONEY SHINE
• See All of Your Money in One Place
Connect Spendee with your online banking, E-Wallet (e.g. PayPal) or crypto-wallet (e.g. Coinbase) and see your wealth in one place.
• Organize & Analyze Your Expenses
We'll help you see your finances in the big picture! Imagine your data being automatically categorized, displayed in simple infographics, stylish graphs and clever insights that help you on your way to your dream savings and proper financial health!

Save money for categories you spend the most on by creating budgets and sticking to them! We'll notify you on your progress to make sure you are in green numbers and maintaining positive cash flow.

Embrace financial awareness. Let us become your best financial friend which proactively helps you to manage your personal finances and build a sustainable emergency fund. We're ready to give you tips & tricks to help you with your daily decision making.

• Budgets - to help you stick to your financial goals
• Wallets - organize your cash, bank accounts or different financial occasions
• AI Receipt Scanner (NEW) – scan your receipt and create a transaction in seconds (price, category, description, photo, and other details filled automatically)

• Multiple Currencies - to handle vacation finances with ease
• Labels - to mark and analyse transactions in more depth
• Dark Mode - to enjoy in eye friendly environment
• Web Version - to see your finances on a bigger screen
• Secure Data Sync - to keep your details private, confidential and safe
AWARD WINNING DESIGN
Starting with Spendee is easy thanks to its intuitive design. And the more you use it, the more valuable it gets, rewarding you with attractive charts that show you where your money is going, how you're doing compared to previous periods & much more. We believe in beautiful design - and thanks to that, we'll guide you to better financial decisions with ease.
Download Spendee now! Sync your bank account to be your own money manager & get ahead of your finances. It's easy, effective and enables you to save and plan for the future. 
Follow us on our social media @spendeeapp or email us at hello@spendee.com

bluejetty:00136887:ios.description:
Canela.TV es tu aplicación de televisión en español. Disfruta de una amplia variedad de entretenimiento para toda la familia y un programa de lealtad donde ganas puntos viendo tus shows favoritos. Disponible ¡SIEMPRE GRATIS!

Siempre es gratis, solo necesitas crear tu perfil e iniciar sesión para comenzar a ganar puntos desde la app de la TV, móvil o sitio web. Ganas 5 puntos por cada 5 minutos de contenido consecutivo. Mientras más veas e interactúes con Canela.TV, más puntos ganas.
SERIES ORIGINALES de todos los géneros, incluyendo Secretos de Villanas y Secretos de las Indomables, con la participación de estrellas icónicas de la televisión como Gaby Spanic, Laura Zapata, Cynthia Klitbo, Aylin Mujica, Sabine Moussier, Geraldine Bazán, Sarah Mintz, Yuri, Alicia Machado, Ninel Conde, Amara ‘La Negra’, Patricia Manterola y Zuleyka Rivera.
CANALES EN VIVO siempre disponibles y dedicados a diferentes géneros y entretenimiento, seguro encuentras un canal para ti.
PELÍCULAS Originales como Mi Perfecto Ex con Marjorie de Sousa y Mark Tacher; Cazadoras de Millonarios con Alicia Machado y Sherlyn. Clásicos del Cine de Oro como La Devoradora con María Félix; Me He de Comer Esa Tuna con Jorge Negrete; y Sor Tequila con La India María. Y lo mejor de Hollywood para todos los gustos: acción, comedia, romance, drama y más.
TELENOVELAS desde las que marcaron toda una época hasta los más recientes éxitos. Novelas Turcas como Hercai, Infieles, El Secreto de Feriha y Me Robó Mi Vida, y telenovelas latinas como: Mirada de Mujer, Gata Salvaje y Eva Luna.
CANELA MUSIC con videos musicales, shows originales, entrevistas y mixtapes seleccionados con los mejores videos de la música latina.

CANELA KIDS te ofrece contenido infantil y 100% en español. Disfruta shows originales como Plaza Aventuras, SúperEllas y StoryBook, además de éxitos donde los pequeños aprenden jugando, como Barbie Dreamtopia, El Mundo de Ryan, Hola Romi y Love Diana.
¿Qué puedes hacer dentro de Canela.TV?
- Disfrutar de todo el contenido disponible con acceso 100% gratuito.
- Filtrar contenido para encontrar justo lo que quieres ver.
- Recibir notificaciones personalizadas para seguir descubriendo más entretenimiento.
- Recibir recomendaciones personalizadas alineadas a tus gustos.
- Guardar tu contenido favorito.
- Recibir acceso anticipado a contenido exclusivo.
- Controlar el acceso a contenido que ven tus hijos.
- Si eres parte de Club Canela, podrás ganar puntos por ver tu contenido favorito, que puedes cambiar por contenido exclusivo, entradas a sorteos y nuevas sorpresas todo el tiempo; además podrás completar divertidos retos y trivias que te harán ganar puntos extras.
El mejor entretenimiento en español en un solo lugar. ¡Descarga la app ahora!
Canela.TV - Televisión gratis y en español

bluejetty:00046280:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the calming world of Woody Block Puzzle, a free and classic wood-style block puzzle game! Easy to pick up, this relaxing brain game offers a satisfying mental challenge. Perfect for unwinding or sharpening your logic and strategy skills.
How to Play the Relaxing Woody Block Puzzle:
STRATEGICALLY PLACE uniquely shaped wood blocks onto the grid.
- CLEAR LINES & COLUMNS by filling them completely to earn satisfying scores and free up space.
- SMART MOVE! Blocks can be ROTATED to fit those tricky gaps.
- EARN POINTS with every block placement and for each line or column you eliminate. Crush more blocks at once for a higher score!
The game ends when there's no more space – PLAN YOUR MOVES CAREFULLY!
Aim for the highest score and become the ultimate Woody Block Puzzle master!
Key Features of Woody Block Puzzle - Your Free Brain Game:
- COMPLETELY FREE TO PLAY: Enjoy endless hours of puzzle fun at no cost!
- PLAY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE: No Wi-Fi needed! Perfect for offline entertainment and brain training on the go.
- PURE PUZZLE BLISS: No time limits – relax, strategize, and enjoy this calming game.
- INTUITIVE GAMEPLAY: Simple rules make it easy for everyone to understand and enjoy this classic block puzzle.
- BEAUTIFUL WOODEN DESIGN: The natural wood aesthetic creates a soothing and immersive puzzle experience.
- EVER-EVOLVING CHALLENGES: Discover a constantly updating variety of classic and stimulating block shapes.
- SIMPLE, YET DEEPLY ADDICTIVE: You'll find yourself coming back for more woody puzzle action!
- TRACK YOUR PROGRESS: Game scores are automatically recorded. Can you beat your personal best in this engaging mind game?
Woody Block Puzzle: More Than Just a Game:
Woody Block Puzzle, also known as Woody Blocks, is a timeless classic that combines simple mechanics with engaging strategic depth. Every placement matters! Develop your spatial reasoning and planning skills as you strive for those high scores. Whether you're looking for a relaxing way to unwind or a stimulating brain exercise, Woody Block Puzzle offers the perfect blend of fun and challenge.
Download Woody Block Puzzle today and experience the satisfying crunch of the wood! Get your free puzzle game now!

bluejetty:00069319:ios.description:
If you like a good mahjong game, dominoes game, sudoku, or a challenging chess game, then you are in the right place! Mahjong Games is a challenging mobile puzzle game that will keep you captivated for hours. The game play is very simple. Mahjong Games uses mahjong tiles as puzzle pieces. The beautifully designed mahjong pieces will make it absolutely enjoyable to play while sitting in the bus, park, during work breaks or anywhere. The basic aim of the game is to pair two pieces without getting stuck.
How to play:
* Match all the mahjong tiles to complete a board.
* Save the baby birds stuck between the mahjong tiles!
* Collect shining golden acorn tiles!
Features:
* Easy to play but gets more challenging as you level up.
* Enjoy monthly adventure quests (and get new tile sets as a prize);
* Use powerful boosters if the level is a tough nut to crack!
* Collect various unique collection items from each chapter.
* Customize the adorable Baby Beans with lovely and charming outfits!
* Optimized for portrait mode.
* Beautiful graphics and rich sound effects.
Have fun playing Mahjong Games!
Thank you!

Just CrossStitch is the first magazine devoted exclusively to counted
bluejetty:00029835:ios.description:
30-DAY RISK-FREE TRIAL - Download and read the current issue for FREE for 30 days. Cancel within 30 days at no charge or do nothing and we'll begin your subscription.
Just CrossStitch is the first magazine devoted exclusively to counted cross-stitch and the only cross-stitch title written for the intermediate to advanced-level hobbyist. Your subscription includes six regular issues PLUS the popular Christmas Ornaments annual (a $9.99 value!) at no extra charge. Each issue contains a bonanza of easy-to-read, cross-stitch charts that would otherwise cost up to $60 if purchased separately. Lavish photography, easy-to-read charts, detailed instructions and complete materials lists round out this terrific cross-stitch value. Join us as we create timeless heirlooms that will be treasured for years to come!
----------------------------------------------
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues.
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest regular issue at the time of purchase.
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased.
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.
Users can register for/ login to a pocketmags account in-app. This will protect their issues in the case of a lost device and allow browsing of purchases on multiple platforms. Existing pocketmags users can retrieve their purchases by logging into their account.
We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved.
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags.
If you have any problems at all please do not hesitate to contact us: help@pocketmags.com
--------------------
You can find our privacy policy here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/privacy.aspx
You can find our terms and conditions here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/terms.aspx

bluejetty:00015805:ios.description:
Descubre Todotest, tu aliado para conquistar los exámenes teóricos de manejo en diferentes categorías. Nuestra plataforma ofrece exámenes auténticos para obtener las licencias de Clase B, A1, A2, C, D, E, así como los permisos profesionales como ADR, CAP de mercancías y viajeros, competencia profesional, consejero de seguridad y recuperación de puntos.
¿Qué hace a Todotest destacar?
1.Exámenes Reales
Prepara tu camino con exámenes cuidadosamente seleccionados que contienen las preguntas esenciales para aprobar las pruebas teóricas de Conaset, DMV o DGT. Nuestros exámenes reflejan fielmente el formato real, lo que te da una ventaja en el día de la prueba.
2.Explicaciones Detalladas
Acelera tu aprendizaje con las explicaciones de nuestros profesores. Opta por el modo de estudio y obtén explicaciones inmediatas después de responder cada pregunta, facilitando la comprensión de los conceptos clave.
3.Refuerzo Temático
Domina los temas esenciales con nuestros exámenes temáticos. Refuerza los contenidos del manual en las áreas que necesites, brindándote una preparación integral.
4.Registro de Preguntas Falladas
Aprende de tus errores con nuestra función de registro de preguntas falladas. Este servicio está disponible en todas las clases de permiso, permitiéndote fortalecer tu conocimiento y confianza.
Confía en la Experiencia:
Con más de 7 millones de alumnos exitosos, hemos allanado el camino hacia la obtención de licencias de conducir. Tanto si estás en Chile (Conaset), España (DGT), o Estados Unidos (DMV), Todotest está disponible para apoyarte en tu viaje de formación vial. Prepárate con total garantía y desbloquea un futuro lleno de oportunidades en la carretera.

bluejetty:00065760:ios.description:
NCIS: SHADOW STRIKE
Play as special agents from NCIS, the hit TV show, and investigate a shocking Navy ship explosion! 
Play a story-driven room escape game with unique puzzles enjoyed by tens of millions of players. Solve mysteries, puzzle through escape rooms, and find the clue that will crack the case in a critically acclaimed puzzle adventure game!
SOLVE A MURDER MYSTERY
Find clues and solve a murder mystery as Detective Kate Gray in On Thin Ice! A mysterious criminal has blackmailed the police station and a key witness was murdered. Investigate the crime scene, interrogate suspects, and solve the case. 
SURVIVE THE HORROR
Julian Torres is an ordinary boy in a sleepy town until a creepy serial killer known as Mirror Man tries to kill him. Julian must escape haunted houses, scary situations, and his own creepy memories. Who is Mirror Man? What can stop him? Can you help Julian survive? This is a scary puzzle game for adults!
PLAY AN EPIC STORY
Save a fantasy kingdom in Legend of the Sacred Stones! A mysterious curse has fallen over Tempus Island. Help Aila take control of the elements, escape brain teasing temples, and battle towering Stone Gods in this epic adventure!
SOLVE UNIQUE PUZZLES
Use your observation skills, deductive reasoning, and cunning to solve logic puzzles and brain teasers. Collect treasures and tools in your inventory, find clues and hidden objects, and relax and enjoy an escape room game.
ENTIRELY FREE
Play for free! You can support Haiku by purchasing a hint if you’re stuck, but you’re never forced to. And no - we don’t create impossible puzzles so you’re forced to pay. The escape rooms may be challenging but the puzzles are always solvable!
INSPIRED BY CLASSIC POINT AND CLICK GAMES
Adventure Escape takes the best of classic point and click adventure games that adults love and mixes it with the brain teasing gameplay of modern escape games. 
RAVE REVIEWS
Adventure Escape has been played by tens of millions of players and has a >4.5 star average rating. Game critics like AppPicker, TechWiser, and AppUnwrapper have picked Adventure Escape games as the best escape room game.
SUPPORT AN INDIE GAME COMPANY
We're an indie game studio that loves riddles, logic puzzles, and brain teasers. Our team has been to hundreds of escape rooms and participated in jigsaw puzzle competitions. At Haiku, we have a game design philosophy we call “satisfying challenge.” We think puzzles should be tough but solvable, so we spend a lot of time designing unique escape room gameplay that we think you'll love!
Website: www.haikugames.com
Facebook: www.facebook.com/adventureescape
Instagram: www.instagram.com/haikugamesco
KEY FEATURES
- Enjoy the entire escape game experience for free!
- Influence the story's direction with your choices.
- Engage in ingenious escape room gameplay
- Explore over 500 beautifully illustrated scenes.
- Encounter challenging puzzles for adults that tease your brain
- Seamlessly continue your progress across multiple devices.
- Regularly updated with more fun stories!
- Play offline by downloading chapters in advance! No wifi required.

bluejetty:00038107:ios.description:
GoTrack is the #1 GO Train app in the App Store with thousands of commuters relying on it every day. It's also the fastest way to get your GO Train schedule: no waiting, no searching – just open the app.
Key features:
• Speed: Instantly view your train schedule 10x faster than the official website.
• Delays and cancellations: Know at a glance and see real-time delays down to the minute.
• Platforms: See which platform your train will arrive on long before it's announced at the station.
• Notifications: Track individual trips and get notifications when they're delayed or cancelled.
• Widgets: Check your schedule at a glance without even opening the app.
• Simplicity: No search fields, no ads, and no learning curve.
Also:
• Live map: See all trains running on your line on a high-detail map of the entire train network.
• Advanced data: Stops en route, trip refund eligibility, number of cars on the train, whether the train is moving, and more.
• View your schedule in 12-hour or 24-hour time.
• Automatic dark mode support for late night rides.
• Easily share your trip with friends and family.
All new users can start with a no-commitment free trial. Cancel any time before the trial ends without charge. Continued use after the trial requires an active auto-renewing subscription. This service is compatible with Apple's Family Sharing feature: one subscription can provide access for the whole family.
Privacy policy and end user license agreement:
https://gotrackapp.ca/support/privacy-eula/

- See the sights on your terms. Book a car with justfly.com and avoid time restraints at attractions and locations
- Find a car rental in over 170 countries around the globe
