bluejetty:00019601:ios.description:
Are you ready to make your dreams come true and manage a Dinosaur park? 
Yes, you read well… Defy the limits of evolution and build your own Jurassic empire with 
real-life dinosaurs! Have you ever thought about looking after a T-Rex? Be in charge of the most famous leisure business and amaze dino lovers with your astonishing creatures! 
Learn from your experience and become rich thanks to being a worthy dinosaur park manager. Trace your growth strategy while keeping your dinos healthy and under control. Go on expeditions to find the rarest species on this magical island!
GET MULTIPLE SPECIES OF DINOSAURS: 
Improve your expedition team as long as you can reinvest your park earnings and find different dinosaurs like Allosaurus, Quetzalcoatlus, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Iguanodon, or even T-Rex! Numerous species are waiting for your explorers in the mysterious forest to be friendly captured. Bring them to your Dinosaur World, and take care of them!
RECREATE DIFFERENT HABITATS:
Dinosaurs demand specific attention according to their species. Unlock new enclosures and set them up to provide dinosaurs with the best possible environment! See all the areas with the proper natural vegetation, include as many water zones as they require, and, of course… Keep the visitors safe! Dinos are delicate creatures. Try to keep them nourished and happy. 
MEET THE NEEDS OF YOUR PARK VISITORS: 
“Spared no expense!” Open different services for your clients. A safe park will be a profitable park. Put your scientists to work on new research to enhance the visitor experience!
If you like management and idle games, you will enjoy Idle Dinosaur Park Tycoon! A casual easy-to-play game where strategic decisions have to be taken to manage a dinosaur-themed park with profitable results. Improve your facility starting from a modest enclosure for herbivore dinos and unlock visible progress in your premises. Transform your small project into the best leisure park and become the best Dino manager in the world!
Main Features: 
Casual and strategic gameplay for every player
Innovative exploration mode
Intuitive management system 
Dozens of objects to be unlocked and upgraded
Lots of detailed dinosaurs and interactions
Funny 3d graphics and great animations 
Management of a successful business
A small living world in miniature

bluejetty:00027001:ios.description:
Send digital greetings on the go with the Blue Mountain ecards app! This fun and engaging greeting card app lets you quickly search and send thousands of ecards for every holiday and occasion. Personalize digital cards — wherever, whenever and to whomever you like!
ECARD APP FEATURES
Download the Blue Mountain ecards app for FREE. If you’ve already signed up at BlueMountain.com, you’ll get ALL the best features of the app included with your subscription!
• Browse 1,000+ ecards, including SmashUps™ and Creatacards, for every holiday and occasion, including birthdays, anniversaries, Christmas, Valentine’s Day and Mother’s Day.
• Personalize your ecard with a special message — write your own or try our easy-to-use AI message generator!
• Add a digital gift card from a favorite retailer or restaurant and attach it to any ecard.
• Send ecards instantly via email, text or social media or schedule delivery in advance.
• Set up birthday and anniversary reminders to never miss an opportunity to celebrate.
• Stay organized with access to previously sent and received ecards.
• Unlock badges as you send ecards, organize your contacts, create reminders, and engage with your membership through our Peak Rewards loyalty program.
BROWSE 1,000+ DIGITAL GREETINGS
Ecards are greeting cards that come to life with animation and music. Upgrade your well-wishes with stunning, animated ecards and studio-quality video greetings designed to make them say, “Wow!” Enjoy Celebrity SmashUps™ featuring Rob Lowe and Kevin Bacon or create something special with Creatacard™ — customizable digital greeting cards where you can add your own photos, video, message and signature. With our easy-to-use greeting card app, you’ll have unlimited access to digital cards all year long, so you’ll never miss an opportunity to connect! Browse digital greetings for every holiday and occasion, including:
• Birthday ecards
• Anniversary ecards
• Christmas ecards
• Valentine’s Day ecards
• Mother’s Day ecards
• Father’s Day ecards
• Thank You ecards
• Get Well ecards
• Sympathy ecards
• Thinking of You ecards
• Congrats ecards
• Just because!
PERSONALIZE ECARDS QUICKLY AND EASILY
Personalize any digital greeting with your own message and photo for a thoughtful touch. Struggling to find the words? Let our AI Message Generator craft the perfect message for you by answering a few quick questions.
ADD DIGITAL GIFT CARDS FROM TOP BRANDS
Want to include a gift with your ecard? It’s easy to add a digital gift card. Explore popular retailers and restaurants, including:
• Target gift cards
• Starbucks gift cards
• Macy’s gift cards
• Sephora gift cards
• Buffalo Wild Wings gift cards
• And many more!
SEND ECARDS INSTANTLY
It’s safe and secure to send ecards through the Blue Mountain ecards app. Instantly send your digital greetings by email, text, messaging app, Facebook or other social networking sites. With email, you can schedule to send ecards up to one year in advance.
NEVER MISS A REASON TO CELEBRATE
When you add someone to your contacts, you can also set up automatic email reminders the day or week before their birthday or anniversary.
BECOME A MEMBER TODAY
Your subscription to Blue Mountain allows you to send an unlimited number of ecards to anyone, any time you want, as often as you want. As a member, you’ll get access to:
• 1,000+ ecards
• AI message generator
• Digital gift cards
• Birthday and anniversary reminders
• Peak Rewards Badges
Your payment will be charged to your account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account will be charged unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your account settings. 
Privacy Policy: https://www.bluemountain.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.bluemountain.com/legal

bluejetty:00150505:ios.description:
We are YYOGA, we believe that yoga is for everyone and every body, which is why, from beginner to advanced, all levels of practice are welcome in our studios.
In 2007, we set out to create a yoga community where everyone belonged. Using principles of yoga and mindfulness, we wanted to create places for people to feel inspired, connected, and welcome. Today, we have four studio locations across the greater Vancouver area: Downtown Flow, Kitsilano, Northshore Elements, and Richmond Olympic Oval.
Whether you’re looking for gentle, beginner- friendly classes or something more fiery and intense, we guarantee you’ll find your fit. Class styles include:
- Flow
- Power
- Hatha
- Gentle Hatha
- Hatha with Sound Bowls - Yin
- Yin & Meditation
- YHot
- YHot with Sound Bowls - YSculpt
- Pilates Fusion
Our official YYOGA app makes it easy for you to book a class, filter by your favourite studio or teacher, view your account history, view studio information, and get access to exclusive promotions.
We're so excited to welcome you to the community.

تطبيق العربية متوفر على الآيفون، الآيباد، أبل TV، ساعات أبل وأبل كاربلاي
أن تعرف أكثر: يعرض التطبيق آخر الأحداث العالمية وعناوين الأخبار اليومية والتحليلات من الوطن العربي وتركيا وأوروبا وأفريقيا وأمريكا اللاتينية وأستراليا وكندا والولايات المتحدة. قم بتنزيل التطبيق الآن للحصول على أهم الأخبار في شتى المجالات مثل: السياسة والصحة والمال والاقتصاد والطقس والرياضة والثقافة والتكنولوجيا وغيرها.
أخبار محلية: أخبار العالم العربي لحظة بلحظة، مع تغطية يومية شاملة لأخبار السعودية والإمارات ومصر وسوريا واليمن والعراق وليبيا ولبنان وفلسطين وغيرها من الدول في الخليج العربي والشرق الأوسط.
أخبار عالمية: ابق على اطلاع بكل ما هو جديد في أوروبا وأستراليا وروسيا وتركيا وكندا والولايات المتحدة.
أخبار موثوقة: مصدرك الموثوق للأخبار والتحليل الدقيق من جميع أنحاء العالم.
أخبار عاجلة: احصل على اشعارات للأخبار العاجلة، أهم الأحداث العربية والعالمية لحظة حدوثها.
لا تفوّت شيئاً: ابق مطلعاً على أهم الأخبار وشاهد البث المباشر وما فاتك من التقارير المصورة والبرامج.
يقدم التطبيق الخدمات التالية:
- اشعارات الأخبار العاجلة لأهم الأحداث العربية والعالمية لحظة حدوثها.
- شاهد البث المباشر لقناتي العربية والحدث مع خيار الاستماع للصوت.
- البحث: ابحث عن اي خبر او تقرير مصور مهتم به أو فاتك بضغطة واحدة
- شاهد ما فاتك من تقارير وفيديوهات وبرامج من مختلف أنحاء العالم في قسم العربية TV
- جرب وضع القراءة الخاص بنا بضوء أقل، واختر حجم الخط الذي يناسبك.
- شارك المحتوى على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي (فيسبوك، تويتر، واتساب..والمزيد)
- قم بتخصيص سمة الوضع الفاتح والداكن وفقًا لتفضيلاتك المرئية.
- ابق على اطلاع بأخبارك المحلية.
- يمكنك حفظ المقالات والأخبار لقراءتها لاحقًا.

bluejetty:00024244:ios.summary:

The Roon App is another controller for your Roon Server. You browse and play your music library on over 1,000 compatible audio devices, and provides a seamless in-home con
bluejetty:00024244:ios.description:
*** The Roon experience requires a Roon Server on your network. ***
The Roon App is another controller for your Roon Server. You browse and play your music library on over 1,000 compatible audio devices, and provides a seamless in-home connection. You can install the free Roon App on as many devices as you like.
What is Roon?
The very best way to experience your music:
Roon reshapes the way you browse and explore music. Powered by rich metadata, Roon's interface invites you on a new journey of musical discovery every time you log in.
Your music library becomes the starting point on a vast map of performers, composers, influences, and genres. Follow the path emanating from the music you love to discover exciting new sounds and reconnect with long-forgotten favorites. You can delve even deeper through lyrics, artist photos, bios, reviews, and tour dates - then continue the journey with recommendations specifically tailored to your tastes and listening habits.
Listen anywhere, on all your gear:
Roon lets you play from your collection of music files and TIDAL, Qobuz, and KKBOX libraries on thousands of Roon Ready, Airplay, Chromecast, and USB devices from one app inside your home. Meanwhile, Roon ARC provides access, playback, and precision audio control for your entire Roon music library directly from your phone, wherever you are in the world.
Flawless playback. Everywhere, every time:
Roon is built to ensure your music sounds perfect every time you hit play, no matter where you are. Roon guarantees the best possible sound quality from every piece of audio gear - our MUSE sound engine delivers bit-perfect playback, exhaustive format support, and precision audio control for a fully customizable and flawless listening experience. From headphones to your home hi-fi, and everything in between.

bluejetty:00081590:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00081590:ios.description:
► SHOW THEM WHAT YOU’RE MADE OF
What makes a real champion fighter? Natural talent and innate strength? Dedication and hours of training in the gym? The answer is no and no in this wild and crazy casual fighting game where you can put just about anything – including the kitchen sink – into the mixing pot, merge components animal and mineral into fearsomely cute mutant fighters, then send them out into the ring to do battle with other equally freaky cartoon monsters to see which blend of unlikely elements comes out on top. Have you got the recipe of a real champion? Maybe it needs an extra dash of cola or some added shark fins? Only time and tough battle will tell in this fun, freaky, action-packed fighting game.
◾ If you’ve got it, merge it: From fierce wild animals to ordinary household appliances, computer components to soda pop, garden implements to creatures of the deep, the range of ingredients you can match and blend to create a fearsome fighter is endless and unpredictable. How effective will toaster arms and a giraffe’s neck be in the heat of battle? There’s only one way to find out – merge them in the lab and send them off to wreak merry mayhem on the battlefield!
◾ Build a freaking army: Progress through the game by steadily building up your stock of mutant fighters and picking the best for each match. Whether you’re facing opponents one-on-one or fighting in wild team brawls, level up your existing army or merge new champions from crazy components and send them into action until you’ve built the ultimate battle-hardened mutant army. Balance your team and level up each character to ensure you can meet the toughest combat challenges.
◾ Freaking adorable: Your fighters may be patched together from the most disparate of junk elements, but they’re still by far the cutest mutants on the block thanks to Merge Anything’s fun and stylish cartoon graphics, which give each hero a uniquely adorable appearance. Plus there’s a really funky soundtrack to keep them dancing around the ring and ensure all the action is always spectacular.
► A WHOLE NEW KIND OF RECYCLING
If you’ve been looking for a fighting game that brings something really new and unusual to the mix, that’s fast and frantic but also heaps of fun, that’s unpredictable and exciting but also adorably cute, then Merge Anything could be just the game you’ve been waiting for. Download Merge Anything right now, unleash your inner mad scientist, throw everything into the pot and head into battle for hours of crazy action and adventure.

bluejetty:00128793:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
SKIDOS Sketch & Stretch is an educational build & design game for kids aged 8-11. Use all kinds of shapes and colors to create your own designs from scratch or continue building a house, a robot, a city, and much more. Get creative and design masterpieces!
Features: 
- Choose between 12 different designs 
- 12 different colors and 9 different shapes
- Drag and stretch objects to different sizes and forms
- Infinite possibilities in creating your own designs 
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00081666:ios.description:
Next generation of the Invidyo camera is finally here. 
You can use the Invidyo camera to keep an eye on your baby while you are away. If you have a baby sitter, you can monitor the moments when they are taking care of the baby and have peace of mind.
-Invidyo camera automatically detects motion, sound and human faces in the video feed and records these events to the cloud. You receive a mobile notification when these events occur and can watch the recordings of the events anytime. 
-Invidyo camera captures high quality HD video and sound. It has 130 degrees field of view, one camera is enough to see the entire room.
-Invidyo camera includes a temperature sensor so that you can monitor your babies environment and make sure that everything is OK. 
-Invidyo supports two way audio functionality, you can speak to our mobile app and your baby will hear your voice from the camera. 
Invidyo camera has excellent night vision and support wireless and wired connections.
Invidyo camera can also be used from home security, elderly monitoring and pet monitoring.

bluejetty:00017976:ios.description:
YOUR FAMILY. IN SYNC.
Greenlight is a family technology subscription that connects money, safety, and everyday life into one experience.
MONEY
- Send & receive money fast. Set up direct deposit.
- Kids & teens debit card¹ with parent controls, real-time notifications, and spending limits
- Set savings goals & earn up to 6% in rewards²
- Track chores, put allowance on autopilot
- Kids & teens learn to invest with parent approval on every trade
- Play Greenlight Level UpⓇ, the financial literacy game built by education experts
SAFETY
- Skip the "did you get there?" text with family location sharing with place alerts⁴
- SOS alerts, crash detection, & driving reports keep everyone looked out for⁴
- No phone required: the Safe Family device tracks kids, seniors, or pets with GPS, place alerts, and a double-tap SOS button⁸
ORGANIZATION — NEW: GREENLIGHT FAMILY HUB
- One home base for calendars, chores, lists, and photos
- "Hey Greenlight," a family-safe AI assistant that helps hands-free
- Add the safety map, place alerts, and voice-powered smart assistant with Family Hub+
PROTECTION
- Purchase, identity theft & cell phone protection³ for the family
- Account monitoring & suspicious activity alerts⁵ so scams and fraud get caught early
- Protect senior loved ones⁷ with up to $1M identity theft coverage⁶ and up to $100K deceptive transfer fraud coverage⁶
- Optional debit card for senior loved ones⁷
Trusted by the New York Times and Parents Magazine, plus 6.5M family members.
PLANS FOR EVERY FAMILY.
- Core: Debit card and educational app for kids and teens to earn, save, spend, and give — plus 2% on savings² ($5.99/month)
- Max: All of Core with 1% cash back, 3% on savings², protection plans³, and investing ($9.98/month)
- Infinity: All of Max with 5% on savings², location sharing, crash detection⁴, SOS alerts, and driving reports ($14.98/month)
- Family Shield: All of Infinity with 6% on savings² and financial protection for seniors ($24.98/month)
- Family Hub Free: Calendar, chores, lists, and photos on your existing plan
- Family Hub+: Everything in Free, plus safety map with place alerts and the family AI assistant ($9.99/month or $99/year)
24/7 SUPPORT. Get help & ask questions: https://help.greenlight.com
Your California Privacy Rights: https://greenlight.com/privacy#your-california-privacy-rights Do Not Sell My Information: https://greenlight.com/data-request/
Disclosures
(1) The Greenlight app facilitates banking services through Community Federal Savings Bank, Member FDIC. The Greenlight card is issued by Community Federal Savings Bank, Member FDIC, pursuant to license by Mastercard International.
(2) To qualify, the Primary Account must be in Good Standing and have a verified ACH funding account. See Greenlight Terms of Service for details. Subject to change at any time.
(3) Provided by Virginia Surety Company, Inc.; cell phone protection is not available to residents of New York.
(4) Available on Greenlight Infinity and Family Shield plans. Requires mobile data or a WiFi connection, and access to sensory and motion data from cell phone to utilize family location sharing, SOS alerts & crash detection features. Messaging & data rates and other terms may apply.
(5) Premium monitoring services are offered by Experian.
(6) Insurance offered by Acrisure, LLC is provided by ACE American Insurance Company and its U.S.-based Chubb underwriting company affiliates. Additional details can be viewed here. See here for policy information. Insurance products are not insured by the FDIC or any federal government agency and are not a deposit or other obligation of, or guaranteed by, any bank or bank affiliate.
(7) Loved ones refers to covered family members as defined in the policy, i.e. supported adults for whom you control or assist with their finances.
(8) The Greenlight Safe Family device requires the purchase of a Safe Family device and a monthly GPS data plan. See terms for more details.

bluejetty:00029928:ios.name: Begone: Spam Call Blocker
bluejetty:00029928:ios.summary: Begone is a productivity app for iOS. It lets you block individual numbers or number ranges quickly and effortlessly. It can also act as a private directory for people or companies that you don’t want to add to your contacts but want to ide
bluejetty:00029928:ios.description:
Begone is a productivity app for iOS. It lets you block individual numbers or number ranges quickly and effortlessly. It can also act as a private directory for people or companies that you don’t want to add to your contacts but want to identify when called by.
Begone uses a simple wildcard character mechanism to add numbers into its database. You can use the # character as the wildcard. For example, when you enter +1 212-555-#### to its block list, Begone blocks the numbers from +1 212-555-0000 to +1 212-555-9999. bluejetty:00149392:ios.description:
Buy, sell, or own with confidence. Access to millions of listings and tools help you succeed at any stage of your real estate journey. 
HOME BUYERS
With customized search capabilities, you can browse over 1 million active listings directly from the MLS, the largest property database in the United States. Save a search and favorite homes and we’ll update you via push notifications of any updates matching your criteria. You’ll never miss a home that might be the right fit.
HOME SELLERS
See how much your home is worth with our home value estimator. Get access to articles to answer all your selling questions, and when you are ready, we can connect you with a local real estate agent who can make sure you maximize your sale price. 
HOME OWNERS
Everything you need to manage your home in one place. Clearly track your home value and your equity over time. Get maintenance recommendations and get connected with home pros in your area. We will even update you on what is happening around you such as which of your neighbors are listing their home. 
MATCH WITH AN AGENT
When you’re ready, we’ll carefully match you with a top-rated agent that can guide you through every step from viewing a property to closing on your new home. Along the way, we’ll also connect you with other industry experts, giving you all the benefits of a real estate search tool and access to vetted pros, all from your phone. 
Even more…
* Discover homes for sale and get updates on properties near your location — anytime, anywhere.
* Interactive maps show nearby schools, business, amenities, and points of interests, giving you more insight into areas you like.
* Detailed search filters go beyond price, size, and location. Narrow down property listings by days on market, HOA fees, and other features that are important to you.
* View upcoming open houses and save the dates directly to your personal calendar.
* Access everything in your app on the Movoto desktop experience as well. Your preferences are saved and tracked across your profile, so whether you’re on your phone or computer you can keep your search going.
Become a real estate expert with Movoto!

bluejetty:00100392:ios.description:
Medical AI is a subscription-based clinical reference app designed for licensed healthcare professionals.
A paid subscription is required to access all features of Medical AI. Monthly and yearly auto-renewable subscriptions are available, each with a 7-day free trial for new users. There is no free functionality beyond the trial period.
Medical AI provides evidence-based clinical information supported by citations from peer-reviewed journals, clinical guidelines, FDA resources, and trusted medical databases. Every response includes references so users can independently verify the source material.
## Subscription Required Features
With an active subscription, Medical AI provides access to:
- Evidence-based clinical answers with citations
- Current clinical guidelines from major medical societies including ACC, AHA, IDSA, and NCCN
- Drug information including FDA-approved indications, dosing, interactions, and contraindications
- Differential diagnosis support with structured clinical reasoning
- Coverage across multiple medical specialties
- Clinical summaries for point-of-care reference
- Support for medical board exam preparation including USMLE, PANCE, and NCLEX
## Intended Use
Medical AI is intended exclusively for licensed healthcare professionals, including physicians, residents, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and medical students in clinical training.
This app is an educational and clinical reference tool only. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment and does not replace professional medical judgment. Users must independently verify all information using appropriate professional resources.
## Reliability and Data Handling
- Content is updated regularly to reflect current medical evidence
- All responses include transparent source citations
- No patient data is stored
- Designed with HIPAA-conscious principles
## Subscription Information
- Monthly and yearly auto-renewable subscriptions
- 7-day free trial for new users
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Manage or cancel subscriptions in Apple ID Account Settings
## Legal
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
## Disclaimer
Medical AI is a clinical reference and educational tool. It is not intended for patient diagnosis or treatment. Always use professional clinical judgment.

bluejetty:00040382:ios.description:
-- Stay Ahead of the Weather with the Ultimate Weather App --
Turn your iPhone into a powerful weather station and experience the most reliable way to stay updated on current and upcoming weather conditions. This all-in-one weather companion offers real-time weather updates, detailed forecasts, and essential environmental data to help you plan your day with confidence.
With an intuitive interface and accurate weather reporting, the app delivers comprehensive insights you can trust. Whether you're heading out for a walk, planning a weekend trip, or just checking if it’s going to rain, everything you need is right at your fingertips.
Get precise temperature readings in Celsius, Fahrenheit, or Kelvin, updated in real time. Stay one step ahead with a full 7-day forecast, including daily and hourly breakdowns. You’ll know exactly what to expect from sunrise to sunset and beyond.
Humidity monitoring helps you understand moisture levels throughout the day, which can be crucial for staying comfortable or managing health conditions. Wind speed and direction updates ensure you're always informed before stepping outside, especially when planning outdoor activities like cycling, hiking, or sailing.
Track air pressure changes to better understand shifting weather patterns. For those who enjoy early morning walks or evening outings, the app also includes daily sunrise and sunset times. Planning becomes easier when you know how much daylight you’ll have.
Outdoor explorers and travelers will appreciate the built-in compass for accurate navigation, along with visibility reports that help you make safe travel decisions. Real-time visibility updates are especially useful during fog, storms, or low-light conditions.
Health-conscious users can stay informed with the Air Quality Index (AQI) feature, which lets you monitor pollution levels and make safer choices about when to be outdoors. For those who live near the coast or enjoy activities like boating and fishing, marine weather updates provide specialized insights tailored to water conditions.
Here’s what makes this app stand out:
- Accurate and reliable data powered by advanced weather algorithms
- User-friendly design with simple navigation and fast access to forecasts
- Customizable measurement units so you can view data your way
- Strong commitment to user privacy and security
** Frequently Asked Questions **
Is this app compatible with all iOS devices?
Yes, the app is fully optimized for smooth performance across all iPhones.
How accurate is the weather data?
The app collects data from trusted meteorological sources to ensure accuracy in all forecasts.
Can I track weather in different cities?
Yes, you can add and monitor multiple locations around the world at the same time.
This app is designed for those who like to be prepared. Whether you’re keeping an eye on the forecast for your hometown or checking conditions for an upcoming trip, it provides the tools you need to make better decisions every day.
-- Subscription Information --
Outdoor Temperature Forecast offers a subscription plan with added benefits. With a subscription, you can view temperature in multiple measuring units, track an unlimited number of cities, and enjoy the app without any advertisements.
Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at the time of purchase
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period
You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime by going to your Account Settings after purchase
This subscription ensures uninterrupted access to advanced features, expanded tracking, and an ad-free experience.

Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/livetemperatureios/privacy/

bluejetty:00063283:ios.name: Dracula , Frankenstein & Co
bluejetty:00063283:ios.summary: Once upon a time a little village, full of uncontrollable human people, decide to give a final assault to the most iconic monsters of all time : Dracula, Frankenstein, werewolf and the mummy. Play as one of the most famous creatures of all
bluejetty:00063283:ios.description:
Once upon a time a little village, full of uncontrollable human people, decide to give a final assault to the most iconic monsters of all time : Dracula, Frankenstein, werewolf and the mummy. Play as one of the most famous creatures of all time and stop this slaying rampage from the villagers. In this fantasy land, try to save the monsters from death, fight against the foes, beat their BOSS, and beat them up all...
DRACULA, FRANKENSTEIN & CO VS THE VILLAGERS is an arcade and action game with retro pixel art style. If you like platformer games and "Beatem all" games, you will love this game.
You have tons of weapons, potions, spells and much more to play with your phantasy monsters.
On your journey you will travel through numerous places around the village and you will encounter dozens of different villagers and their bosses that will try to kill you. 
Can you save the epic heroes from death ? Only the most worthy adventurers will be able to complete this task . Are you ready for some slaying ? 
• Arcade & action RPG 
• Fun and challenging game 
• 4 unique playable creatures: Dracula, Frankenstein, werewolf and the mummy. 
• Pixel perfect / retro graphics style
• Tons of loot: weapons, armor, spells... 
• Fight knights, peasants, soldier... and their bosses 
• up to 400 levels 
• 5 games mode for each level : kill X foes, survive x seconds, reach the flag, kidnapp the pincess, Guard the princess. 
• "Toccata En Fugue" as music of the game

bluejetty:00024319:ios.name: Meteum: weather radar・forecast
bluejetty:00024319:ios.summary:
Meteum provides accurate hyperlocal weather forecasts, alerts and interactive weather radar information in real time.
Powered by the AI technology, Meteum integrates surface observations provided by
thousands of automated weather stations
bluejetty:00024319:ios.description:
Meteum provides accurate hyperlocal weather forecasts, alerts and interactive weather radar information in real time.
Powered by the AI technology, Meteum integrates surface observations provided by
thousands of automated weather stations around the world, alongside data from radars and satellites. It also relies on current weather reports from the service users, which bring the quality of live weather forecasts to a new level.
Meteum users can:
— View weather forecast for today, tomorrow or the whole week ahead – for a city, city district, metro station area, or even specific street address
— Watch the rain or snow patterns on a weather radar map in real time and track their trajectories in the next ten, thirty or ninety minutes
— Choose favorite locations for tracking the local weather and easily switch between them
— Receive alerts about sudden weather changes, such as cold snaps, thaws, or rain showers
— Place a customizable weather widget on their home screen or notification bar to always stay in-the-know about the weather and plan ahead
— Quickly verify current weather reports submitted by other Meteum users through a clear and simple user interface

bluejetty:00132190:ios.description:
Hardcore Hack’n Slash Action-RPG.
The must try game for any real hack and slash fan who already got bored with just mindlessly smashing buttons on the screen.
Shadow hunter is an action-packed dark fantasy hack and slash game with an incredible combat system and awesome boss fights, assisted by a one of a kind character control mechanism and a perfect mix of RPG elements to make your adventure super immersive.
A DARKENED, RUINED AND FULL OF SUFFERING SHADOW WORLD
As the mortal world got invaded and destroyed by the horde of dark demons and shadow monsters, everything was covered in the darkness of hell and the constant insufferable noises that were the combination of the endless scream from those evils and the crying and mourning of the lucky few that manage to survive through this nightmare.
The player will be a Shadow Hunter in this world, which is someone who got blessed by the Ancient One with a special power to fight off those dark demons. 
Through countless battles and obstacles, shadow hunters are destined to bring the light back to this mortal world.
EPIC BOSS FIGHT
Shadow Hunter's most exciting moments must be it's epic boss battle, in which the Hunters must defeat dark giant demons to collect their souls and advance to the darkest dungeon and the highest floor of the evil tower. 
Without a decent set of equipment and highly trained techniques, any player could easily get wrecked by those big bosses. 
However, the incredible feelings that players get from successfully overcoming those challenges will make it all worth it. 
Furthermore, those dark demon souls are the key to upgrade hundreds of shadow equipment and weapons, turning them from just a common warrior sword to a legendary hero's blade that would be worshiped by the generations to come.
MULTIPLE CHARACTERS TO PLAY AND ROLL
Players will get to play as multiple different characters, each has its own unique skills, gameplay and assets. Each character is going to be a distinct way to play the game, a distinct approach to the strategy and the combat.
KEY FEATURES
Intense hack and slash combat.
Epic Boss Fights.
Multiple characters to play.
Hundreds of equipment and weapons to loot and upgrade.
4+ PVE modes and PVP.
Play anytime, anywhere even when offline.
Visit Here to Learn More About Shadow Hunter:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SHLostWorld
Twitter: https://twitter.com/shlostworld

bluejetty:00131744:ios.name: Xavion
bluejetty:00131744:ios.summary: In flight, Xavion constantly imagines engine-failed glides to every runway in gliding range, and then shows you the safest-possible route as a Highway-In-The-Sky to take to an airport in the event of engine failure. This, finally, gives you
bluejetty:00131744:ios.description:
In flight, Xavion constantly imagines engine-failed glides to every runway in gliding range, and then shows you the safest-possible route as a Highway-In-The-Sky to take to an airport in the event of engine failure. This, finally, gives you guidance after an engine failure that is based on energy-management all the way down. Xavion also has instrument approaches in 3-D for the United States, so you can simply select any approach and then fly through the hoops to fly it!
As well, Xavion tracks other airplanes via ADS-B, and memorizes their location to track their WAKE TURBULENCE, moving the wake turbulence down and with the wind over time, showing the wake turbulence as little spiraling tornados. Finally, an App that tracks and shows you the wake turbulence of other airplanes.
As well, Xavion gets ADS-B weather if you have a portable receiver, and displays it, including the new icing, turbulence, and lightning products. Xavion also gets METARS and winds aloft from the internet if you have a WIFI or cell signal to help you plan before a flight!
Also, Xavion checks your weight and balance, and even estimates your takeoff distance and compares that to the length of the runway that you are about to take off on to warn you if the available runway length from your current location is marginal for a safe take-off.
Also, Xavion estimates time and fuel burn at all different altitudes to any destination, showing you the time and fuel burn required for each altitude enroute, so you can pick the best altitude.
All USA VFR and IFR charts and plates are included with base subscription.
Terms of use and Privacy Policy can be found at:
http://xavion.com/xavion-privacy-policy-and-terms-of-service/
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00178542:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00178542:ios.description:
The NFC Tap iOS App leverages on the NFC core feature of iOS supporting the read an write of NFC 
tags from iPhone 7 and later devices. It gives users a new experience based on the tag's NDEF content, making it easier and faster to perform recorded actions as described below. 
Main Features:
• Support every STMicroelectronics ST25 Type5 & Type4A series tags.
• App Clip based on URL https://www.myst25.com/clip
• Read/Write user memory for Type5 tags. This allows user to read, write or update the content of any Type5 tags.
• ISO15693/NFC Type5 commands list User Interface. This allows user to manage all ISO15693 commands.
• ISO15693/NFC Type5 custom commands list User Interface
• Fast Transfer Mode using STMicroelectronics ST25DV-I2C and ST25DVC tags.
• PWM Control user interface for STMicroelectronics ST25DV-PWM tags.
• Read/Write any kinds of NDEF Messages, NFC Forum compliant (URL, Text, SMS, email, Call, Map, VCard, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi®, Mime and Externals)
• Universal Link with URL : https://www.myst25.com
• Custom App URL Scheme “nfctap://”:
 - This allows user to open our iOS app from any other iOS app or from the safari browser using the custom URL scheme “nfctap://”
In Details, the App features several functions enabled by the NFC tag content:
- Connect to Wifi devices identified by its SSID, Key password and encryption type.
- Connect to Bluetooth devices: Facilitates the pairing with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. After tapping a tag with the phone, the NFC Tap iOS App will recognize any Bluetooth pairing NDEF record and connect the phone directly to the specified device.
- Open a URL in a browser: Opens a web page to the URL contained in the tag's NDEF record.
- Get contact information: Displays and saves contact information (including ID picture) by tapping a tag containing a business card(vCard) message.
- Geolocalize a position: Opens Apple Maps to the GPS location stored in the tag being tapped.
- Initiate an SMS or Email: Opens the relevant email or SMS application with information contained in the tag being tapped. The user can then choose to send the email/SMS or edit it before sending. Use cases include, but are not limited to, customer service information for warranty or loyalty programs.
- Initiate a phone call: Opens the phone service to the number contained in the tag's NDEF message.
- Read a Text: Displays the text message contained in the tag being tapped.
- Mime NDEF exemples: MimeType = application/pdf / MimeData = userManual.pdf
- External NDEF exemples: application = video ; type = mpeg ; Data = video.mov
Additionally, the NFC Tap App application include Bluetooth pairing with a ST25DV discovery board.

bluejetty:00133501:ios.name: BoardVitals Medical Exam Prep
bluejetty:00133501:ios.summary: BoardVitals offers board-style practice questions for more than 50 board exams and medical specialties. Study effectively with high-yield questions that are accompanied by detailed explanations and rationales for correct and incorrect answe
bluejetty:00133501:ios.description:
BoardVitals offers board-style practice questions for more than 50 board exams and medical specialties. Study effectively with high-yield questions that are accompanied by detailed explanations and rationales for correct and incorrect answers. All questions are written and reviewed by physicians and clinicians who’ve recently taken the board exams.
Brought to you by BoardVitals, a brand you know and trust for up-to-date quality content, you can now access your test prep from wherever you are with your mobile device.
Whether you have 10 minutes between classes, on rounds, on a commute, or you’ve blocked off bigger chunks of time to focus on practice questions, we’ve got you covered. 
OFFLINE ACCESS
The content on the BoardVitals Mobile App is available anywhere. Download your custom quizzes with offline access and study with or without an internet connection. 
PRACTICE WITH CONFIDENCE USING TOP TOOLS
With similar testing features to the ones you’ll have access to on the exam, you can nip some of your test anxiety in the bud. 
Highlight key passages of the question
Strikeout answer choices to eliminate distractors
Mark a question to come back to it later
Make a note for yourself for a specific question
QUESTION FORMATS
Half the battle of mastering your score, is mastering the format of your exams. Taking practice questions in the same format you’ll see on the exam is critical to your success. These question banks include the following testing formats:
Multiple Choice
Select All That Apply (SATA)
Graphic Items
Hot Spot Items
Fill in the Blank Calculation
Audio Questions
Exhibit Questions
As you create your custom practice quizzes, you will see a mix of these question types, just as you would see on the exam for which you’re preparing. 
QUIZ MODES
Further customize your quizzes by choosing from three quiz types:
STUDY MODE
Study mode is similar to an open book quiz without a time limit. In this quiz environment, you can read the explanations as you go and practice at your own pace. 
TEST (UNTIMED) MODE
Test (Untimed) Mode is like taking a closed book quiz without the pressure of a time limit. Answers and explanations are not available during the quiz.
TEST (TIMED) MODE 
To quasi-simulate the pressure of a test environment, Test (Timed) Mode allows you to study without revealing the correct answers and explanations until the quiz has been completed. 
NCLEX® CAT TESTING MODE
For NCLEX® students, you can choose to practice in a Computer Adaptive Test mode (CAT). Computer adaptive testing adjusts to your abilities - providing you with either an easier or harder question depending on how you answered the previous question. 
DETAILED ANALYTICS
ANSWER RESPONSE TIME
Oftentimes we know the answer, but it can take us too long to recall it. With built-in analytics to evaluate your answer response time, you can see if you’re on the right track to completing your board exam in the allotted time frame. 
Analytics cover your average response time based on individual questions, averages by subject, and averages by quiz.
PEER RANK
Individual performance scores are important, but only give you part of the story. Our Peer Rank metric shows how you compare with others answering the same questions so you can see how you're ranking compared to your peers studying for the same exam.
Our comprehensive evidence-based explanations are now augmented with Peer Comparisons so you can see exactly how other users answered the same question with percentages for each answer choice. 
MONITOR YOUR PROGRESS
Your competency changes as you study. Your dashboard will feature a visual representation of your performance over time. Identifying growth or plateaus can help you target trouble areas and maximize your study time.

bluejetty:00061564:ios.description:
The PrimeStreet System
CONNECTING TO THE RIGHT CLIENTS
Sales is a numbers game- the challenge is sifting through all the dead-end leads quickly to find those who are ready to go. PrimeStreet qualifies buyer and seller inquiries, introducing only transaction-ready referrals to agents.
NURTURING
Buyers often need time to get their credit in order, save for a down payment, or wait for their current lease to expire. Historically, these consumers fall through the cracks while agents focus on people who are closer to transacting. The PrimeStreet system nurtures prospects until they’re ready and then connects the referral to the agent to be closed.
LIVE TRANSFER
Once a buyer or seller is ready to transact, PrimeStreet ranks available agents and then invites agents to accept the referral via an app notification. After an agent accepts the referral, an introduction is made from our call center and we coordinate a warm handoff to create trust with the buyer or seller.
Privacy Policy: https://primestreet.io/about-primestreet/privacy-policy

Extract audio from videos with one tap, preserving clear sound quality, and save it as MP3, AAC, and other common formats.
A professional audio editing tool that makes it easy to:
- Trim audio: cut any segment
- Merge audio: combine multiple tracks
- Adjust volume: control levels freely
- Fade in/out: create smooth transitions
- Convert formats: freely convert between MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, and more
Whether you're extracting background audio from a video, editing audio clips, or converting formats, AudioSnap helps you get it done fast.
Simple to use, ready in 3 seconds, no ads to interrupt you.

bluejetty:00138742:ios.description:
PixelLab is a Drip & Text on Photo app that is the ultimate photo editor and collage maker for your creative needs. You can easily add stunning drip effects, text on photo, quotes, stickers, and a background eraser.
PixelLab is your ultimate tool for creative photo editing. This all-in-one photo editor lets you add text, filters, and effects with ease. Enjoy powerful tools like a background eraser and collage maker. Whether you’re into photo editing, need a fun photo editor, or love using a collage maker, PixelLab has you covered. 
• Drip Effect: Add cool drip effects to your photos with different styles and colors. You can also adjust the drip size and direction for a unique look.
• Text On Photo: Add text on photo with PixelLab's powerful text editor. You can write quotes, captions, slogans, or anything you want on your photos. You can also choose from a variety of fonts, sizes, colors, and shadows to make your text stand out.
• Background Eraser: Erase the background from your photos with PixelLab's AI-powered background eraser. You can remove any unwanted background with a simple swipe and replace it with a new one. You can also use the background eraser to make transparent PNG images.
• Collage Maker: Create stunning collages with PixelLab's collage maker. You can choose from many collage templates or make your own with the grid layout. You can also add text, stickers, and neon spiral magic to your collages.
• Stickers: Add fun and expressive stickers to your photos with PixelLab. You can choose from a huge collection of stickers, text art, and tattoos. You can also resize, rotate, and flip the stickers as you like.
• Neon Spiral Magic: Add mesmerizing neon spiral effects to your photos with PixelLab. You can choose from a wide range of spiral patterns and customize them. You can also use the neon spiral magic on your collages for a dazzling effect.
• Photo Editor: Edit your photos like a pro with PixelLab's photo editor. You can crop, rotate, flip, and adjust your photos with ease. You can also apply filters, effects, and frames to your photos for a professional touch.
• HD Quality: Save and share your photos in HD quality with PixelLab. You can also adjust the resolution and quality of your photos before saving them. And much more!

• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Start your next adventure by downloading the NovelFlow app today!
Why Choose NovelFlow?
Massive Library: Over 500,000+ titles featuring trending novels and fanfiction.
Listen Anywhere: High-quality audiobooks for a hands-free experience.
No Wi-Fi? No Problem: Download entire books to read offline with zero data usage.
Daily Updates: Fresh chapters delivered daily—never wait long for a cliffhanger.
Diverse Book Genres
NovelFlow contains a vast array of genres designed to satisfy every craving. From heart-pounding Werewolf and Billionaire romances to immersive Fantasy and Sci-Fi worlds, our collection is deeply loved by our global community.
Find your favorite story on NovelFlow and start reading without delay!

Customize Your Reading Style

Support Our Authors

Ad-Free Subscription: You can choose to upgrade for a seamless, ad-free experience. This is a direct way to support your favorite writers and help them obtain a stable income to continue their creative work.

bluejetty:00073625:ios.summary:
Welcome to Autotrader – your ultimate car buying solution. With thousands of dealers and private sellers in our network and millions of cars to choose from, you can seamlessly find cars in your price range in just a few clicks. 
FIND THE R
bluejetty:00073625:ios.description:
Welcome to Autotrader – your ultimate car buying solution. With thousands of dealers and private sellers in our network and millions of cars to choose from, you can seamlessly find cars in your price range in just a few clicks. 
FIND THE RIGHT CAR FOR YOU
- Guarantee that the car price is fair with Kelley Blue Book® Price Advisor on every Autotrader Dealer listing. 
- Estimate your future car payment.
- Access comprehensive car buying and selling tips.
- Get vehicle pricing and discover seller discounts.
- See car safety information and vehicle reports.
- View our competitive financing options.
- Explore the best deals on new and used cars or trucks near you.
- Browse detailed listings and comprehensive vehicle history reports so that you can purchase vehicles with confidence.
With millions of cars to choose from you are sure to find your perfect ride. Download today to buy your next car!
AUTOTRADER APP FEATURES:
BUY NEW AND USED CARS
- Be as specific as you need and let our AI powered search filters do the work for a seamless car shopping experience.
- Create a free "My Autotrader" account to add your favorite cars and searches to your watchlist.
- Pick up where you left off while car shopping in-app or online.
- Get recommendations based on features you care about. 
- Search by keyword to find specific cars near you that meet your needs.
- Sign up for alerts on price drops and get notified when new listings that match your search criteria are added. 
- Find the best deal as you buy cars: Look for the Good Price or Great Price green badge in the top right corner of the listing.
- Can't find it today? Add a search criteria and we will let you know when vehicles that meet your criteria are added to our list of vehicles.
- Get Vehicle History Reports (when available) along your search. 
- Delivery door feature: Vehicles can be shipped to your front door. 
CAR SHOPPING EXPERIENCE
- Share cars with friends and family via email or text.
- Contact a seller by phone, text, or email directly from a vehicle listing.
- Schedule test drives right from the app.
- Find vehicles in your budget and know what you’ll pay before you buy.
- Receive personalized recommendations.
Our mission at Autotrader is to be your ultimate online solution for buying and selling new, certified and used cars. For classic cars (1990 and older), please visit Autotrader Classics at https://classics.autotrader.com/

bluejetty:00184162:ios.description:
With 20,000 real user reviews and a 4.8 rating, CROSS is the essential financial app for foreigners in Korea!
CROSS is now better than ever. With just one CROSSPAY card, you can handle overseas remittances, domestic transfers, offline payments, and public transportation—all in one place.
For everyday life in Korea, CROSS is the must-have app for foreigners! Check it out now.
*Some features may be limited depending on nationality, country of residence, identity verification results, or applicable laws and regulations.
[NEW] Make life in Korea easier with the CROSSPAY Prepaid Wallet Card
Meet CROSSPAY, a prepaid card made for foreigners in Korea that’s easy and quick to issue. Simply top up and start using it right away.
Domestic Transfers: Receive money from friends or colleagues and transfer it directly to a domestic bank account.
Offline Payments: Use your prepaid card for online and offline payments at stores nationwide, including convenience stores, supermarkets, and restaurants.
Transportation Card: Simply tap and ride on buses, subways, and other public transportation.
CROSS Shop Integration: Pay with CROSSPAY in just one second and enjoy special deals on CROSS Shop.
With one CROSSPAY card, domestic transfers, offline payments, and transportation are all easier and more convenient for everyday life in Korea.
CROSS, the essential app for foreigners living in Korea, brings it all together—from a prepaid card and transportation card to convenient everyday payments.
[KEY SERVICES]
Fast & Secure International Remittance with CROSS
Trusted by over 2 million foreigners in Korea
■ Competitive Exchange Rates & Low Fees
With preferential exchange rates, CROSS helps you send more money to your family back home. International remittance fees are 5,000 KRW or less for all countries, and your first remittance is free. Enjoy both better exchange rates and low fees.
■ Fast & Easy Sign-Up
Anyone can complete registration in just five (5) minutes with an ID or passport. You can apply for an international remittance even without a bank account or with an expired passport. With your saved information, repeat transfers can be completed in just one (1) minute.
■ Safe & Trusted CROSS
CROSS is a government-licensed international remittance provider in Korea (License No. 2020-2). When you send money through the app, the recipient safely receives the exact amount confirmed at the time of application.
■ Multilingual Customer Support
Our multilingual customer support team is here to help. Whether you have questions about prepaid cards designed for foreigners or international remittances, feel free to contact us anytime.
■ CROSS Shop
Shopping in Korea can be challenging, but CROSS Shop makes it easier. Shop in your own language and ask questions with ease. Find popular Korean products as well as products you know and love from your home country—all in one place.
CROSS is the essential app for foreigners living in Korea. From preferential exchange rates on international remittances to CROSSPAY, enjoy domestic transfers, offline payments, transportation, and shopping—all in one app.
Make everyday life in Korea easier and more convenient with CROSS!
[Customer Support Center]
- Telephone Inquiry: 1670-2624
- Address: 22 Hakdong-ro 7-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul
[Service access rights]
■ (Optional) Camera: You can attach a photo or use functions such as QR code scanning.
■ (Optional) Album: You can import photos stored on the device and use functions such as address entry and QR code scanning.
■ (Optional) Microphone: Customer center telephone connection is available.
■ (Optional) Biometric information: It can be used as a means of self-authentication when logging in and making payments.
■ (Optional) Location: Based on the current location information, you can use automatic address entry and find a nearby convenience store function.

bluejetty:00089363:ios.summary:
"Are you looking for a cute pet? Too bad!
Kotadama Diary's characters evolve depending on the words which you feed them, and could even grow up into something... unexpected. 
Weird characters, happy characters, sad characters, lovely charac
bluejetty:00089363:ios.description:
"Are you looking for a cute pet? Too bad!
Kotadama Diary's characters evolve depending on the words which you feed them, and could even grow up into something... unexpected. 
Weird characters, happy characters, sad characters, lovely characters, rude characters, and even, yes, simply cute characters—There's something for everyone!
Can you feed them the right words to make them evolve into a new species? Try your best while you decorate your room with your favorite furniture. And you don't even need to clean up!
Kotodama Diary is a simple, entertaining game that lets you have fun with bizarre characters that evolve depending on your choices!
There are more than 100 different species of these weird characters, known as the ""kotodummies"".
And, maybe, you'll find that the words you chose tell you something about yourself...
●○ How to play ○●
- Touch or swipe on the hearts to collect them
- When you have enough hearts, words will appear
- Choose one of the words
- Depending on which word you chose, the kotodummy will evolve
- Use gems or tickets to draw fortunes and get accessories
- The kotodummies will wear the accessories you give them, and, if they like them, they'll give you useful items in return
- The kotodummies will collect coins which you can use to buy furniture
- Furniture helps you progress through the game faster
Decorate your room, play with your favorite kotodummies, and create your very own Kotodama Diary!
●○●You'll like this game if●○● 
- You like slow-paced, relaxing games
- You want to pass some time for free
- You want more than just cutesy characters
- You want to speak with your pets
- You want some absurd screenshots to share
- You like pixel art
- You like rolling those sweet gachas
- You love putting accessories on things/people/animals
- You enjoy the occasional weird character
- You could do with some giggles
- You like bringin up virtual characters
- You want to decorate your room
- You like collecting things
- You want some very unique ""pets"""

bluejetty:00013852:ios.description:
Profolio™ is a bespoke property listing management platform, exclusively designed for real estate agents in the UAE who are registered on Bayut. With innovative tools such as ProConnect™, SmartLeads™ and TruCheck™, the application is a comprehensive solution for managing your property listings and leads.
Streamlined Lead Tracking and Management
● Gather data-backed insights with SmartLeads™ to know more the preferences of property seekers.
● View all your leads generated from multiple channels in one place and interact with them via Phone Calls, Emails or WhatsApp.
● Understand the requirements of potential clients by listening to recordings of tracked phone calls.
Increase Conversions with the TruCheck™ Badge
The TruCheck™ badge on Bayut helps you attract more serious property seekers by showcasing the availability and authenticity of your listings. Using Profolio™, you can:
● Start the TruCheck™ process by visiting the property premises of your listing.
● Capture and upload pictures of the listing to timestamp and geo-tag the listing with the latest available information.
● Submit the pictures for approval after which your listing will appear with the TruCheck™ badge on Bayut’s search results and receive increased exposure.
Listings Management and Analytics
● Use Profolio™ to quickly and conveniently publish or edit your property listings.
● Upload validation documents to promote the authenticity of your listings. 
● View the performance of your listings in terms of the numbers of impressions, clicks and leads generated.
Set Up Your Agent Profile
A complete Agent Profile on Bayut helps your listings rank higher on Bayut’s search results. It is also the perfect opportunity to build your personal brand and tell property seekers a bit more about yourself. With Profolio™ you can:
● Fill in the required details and upload your picture to complete your Agent Profile.
● Provide a summary of your work experience, key strengths and reasons why property seekers should work with you.
Collaborate with other agents through ProConnect™
● Post your property preferences and instantly get matched with relevant listings from our network of agents.
● Connect directly with other agents to share listings and close deals faster.
● Build trust and visibility with your dedicated Agent Profile showcasing your expertise and active listings.

Filmic Firstlight is a revolutionary photo camera from the makers of the class leading Filmic Pro cinema video camera that makes live photography fun and creative.
-- -- -- -- -- -- 
Rediscover the joy of capturing life’s moments in photo
bluejetty:00075986:ios.description:
Filmic Firstlight is a revolutionary photo camera from the makers of the class leading Filmic Pro cinema video camera that makes live photography fun and creative.
-- -- -- -- -- -- 
Rediscover the joy of capturing life’s moments in photographs you will immediately treasure and want to share.
Firstlight combines custom film simulations, adaptive film grain and FiLMiC Pro’s famous live analytics to offer an advanced but approachable front end camera experience like no other.
Fast, easy and intuitive, Firstlight lets you envision and capture your best moments in camera, without having to spend hours editing your photos later. Shoot and share, it’s that easy.
-- -- -- -- -- -- 
ADVANCED IMAGE CONTROLS
- Fast, intuitive focus and exposure controls: Tap the screen to set focus/exposure, tap again to lock.

bluejetty:00022480:ios.description:
*Try it for free, full version requires a paid subscription*. Tune It Yourself makes use of the in game telemetry feed and advanced algorithms to tune each race car to the driver and circuit conditions. 
Using improved tuning formulas and a brand-new tuning technique, Tune It Yourself connects with Forza Motorsport 2023, Forza Motorsport 7, Forza Horizon 6, Forza Horizon 5 or Forza Horizon 4 and collects live data from your car as you race. This allows Tune It Yourself to automatically adjust your base tunes using the data gathered from your time on track to tailor the suspension and gearing setups for both the car and the track it is on.
The trial version of this app allows the user to tune the KTM X-Box GT4 on any track in Forza Motorsport 2023, the Radical SR8 on any track in Forza Motorsport 7, the 1993 Skyline GT-R VSPEC in Forza Horizon 4, the 1992 Ford Escort RS Cosworth in Forza Horizon 5 and the 1994 Toyota Celica GT-FOUR ST205 in Forza Horizon 6. To tune other cars, a Tune It Yourself subscription is required which can be purchased from within the app.
The Pocket Playground terms of service can be found at https://www.pocketplayground.net/tos

bluejetty:00171814:android.summary: Introducing Norton Genie. Your personal AI-powered scam detector. Genie is an industry leading AI-powered scam detection tool that will scan and review text messages, emails, websites, and social posts trying to trick you. You’ll get instan
bluejetty:00171814:android.description:
Introducing Norton Genie. Your personal AI-powered scam detector. Genie is an industry leading AI-powered scam detection tool that will scan and review text messages, emails, websites, and social posts trying to trick you. You’ll get instant advice on whether the message or site is potentially a scam, so you'll know if it’s safe. [1]
- Have you received a text message from a suspicious or unknown sender? 
- Was an email delivered to your inbox by someone pretending to be your bank or insurance company? 
- Is that offer advertised on social media too good to be true?
- Does a website feel like it could be a scam? Did you really find the best price or does the site just want your credit card info?
Criminals are so good at making scams look real, that it’s easy to get tricked into opening, clicking, or sharing shady links. Bottom line? We can tell you if it could be a scam before you get scammed!
So easy to use, it’s like magic.
Just copy & paste or upload a screenshot of the text message, social media post, email, or website you want checked, and just like magic, we'll let you know in seconds if it's potentially a scam or not. Genie can also provide tips on what to do next, and answer follow-up questions you might have like, what are the criminals trying to get from me? 
The more you use it, the smarter it gets.
Unfortunately, criminals keep finding new ways to trick you. Genie is powered by advanced AI so the more you use it, the smarter it gets at detecting new scams. The more messages you upload, the more it evolves, keeping you even safer in the future.
New technology from Norton, a global leader in consumer cyber security.
At Norton, we have decades of experience uncovering and remediating scams, phishing attacks, and sketchy websites. And even though proactively stopping scams sounds like sorcery, you can feel secure knowing that a scam detector from Norton is backed by actual, tried-and-true cybersecurity technology.
Take back control from online scammers and fight back with Genie. Try for Free Now!
[1] Depending on the content of a message, Genie may not be able to tell if it is a scam or not, but it will provide guidance on next steps.
[2] Genie is only compatible with Android devices running Android version 8 and higher.
Our app is currently available only in English and does not evaluate for scams

bluejetty:00069215:ios.description:
DIE ZEIT steht für preisgekrönten Journalismus – mit aktuellen Nachrichten, Schlagzeilen, tiefgehenden Reportagen, Podcasts und Videos aus der ZEIT-Redaktion.
Dazu: Hintergründe, Datenvisualisierungen und die wöchentliche Ausgabe der ZEIT als E-Paper – fundiert, unabhängig, multimedial.
ZEIT und ZEIT ONLINE sind jetzt vereint unter einer Marke: DIE ZEIT.
Neben News zu den wichtigsten Ereignissen und Live-Berichterstattung finden Sie das vollständige E-Paper der aktuellen ZEIT-Ausgabe und exklusive Z+-Artikel. Ergänzt wird das Angebot durch Hintergründe zu Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft, Kultur und Wissen.
Bleiben Sie informiert mit fundierten Analysen, exklusiven Recherchen, Reportagen und Schlagzeilen, Podcasts mit unserem neuen Audioplayer und entdecken Sie Empfehlungen direkt aus der Redaktion.
Auch im Bewegtbild begleitet Sie DIE ZEIT multimedial: Erleben Sie aktuelle Nachrichten mit Videos, Livestreams und Hochkant-Formaten aus der Redaktion.
Mein Abo – alles im Digitalpaket
Hier finden Sie alle Inhalte Ihres Digitalabos: Z+-Artikel, exklusive Inhalte wie Rezepte aus dem Wochenmarkt, Rätselklassiker wie Sudoku und „Um die Ecke gedacht“, das E-Paper der aktuellen ZEIT und mehr.
Audio – Hören statt lesen
Im Audiobereich finden Sie alle Podcasts der ZEIT, wie unseren Nachrichtenpodcast „Was jetzt?“ und ZEIT Verbrechen. Außerdem hören Sie vorgelesene Artikel aus der aktuellen ZEIT. Für ein personalisiertes Hörerlebnis können Sie einzelne Episoden oder die Hörversionen von Artikeln Ihrer Warteschlange hinzufügen, um diese ohne Unterbrechung zu hören.
Spiele & Rätsel
Täglich neu: Spielen Sie das beliebte Worträtsel Wortiger, die Buchstabiene oder einen unserer Klassiker: Sudoku, Kreuzworträtsel oder das Quiz.
Menü & Navigation
Im Inhaltemenü (links oben im Start-Tab) finden Sie alle Ressorts und wichtigen Übersichtsseiten wie die Newsletterübersicht oder das ZEIT-Archiv.
Im Nutzermenü (rechts oben im Start-Tab) finden Sie zusätzliche Funktionen: Dark Mode, Schriftgrößenanpassung, Ihre persönliche Merkliste – und die Möglichkeit, Push-Benachrichtigungen zu aktivieren. So bleiben Sie informiert über Live-Updates, Schlagzeilen und Eilmeldungen in Echtzeit.
ZEIT Widgets
Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden – direkt vom Homescreen: Mit unseren Widgets können Sie sich empfohlene Artikel, Schlagzeilen oder unsere aktuell meistgelesenen Artikel anzeigen lassen.
Ihr Abo – alles inklusive
Mit einem ZEIT-ONLINE-Digitalabo erhalten Sie Zugriff auf alle Inhalte der App sowie
• DIE ZEIT E-Paper App
• ZEIT Audio App
• E-Reader-Formate
• Fachkundiger ZEIT-Kundensupport
In-App-Abos über iTunes
Die Abrechnung erfolgt über Ihr iTunes-Konto. Nach Ablauf der gewählten Laufzeit wird das Abo automatisch verlängert, sofern Sie nicht spätestens 24 Stunden vorher kündigen.
Fragen oder Feedback zur App?
Schreiben Sie uns gerne an apps@zeit.de
Datenschutzerklärung: https://datenschutz.zeit.de/zon
AGB: https://www.zeit.de/administratives/agb-kommentare-artikel

bluejetty:00077132:ios.description:
Looking for the best baby tracker app to support you through the newborn and toddler years? Onoco is an all-in-one baby schedule planner, combining baby tracking, routine planning, and smart insights to simplify parenting. Whether you need a breastfeeding app, baby sleep tracker, or milestone tracker, Onoco helps you stay organized from day one.
FREE BABY TRACKER & ROUTINE PLANNER
Comprehensive Baby Tracking
Track every aspect of your baby’s routine with an intuitive baby tracker:
-> Breastfeeding & pumping tracker – Log nursing sessions with an easy-to-use breastfeeding timer
-> Bottle & solids tracker – Monitor formula feeds and meal intake
-> Baby sleep tracker & nap log – Keep track of sleep duration and establish a healthy baby sleep schedule
-> Diaper & potty tracker – Monitor diaper changes and potty training progress
-> Growth & health tracking – Record weight, height, and medical needs
-> Medicine tracker – Log vaccinations, medications, and doctor’s visits
-> Custom Logs – Track tummy time, bath time, playtime, or anything else important in your baby’s day
-> Advanced Pattern Charts – Spot Trends in Your Baby’s Routine
View a weekly overview of feeding, sleep, and diaper patterns
Identify emerging habits and adjust your routine accordingly
Family & Caregiver Sharing – Free for All Users
Onoco makes it easy to share baby care responsibilities with parents, grandparents, nannies, and babysitters – at no extra cost!
-> Invite unlimited caregivers and sync updates in real time
-> Customizable access levels – Choose what each caregiver can see and edit
-> Secure activity logging & commenting – Keep everyone informed on sleep, feeds, and routines
-> Special Nanny Account – A dedicated profile for professional caregivers
-> Photo Timeline – Capture & Share Precious Moments
-> Upload photos to your baby’s timeline and link them to their learning journey
-> Family members can view and comment on moments, keeping everyone involved in your child's growth
Baby Milestones & Learning Journey
-> Track 460+ developmental milestones over the first 5 years
-> Receive daily parenting tips tailored to your baby’s growth
-> Monitor progress with digital growth charts
ONOCO PREMIUM – AI-Powered Parenting & Smart Baby Scheduling
AI Baby Sleep & Nap Scheduler
-> Get personalized nap predictions based on your baby’s sleep data and millions of real-world sleep patterns
-> Prevent overtiredness with AI-generated optimal sleep windows
-> Adjust your baby’s sleep schedule as they grow and drop naps
Smart Baby Schedule & Routine Management
-> Plan naps, feeds, and activities with a flexible baby routine planner
-> Get real-time AI adjustments as your baby’s sleep needs change
-> Integrate doctor’s appointments and childcare arrangements
Knowledge Hub – Expert Parenting Resources
-> Access 100+ expert articles and videos on sleep, nutrition, and behavior
-> Get science-backed guidance for every stage of development
-> Personalized Development Insights
-> Receive milestone-based tips aligned with the EYFS framework
-> Understand what’s next in your child’s growth and how to support their development
Data Download & Healthcare Integration
-> Export logs for medical consultations and record-keeping
-> Keep an accurate history of your baby’s growth and health patterns
All-Inclusive Family Access with Premium
Upgrade to Onoco Premium, and all caregivers will get access to advanced features at no additional cost
Join a hundred thousand of Parents Using Onoco for a Smarter Baby Routine!
Onoco is more than just a baby tracker app – it’s your AI-powered parenting assistant. Effortlessly track milestones, create a personalized baby schedule, and build healthy routines with the help of smart tools.
Download Onoco today and take the guesswork out of parenting!
Web: https://www.onoco.com
Terms of Use: https://www.onoco.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.onoco.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00028836:ios.description:
A simple and convenient interval timer perfect for your workouts!
This timer is ideal for any type of workout—whether you're into fitness, boxing, or intense training.
Key Features:
- Easy-to-use and intuitive interface 
Customize your timer to suit your needs: set work and rest times, the number of rounds, and exercises. Take full control of your workouts!
- Workout History 
Track your progress with a complete history of your workouts. The app saves all your sessions so you can repeat successful workouts and track your progress.
- Music and audio without interruptions 
No need to worry about music! The timer won't interfere with your music or audio files while you train.
- Suitable for all types of sports 
This timer is perfect for home workouts, fitness, CrossFit, MMA, boxing, and other physical activities.
- Workout Statistics 
The app tracks important data about your workouts: the number of consecutive workout days, completed sessions, and total workout time. This helps you monitor your progress and reach new goals.
With this app, working out has never been easier, more convenient, or more enjoyable! Start training with the interval timer and achieve great results!

Transfer money anytime to fellow DANA users or bank accounts directly from the app. Whether you're splitting bills, supporting family, or making business payments, DANA makes every transfer quick and convenient.

• Electricity (PLN)
• BPJS Health Insurance
• Water (PDAM)
• Internet & Wi-Fi
• Cable TV
• Other digital services
Stay on top of your payments anytime, anywhere.
Top Up Mobile Credit, Data & Digital Products
Need more mobile data or prepaid credit? DANA makes topping up fast and convenient.
You can also purchase various digital products and services directly within the app.
DANA+ Grow Your Balance Every Day
DANA+ is a feature that gives your DANA Balance the potential to keep growing, with a chance to earn extra balance every day. Your DANA+ Balance can be used immediately to pay with QRIS, send money, or make other transactions.
Built for Secure Digital Payments with DANA Protection
Your security is our priority. DANA is equipped with multiple layers of protection to help keep your account and transactions safe, including: 
• DANA Protection with a 100% Money-Back Guarantee (subject to applicable terms and conditions)
• Scam Checker to help identify potential fraud
• Multi-layered protection for your account and transactions, including PIN, OTP, and DANA Viz
• Meet DIANA, your 24/7 Digital Assistant, always ready to help and answer your questions about DANA
Why Choose DANA?
• Pay with QRIS at millions of merchants
• Send money quickly and securely
• Transfer to bank accounts with ease
• Pay bills in one app
• Top up mobile credit and data packages
• Advanced security features to protect your account
• Trusted by millions of users across Indonesia
Download DANA today and experience a smarter way to pay, transfer money, shop, and manage your everyday finances—all in one secure digital wallet.

Characterize: Your Unlimited Character Creation Companion
Characterize is the ideal tool for writers, role-players, storytellers, and anyone who needs fresh, original characters at a moment’s notice.
With a tap, Characterize draws from a massive, ever-expanding database of names, traits, and stats to bring you a nearly infinite variety of unique personalities—enough for even the most epic of projects. Boundless Name Generation:
- Instantly generate characters from countless categories, including humans, orcs, pirates, assassins, and more. The possibilities stretch into the quadrillions—no two characters need ever be the same!
Rich Character Details:
- Don’t stop at names. Dive into ages, birthdays, hair and eye color, height, intelligence, personality, and relationships—all created with a single tap. Your characters will spring to life with depth and flair!
Unlock Even More Worlds:
- Beyond the vast default selection, themed packs give you even more variety. From superheroes to aliens, historical figures to anime icons, you’ll find the perfect flavor for any setting.
Save & Share with Ease:
- Keep track of your favorite creations and share them with friends. Revisit your saved characters whenever you like—no scrolling through endless notes or documents.
Whether you’re naming a long-awaited protagonist, populating a tabletop campaign, or challenging yourself to write a story without knowing your cast in advance, Characterize puts limitless inspiration at your fingertips.
Stop juggling multiple tools—download Characterize today and generate your next hero with a single tap!
