bluejetty:00034858:ios.description:
Get the latest New Mexico lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Lotto America
- Roadrunner Cash
- Pick 3 Plus (Day and Evening)
- Pick 4 Plus (Day and Evening)
Powerball, Mega Millions and Lotto America also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

Some workout schedules included are Stronglifts, 5x5, Madcow, Push Pull Legs (PPL), Starting Strength and much more. Training with weights has never been easier.
When you create your gym workout plans and log your weight lifting workouts, the workout planner will help you visualize your progress. You can view one rep max charts of the major compound exercises like bench press, barbell squat, and deadlift. 
It has been proven that by tracking your weight lifting workouts you will be able to increase your bench press, barbell squat, and deadlift significantly.

Start logging a workout immediately

- Easy to use exercise tracker that’s quicker than using pen and paper and spreadsheet
- Add supersets, trisets, and giant sets to your gym workout
- Add notes to your sets and workouts
- Plate calculator
Built in workout schedules
- Beginner workout schedules like StrongLifts 5x5 and Ice Cream Fitness
- Advanced workout schedules like Madcow 5x5, PHUL, and PHAT
- Workout schedules that allow you to build muscle, burn fat, and build strength
- Everything from powerlifting, bodybuilding, weight training, and strength training workout schedules
- A gym trainer that is catered to your fitness goals

- Library of 300+ gym exercises with images and instructions included to add to your workout schedule 
- Workout gym exercises such as barbell squats, bench press, barbell rows, and deadlifts
- Customize sets and reps for each exercise in your workout schedule
- Add individual rest times for each exercise in your workout
- Group exercises into supersets, trisets, and giant sets
- Allows you to create workout schedules like 5x5, 3x5, 1x3, Starting Strength, German Volume Training, and Crossfit workouts
- Perfect for people doing powerlifting and bodybuilding who want to take their strength training and weight training to the next level
During a workout session
- The workout app will allow you to easily log the reps and weights of each set
- A rest timer appears making sure you are taking an appropriate amount of rest
- You will be able to see the last performance of the set you are doing 
- Focus on beating your personal records and making those bodybuilding, strength training, and weight training gains

- Share all your workout sessions and body measurements logged to Apple Health

App Store ‘Best of 2015’ Awards Winner
Step into the epic Warhammer 40,000 universe with Warhammer 40,000: Freeblade! Take control of a mighty Imperial Knight and embark on a thrilling journey of honor, redemption, and vengeance. Explosive Tap-to-Shoot Action:

Experience Warhammer 40,000 like never before! Immerse yourself in stunning high-detail graphics and the latest visual effects that bring characters and creatures to life.

Take advantage of 3D Touch technology on compatible devices. Press deeper for enhanced zoom and weapon switching. Feel the action at your fingertips without lifting a finger.

bluejetty:00014444:ios.name: UniCredit RO - Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00014444:ios.summary:
The mobile application from UniCredit Bank has an intuitive, safe navigation and helps you save time for the things that really matter.
- Do you want to enroll you card in Apple Pay and use your phone for payments?
You can do it directly f
bluejetty:00014444:ios.description:
The mobile application from UniCredit Bank has an intuitive, safe navigation and helps you save time for the things that really matter.
- Do you want to enroll you card in Apple Pay and use your phone for payments?
You can do it directly from Mobile Banking. Go to Cards/Card Info menu, press the "Add to Apple Wallet" button, enroll the card and activate the NFC on your phone.
- Do you need quickly a debit card?
Request a virtual one from home page or “Offers” menu. Easy to issue it, easy to close it.
- Do you want to get money back for some of your transactions?
Activate and use offers from ShopSmart cashback program that you may find in “Offers” menu. We have more than 100 partners.
- Do you need to credit your UniCredit account quickly in order to pay contactless using your phone or to pay your monthly rate for your loan?
Access "Add money" icon from Account page, fill in the amount and the card details, and authorize the card transaction as you normally do when making online payments using that card.
- Have you changed your phone number or e-mail address and want to update your contact details in relationship with the Bank?
From "My Profile" menu you can update the phone number, the email address and even upload your ID picture. 
- Do you want to stop worrying about bill payment deadlines?
You can activate a Direct Debit mandate from Payments/Utility Payments and the bills will be automatically payed each month from your current account. You can set up a limit or cancel the mandate at any time.
- Did you forgot your card at home and you need to withdraw cash? 
All you need to do is access the mCash icon from the Accounts or Card menu (only those with RON currency), specify the amount and generate the code, which you can use at any UniCredit Romania cash withdraw terminal.
- Do you want to pay utility bills?
You can do it directly by scanning the barcode on the invoice, without the necessity to complete any additional details.
- Do you want to block a card or to set its limits?
Tap on the Cards menu, choose the desired card and you have full access to its settings. You can change POS or ATM limits and you can also block/unblock it or decide whether you want to use it for online payments. Anytime, on the spot.
- Do you want to pay back your credit card?
Select the credit card repayment option from either the Payments menu, or from the Cards menu after you previously choose the desired card. You modify the amount, if you want, and sign.
- Do you want to open a term deposit?
Select the option from the Products menu and open the desired term deposit with just a few clicks.
- Do you want to get rid of the digipass?
Activate Mobile Token. The app generates unique passwords for each authentication or transaction authorization you do in Online Banking.
- And much more.

bluejetty:00028719:ios.description:
Welcome to an enchanting world of mushrooms with our cutting-edge identification app! Discover the fascinating names of various mushrooms at the tap of your finger. Snap a photo or select one from your gallery, and watch as our app, powered by revolutionary AI technology, instantly reveals the secrets behind each fungus you encounter.
Immerse yourself in the wonders of nature and deepen your knowledge of the world around you! Picture this: you're out for a leisurely stroll when you stumble upon a mysterious mushroom. Wondering if it's a delectable treat or potentially hazardous? Worry no more! Open the app, snap a quick pic, and instantly receive all the essential information you need. We've got you covered. However, remember that, like anything in life, the app may occasionally surprise you. It's always wise to exercise caution. If you're unsure about a mushroom's edibility, better safe than sorry!
But that's not all! Our app is a treasure trove of valuable information waiting for your exploration. Dive into insightful articles like "Here’s How You Can Identify Poisonous Mushrooms" and "How to Dry Mushrooms Indoors" and unlock a wealth of knowledge at your fingertips.
Key Features:
- Instantly identify various mushrooms you come across
- Snap or upload mushroom photos for quick identification
- Reliable and accurate mushroom information at your fingertips
- Curate your very own mushroom collection
- Explore a plethora of helpful and informative articles
- Delight in a beautifully designed interface that sparks joy
Subscribe to Premium for features such as Unlimited Mushrooms Identification, All-time History of Identifications, and Card with a Comprehensive Description for Various Mushrooms!

So why wait? Venture outdoors and embark on thrilling mushroom-hunting expeditions with our app as your trusty companion! Unleash your inner explorer and unravel the secrets of these enchanting fungi. Download now and let the adventure begin!

bluejetty:00147366:ios.description:
OnPage is an unparalleled incident notification management and HIPAA-compliant clinical communication platform, revolutionizing how organizations respond to critical situations worldwide. Our cutting-edge technology ensures secure team communication, and that vital notifications reach the right individual promptly, empowering efficient incident resolution.
With features such as Alert-Until-Read capabilities, Dynamic Digital Schedules, Customizable Escalation, robust incident Reporting, and Redundancies, OnPage automate the notification process and guarantees that critical alerts are never overlooked.
Trusted by enterprises globally, OnPage facilitates seamless secure communication, keeping personnel, vendors, and clients informed during critical events while maintaining unwavering reliability. Our platform surpasses traditional pagers, enabling teams to streamline operations and enhance productivity.
Simple, reliable, and secure, OnPage offers a FREE trial to pager app for quick installation, ensuring immediate access to critical alerts. Unlike traditional pagers, OnPage for iPhone offers unparalleled functionalities:
- Consolidate all alerts and messages to your iPhone device, eliminating the need for multiple devices.
- Receive unlimited push notifications that bypass the mute switch, ensuring no critical alert goes unnoticed.
- Securely add text details, image files, voicemails, and document attachments to enhance communication.
- View team availability directly on your iPhone device.
- View your On-Call duty on your iPhone.
- View your team-members on-call duty.
- Choose between high or low-priority notification.
- Easily respond to open incidents or forward messages to colleagues for collaborative resolution.
- Receive mobile alerts that persist for up to 8 hours until acknowledged, ensuring continuous visibility.
- Send HIPAA-compliant messages to team members directly from the OnPage pager app, maintaining data security and compliance.
- Enjoy global coverage and never miss a critical alert, regardless of location.
OnPage's quarterly/yearly subscription features include:
- Full access to the OnPage Enterprise web management console for comprehensive control.
- Configurable on-call digital schedules to ensure messages reach the right person at the right time.
- Performance reports, post-incident data, and audit trails for thorough analysis and improvement.
- Contact manager and user permissions for streamlined communication management.
- On-call mobile reminders and delay notification schedules for optimized response times.
- Escalation policies and failovers to guarantee timely escalation and resolution.
- On-call schedule exceptions and responsibility substitutions for flexibility.
- Integration with ITSM tools, monitoring systems, healthcare solutions, and more, ensuring seamless workflow integration and scalability.
Experience the future of incident alert management and communication with OnPage. Download our pager app for FREE and elevate your incident response capabilities today!
*NOTE: Users can request a 7-day Enterprise free trial by visiting https://www.onpage.com/free-trial/
For more information:

Email: support@OnPagecorp.com
Web: https://www.OnPage.com
Phone: +1 (781) 916-0040

bluejetty:00069907:ios.description:
Cook, Grill and Bake your way to greatness in this free time management cooking game! Your Virtual Family needs to grow their House Flipping fund, and you’re going to help them reach their goal - one feast at a time in their own personal backyard restaurant!
Become a top chef, making gourmet food and drinks from around the world!
Manage your time to beat the dinner dash and dish out the delicious, from pizza to burgers, sushi and cupcakes and so much more!
The house isn’t going to flip itself! Spend your hard-earned dough and renovate the house and yard the way you want it. Maximize the property value and move to bigger, better homes! 
Fire up the grill, mix your marinades, and start your very own Cook-Off now!
Fun and Challenging Levels! 
• Cook breakfast, dinner, lunch and gourmet meals for you guests
• Replay family memories
• Expand your cooking technique with every level
Fun Themes from around the world!
• Cook up delicious meals from New York to Hong Kong, and everywhere in between! 
• Upgrade your dishes to maximize serving size and profit
• Amazing kitchen upgrades
Develop a cooking strategy! 
• Blast through memory levels for bonus coins
• Serve your food fast to get all the likes
• Challenge yourself with unlimited dishes in timed levels
Fun chef games are free to play!
• Time management kitchen cooking meets home renovation!
• Bake, grill and fry delicious foods in the kitchen for your hungry guests!
Upgrade every food and preparation item in the game!
• Visually upgrade your foods to become more valuable
• Update your kitchen gear to increase capacity and decrease prep time
• Level up every ingredient! 
Cook all the classic restaurant foods in this free kitchen cooking game! 
• Cook juicy hamburgers, hearty American steaks, mouth-watering Italian pizza, gelato, pasta and risotto!
• Whip up Mexican breakfast bowls with eggs, avocado and chorizo! 
• Serve up savory Japanese sushi, classic Canadian maple poutine or Jamaican jerk chicken! 
• Bake 3 milks cake, super sweet cupcakes and so much more!
To stay up to date on the latest Virtual Families: Cookoff news visit our Facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/Virtual-Families-Cook-Off-268634747356498/

bluejetty:00123066:ios.description:
Pittsfield Cooperative Mobile Banking offers a convenient, easy way to do your banking from anywhere at any time. This app gives you the ability to perform the same functions you would with Pittsfield Coop online banking only with a user friendly look and feel suited for mobile devices.
Pittsfield Coop Mobile Banking is available by registering as an online banking customer. If you wish to enroll, visit www.pittsfieldcoop.com.
FEATURES 
• View account balances
• View recent transactions
• Transfer funds 
• Pay bills
• Pay someone with our Person to Person payment feature
• Locate ATMs or Branch offices
The Pittsfield Cooperative Bank is a mutual cooperative, community oriented Bank serving Berkshire County in Massachusetts with a variety of products and services, designed to meet the needs of individual consumers and small to mid-size businesses.
Please feel free to e-mail us with any questions you may have about the services we provide. You can reach us at web@pittsfieldcoop.com or 413-447-7304 for general inquires.
We do ask that you do not send confidential information to us via e-mail. E-mail is not necessarily secure against interception. If your communication is very sensitive, or includes personal information like your account numbers, social security number or card numbers, you might want to call us or send it by regular mail.
For tips and additional information on how to use Mobile Banking safely and securely, visit: www.pittsfieldcoop.com/security-center.aspx

bluejetty:00119288:ios.description:
LandstarOne® is the one-stop mobile app for Landstar owner-operators and third-party carriers to access Landstar's available loads, fuel savings, card balances, inspection stations and more. 
Haul more with Load Search 
Quickly find the best loads for your business with our advanced load search and filtering options. 
Stay in the know with Load Details 
See important details for a load, including revenue, rate per mile, load dates and times, weight, miles, load age, load comments and more. 
Keep hauling with Fuel Search 
Find and save your favorite fuel stations, see Landstar fuel discounts, calculate your net fuel cost and more.
Keep track of it with Booked Loads
See current, upcoming, and past loads in one place.
Additional features for Landstar BCOs:
Do more with Trip Advance & Card Balance 
Request a Trip Advance and see your balance right in the app. 
Connect with Agent Search
Quickly find and contact agents to ask questions, book loads and more.
Locate Inspection Sites 
Find Landstar-approved inspection sites, view open hours and contact directly. 
SmartHook™ provides users and their mobile devices and personal computer devices support in tracking and managing of truck and trailer equipment and transportation logistics within the downloadable LandstarOne® App.
Disclaimers: 
To become a BCO and join the Landstar network, visit leasetolandstar.com. To onboard as a qualified carrier visit https://onboard.dat.com/landstar. 
Please remember to be safe. Do not use the application while operating your vehicle.

bluejetty:00114383:ios.description:
Imposter Game – A Social Party & Group Game
Imposter Game is a fast-paced social deduction game designed for friends, families, and groups. This imposter game is perfect for parties, game nights, trips, and casual hangouts where conversation, bluffing, and observation decide the winner.
In every round, one player is secretly the imposter. Everyone else knows the word. The challenge is to figure out who is faking it before time runs out.
How the Imposter Game Works
Each round, players receive their roles.
One player becomes the spy — the imposter.
The imposter does not know the secret word and must blend in.
Players ask questions, give clues, and observe reactions carefully.
At the end of the round, the group votes.
Catch the imposter, or the imposter wins.
The rules are simple, but the gameplay is full of tension.
Why You’ll Love Imposter Game
Imposter Game is an easy-to-play party game that works for any group size.
It encourages conversation, strategy, and social interaction.
No accounts or setup are required.
Each round feels different, keeping the game fresh and replayable.
Ideal for fans of imposter word games, spy games, and bluff-based group games.
This app offers subscription plans. If you choose to subscribe, your payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings.
https://sites.google.com/view/polyhootprivacypolicy/privacy-policy

Enjoy Storytaco’s new romance thriller!
Darling Pet, the romantic interactive otome game of dating cute pet boys and full of thrilling simulations, is finally ready to download!
Everything begins with the animals you rescue.
‘Wait, do I have to live with them?’

Darling Pet is a visual-novel based romantic simulator game featuring attractive illustration and high-quality sound effects. Users’ choices decide the whole plot of the story, especially how the ending will be illustrated. Game’s hidden episodes and thrilling plots maximize the curiosity and the excitement that the users get to feel when trying to solve their ways to the end of the game.

Dangerous neighborhood that follows them.
Can you keep your peaceful daily life?

In a way you’ve never experienced before!

bluejetty:00037183:ios.description:
Your All-in-One Reading Companion
ReadKit is a powerful, all-in-one read-later and RSS client that brings together your favorite news, articles, and feeds. With major providers and built-in iCloud RSS and Read Later sync, ReadKit lets you save and read articles later, providing a distraction-free reading experience anytime and anywhere.
KEY FEATURES
• All-in-One Reading Hub: Access all your accounts in one place with multi-account support.
• Cross-Platform: Universal app with full feature parity on iOS and macOS.
• iCloud RSS and Read Later: Built-in services with iCloud sync.
• Flexible Syncing: Sync with major RSS aggregators and read-later services.
• Advanced Organization: Manage feeds, folders, tags and automatically updated smart folders.
• Smart Folder Actions: Mark items read or starred and filter content.
• Offline Access: Read articles offline with cached images.
• Enhanced Reading Experience: Built-in reader mode extracts full article content, with options for automatic activation.
• Wide Gesture Support: Navigate, mark articles read and perform quick actions.
• In-App Browser: View links and references without leaving the app.
• App Badge Preferences: Customize the badge to display the count of unread items.
• Mark as Read Options: Mark articles read while scrolling, by pulling up, or in one tap.
• Contextual Marking: Quickly mark articles as read above or below directly from the context menu.
• Customizable Interface: Choose themes, light or dark mode, and app icons to suit your style.
• Powerful Search: Search articles by content, title, or source.
• Filter Articles: Easily filter articles by read or starred status.
• Background Syncing: Always stay updated with background sync.
• Content Sharing: Use the share extension to save articles from Safari and other apps for later reading.
• Email Articles: Send articles directly via email to share with others.
• Share via Apps and Services: Share articles through the share sheet.
• YouTube Channel Support: Subscribe to YouTube channels and playlists through RSS feeds.
• Full Keyboard Support: Optimized for hardware keyboards on macOS and iPad.
• Feed Import/Export: Import or export subscriptions via OPML files.
• Application Settings Export: Export and import appearance, reading, general behavior and gesture preferences.
Enjoy ReadKit’s essential features completely free — no ads, no data mining. Unlock additional features with ReadKit Premium, available via a universal subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase for iOS, macOS, or both. A free trial is also available.
PREMIUM FEATURES
• Multi-Account Support: Manage multiple accounts simultaneously.
• Unlimited Smart Folders: Create and customize more than one smart folder per account.
• Enhanced Reader Mode: Extract full-text content from articles, even when missing from the feed source.
• Article Summary: summarize articles using AI on supported devices (requires ReadKit Premium, Apple Intelligence and iOS 26).
• Unlimited Feeds: Remove the 20-feed limit for the built-in RSS service.
• Advanced Organization Tools: Organize feeds and articles into folders or tags.
• Image Caching: Enjoy offline reading with cached images.
• Themes & Custom Icons: Unlock exclusive themes and choose custom app icons.
• Full OPML Support: Import and export feed subscriptions with ease.
• Account and Smart Folder Export: Export account settings with smart folders and import them individually.
• Early Access: Enjoy upcoming premium features as they're released.
SUPPORTED SERVICES
• Built-in RSS and Read Later services with iCloud sync.
• News Reader Services: BazQux, Feedbin, Feedly, Fever, FreshRSS, Inoreader, Miniflux, NewsBlur, The Old Reader, Tiny Tiny RSS
• Read Later & Bookmarking Services: Instapaper, Wallabag and Pinboard
Privacy Policy: https://readkit.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://readkit.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00131942:ios.description:
"Otium Word Search is a modern twist on traditional word search puzzles that allows you to completely unwind and relax!"
This free word game is carefully designed with various special features that cater to your preferences, whether you're playing on an iPhone or an iPad: smooth and fast operation feel, eye-friendly and clear interface design, unlimited rotation to help you observe, get tips from small props, and more! Otium Word Search is dedicated to creating the most relaxing and immersive experience for classic word game enthusiasts.
""Otium"" signifies leisure, relaxation, and tranquility. The Otium Word Search app aims to free you from the hustle and bustle of work or daily life by offering a fresh interpretation of the traditional word game. It provides you with a chance to spend some time for yourself, find inner calmness, embrace relaxation, and enjoy personal fulfillment during the word game.
— Features —
· Visual design: Clear and concise design, stylish and elegant colors, smooth and fast animations, reduce visual fatigue and help users read and play games more easily!
· User Interface: Simple and easy-to-use navigation and icons, no technical familiarity required, no effort required, no confusion and frustration!
· Theme background: Beautiful and tranquil scenery is carefully selected to create a relaxing and enjoyable gaming environment for you!
· Pure gameplay: Anytime, anywhere, no-wifi needed, enjoy a pure word search game without interference!
· Game difficulty: Unique level generation and difficulty evaluation standards bring you a gradually growing difficulty experience from easy to difficult!
· Winning Assistance: Unlimited spins help users observe, get hints from props to help you play easily when needed!
— How to Play —
For those who are new to the word game:
Word Search (also called Word Seek, Word Find, Word Sleuth, or Mystery Word) is a word game that consists of the letters of a word placed in a grid.
Find and mark all the words hidden inside the box. Words can be placed horizontally, vertically or diagonally. It’s as easy and simple as having an afternoon tea!
Otium Word Search is perfect for fans of classic crosswords, word lines, anagrams or block puzzle games. Or if you enjoy Solitaire, Spider, Hearts, Blackjack, Poker, Spades, Bingo and other relaxing offline casino-style card games, you'll love Otium Word Search!
Wordscapes Search is the perfect fit for fans of classic crossword puzzles, word line, anagrams or block puzzle games. Or, if you enjoy relaxing offline casino-style card games like blackjack, poker, solitaire, spades, bingo, hearts, you will love Wordscapes Search, and our other free word puzzle games!
Otium, our team, is dedicated to developing classic and innovative games that bring joy and a sense of personal achievement. Attaining a state of leisure through casual gaming is a breakthrough in meeting the demands of daily life. Stay tuned for more upcoming Otium Games!
Join the ranks of millions of word game enthusiasts and embark on a nostalgic journey with Otium Word Search! Download this free word game, Otium Word Search, on iOS now and indulge in a highly anticipated leisure experience!

bluejetty:00140884:ios.description:
TGWatch is a third-party Apple Watch app for Telegram Messenger. 
TGWatch allow user receive / send telegram messages on Apple Watch. Because Telegram official client miss many main features on Apple Watch app, so many users can't use full features of telegram on apple watch. TGWatch is for that.
TG Watch Feature:
- Support standalone Telegram new message notification and call notification on Apple Watch
- Receive / Send Telegram Text Messages on Apple Watch
- Receive / Send Telegram Photo Messages on Apple Watch
- Receive / Send Telegram Audio Messages on Apple Watch
- Receive Telegram Sticker / GIF Messages on Apple Watch
- Support Telegram Calls on Apple Watch
- Support Telegram bot inline keyboard and reply keyboard on Apple Watch
- Support reply / forward / add reaction to Telegram message on Apple Watch
- Audio to Text
- Access All Telegram Chats on Apple Watch
- Access All Telegram Contacts on Apple Watch
- Display My QR Code on Apple Watch
- Support More Message Types: Text, Photo, Voice Notes, Stickers, GIFs, Document, Audio, Contact, and Location Messages

bluejetty:00088385:ios.description:
Looking forward to winter? Enough!
Install the Just Snow app and add realistic snow to your photo right now.
What you need
At your disposal more than 30 unique filters, created specifically for Just Snow app. You will definitely find the one that suits you.
Choose one of 4 categories:
1. Small snow - great for landscapes.
2. Bokeh - a large and blurry snow, which will decorate your portrait shots.
3. Motion - inspired by extreme photos and suitable for unusual camera angles.
4. Abstraction - pure imagination, use to create creative works.
Just perfect
Create exellent compositions using the "Mask" tool. The snowfall will never close your face or other important objects. The mask works like an eraser. Choose the ideal shape, for example, for landscapes is useful "Half", and for the portrait a "Circle". Just move the mask to the desired object and set the desired size.
Add a new layer
Not enough snow? Use the layers. Mix filters from different categories. Also this tool works fine with masks. Turn on your fantasy. Arrange a snow storm on your picture.
More colors
What if the snow was not white? You have a great opportunity to look at it. You are guaranteed to get bright and colorful photos. Apply one of the specially selected colors or set any other. One color is good, but two is better - with a gradient the snow looks even more beautiful. Color change is also useful for creating realistic effects, the snow filter can always be adjusted for the current lighting. 
Full customization
Just Snow app provides you with all the tools to make the final image perfect:
1. Set the transparency of the snow filter.
2. Change the saturation of the background, this will add an atmosphere of winter to your photos.
3. Fill the background with a color, it will look like a fog or a blizzard.
4. If the snow filter seems too harsh, you can fix it using a blur.
Always different
If you are bored with standard filters, you can always create your own. To do this, use the generation of particles in pairs with layers and masks. Each time the position of the snowflakes changes and you always get the different effect.
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

DS Alarm Clock – Wake Up Smarter, Sleep Better
Start every morning feeling refreshed and in control with DS Alarm Clock, the ultimate alarm app for Android. Whether you're a heavy sleeper, need gentle wake-up sounds, or want powerful time management tools, DS Alarm Clock offers a fully customizable experience that goes beyond just setting alarms.
This all-in-one app combines smart alarms, soothing sleep sounds, reminders, and more to help you take charge of your day from the moment you wake up. With a sleek design and reliable performance, it’s your go-to app for better mornings and restful nights.
⏰ Smart Alarm Features
DS Alarm Clock adapts to your lifestyle and sleep habits with powerful and personalized alarm settings:
Custom Alarm Sounds – Choose from built-in tones, music, nature sounds, or even record your own voice.
Dismiss with Tasks – Force yourself to wake up by solving a puzzle, shaking the phone, or completing a memory game before the alarm stops.
Flexible Snooze Options – Customize snooze intervals and limits to match your sleep needs.
Multiple Alarms – Set alarms for different times, days, or routines – great for work, weekends, naps, and events.
Reliable Alarm Performance – Works even in battery-saving mode or Do Not Disturb. DS Alarm Clock ensures your alarm will always ring when you need it most.
🌙 Sleep Tools to Help You Rest Better
DS Alarm Clock isn't just about waking up – it also helps you fall asleep faster and sleep more soundly:
Sleep Sounds – Access a wide range of relaxing sleep music and nature-inspired sounds, including rain, waves, wind, and white noise.
Bedtime Reminders – Get gentle nudges to help build a healthy sleep routine and wind down on time.
Evening Mode – Pair sleep sounds with a timer for evening meditation, reading, or quiet relaxation.
Upcoming Sleep Tracking – Monitor sleep stages, duration, and quality (coming soon).
Establish a healthier sleep routine that supports your well-being every night.
🕒 All-in-One Time Management
Beyond alarms and sleep tools, DS Alarm Clock offers essential timekeeping and productivity features:
Stopwatch & Timer – Track time for workouts, cooking, focus sessions, or any daily activity.
Daily Reminders – Set task reminders, medication alerts, calendar events, or repeating notifications with ease.
Custom Notification Sounds – Use your favorite tones for reminders or stay focused with minimal alert options.
Clock Widget – Add a beautiful clock and alarm widget to your Android home screen for quick access.
Call Menu Features – Stay productive with reminders during or after phone calls.
🎯 Why DS Alarm Clock?
✅ Easy to Use – Clean, modern UI designed for all ages and skill levels.
✅ Highly Customizable – Make every alarm, reminder, or sleep sound truly yours.
✅ Battery Efficient – Minimal battery use without compromising reliability.
✅ Built for Android – Optimized for all Android devices and versions.
✅ Perfect for Heavy Sleepers – Strong alert features and task-based dismiss options keep you from oversleeping.
From students to professionals, shift workers to night owls, DS Alarm Clock is built for anyone who wants a smarter, smoother start to the day.
🚀 Wake Up With Purpose – Start Every Day Right
With DS Alarm Clock, your mornings will never be the same. Whether you’re tired of snoozing through alarms or looking to enhance your nightly routine, this app is your personalized assistant for better sleep, punctual mornings, and organized days.
Transform how you manage time, sleep, and productivity — all in one app.
📲 Download DS Alarm Clock now and join thousands of users enjoying a more peaceful, effective, and energized life. It’s time to sleep smarter, wake up better, and take control of your day!

bluejetty:00187047:ios.description:
Introducing the Wirex App – Your All-in-One Crypto and Conventional Currency Solution! 
Are you ready to embark on a new era of financial freedom? Look no further than the Wirex app, your ultimate companion for seamless, secure, and efficient management of both crypto and conventional currency. With a user base of over 6 million people worldwide, Wirex is on a mission to democratise the financial landscape, making crypto and fiat currency universally accessible. 
Your Gateway to Financial Empowerment 
Gone are the days of complex account setups and lengthy verification processes. The Wirex app enables you to set up your account in just minutes, putting you at the helm of your digital currency universe. Whether it's Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, or any from the extensive list of over 100 supported coins including ADA, EOS, MATIC, and more, Wirex ensures you're in control of your financial journey. 
Your Crypto Journey, Your Way 
Wirex understands that diversity is key. Effortlessly switch between crypto and fiat, benefit from Over-the-Counter rates, and say farewell to exorbitant exchange fees. By using Wirex, you're saving up to 3% compared to other platforms, providing you with more financial clout for your crypto ventures. 
Rewards That Reshape Your Finances 
Experience rewards like you've never seen with Wirex's innovative approach. Cryptoback™ rewards, become your regular companions whenever you use your Wirex card in shops or online. Enhance your rewards further by staking WXT within the app, garnering up to 8% Cryptoback™ rewards and an impressive 20% AER on your X-Accounts. This isn't just an app; it's your key to maximising your crypto earnings. 
Empowerment Without Boundaries 
Boost your financial freedom with the Wirex card – your passport to spending crypto and fiat wherever Visa and Mastercard are accepted. No more friction – enjoy real-time conversion at point-of-sale and instantaneous crypto rewards. With complimentary ATM withdrawals, unlimited spending, and no monthly maintenance fees, you're in charge of your money like never before. 
The Future of Finance, at Your Fingertips 
Wirex offers financial solutions for everyone. Whether you're a crypto enthusiast or a newcomer, Wirex's flexible plans cater to your preferences. The Premium and Elite plans offer supercharged crypto rewards, with the added advantage of boosting your rewards further by staking WXT. 
Unrivalled Savings, Unveiled 
Meet X-Accounts – a groundbreaking, secure, and flexible way to save. Earn up to 20% on your stablecoins and up to 16% on crypto, all calculated daily and paid out weekly. Need your savings? Withdraw freely, with no strings attached. 
Unlock Potential with Wirex Credit 
Instantly borrow stablecoins against your BTC or ETH collateral. With no setup fees and no extensive credit checks, Wirex Credit allows you to access up to 80% of your collateral's value at 0% interest! 
Security Beyond Measure 
Wirex goes above and beyond to protect your assets. From anti-fraud technology to Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), your peace of mind is paramount, whether you're trading, spending, or HODLing. 
Your Partner in Financial Knowledge 
New to the crypto scene or an expert keen to stay updated? Wirex equips you with the resources you need. Join discussions on our Community pages, find answers in our Help Centre, or contact our Support Team – available 24/7. 
Join the millions already benefiting from the future of finance. Download the Wirex app today and step into a world where crypto and conventional currency coexist seamlessly. Features and availability may differ by region. Learn more at Wirexapp.com. 
Rewards and savings are calculated in Wirex Token (WXT). Feature availability depends on region-specific terms and conditions.

bluejetty:00131371:ios.description:
Print photos quickly, easily and for FREE with the world’s #1 photo printing app! FreePrints provides high-quality printed photos, delivered to your door for FREE.
No subscriptions. No commitments.™ Just free prints!
Ordering your free photo prints couldn’t be easier. Just open the app and select the photos you want to print from your Camera Roll, Google Photos, Facebook, Dropbox and more. Then choose your print quantities and you’re done! Your free prints will arrive on your doorstep in just days – and all you pay is a small shipping charge.
Order up to 85 FREE 4x6 photo prints a month right from your iPhone or iPad. That's 1,000 FREE prints a year! We print your photos on your choice of deluxe glossy or premium matte photo paper. And we never compromise when it comes to quality. At FreePrints® we use only the best papers for the best prints possible.
We promise vivid color reproduction, brilliant whites, fade-free images and the assurance that every photo ordered will be printed to the highest quality standards. There are no subscriptions and no commitments of any kind. And with standard shipping and handling charges starting at just $1.99 (and never more than $9.99, regardless of order size), you simply can’t go wrong.
What do I get for free?
• Up to 85 4x6 prints per month – 1,000 per year
• Limit 1 print per photo
What do I pay for?
• Additional 4x6 photo prints
• Enlargements (We offer 5x5, 5x7, 8x10, 11x14, 12x18, 16x20 and 20x28)
• Shipping and handling – Starts at just $1.99 and never goes above $9.99, no matter how many prints you order
Why is FreePrints so popular?
• It’s the fastest, easiest and most affordable way to print photos from your iPhone or iPad
• Choice of deluxe glossy or premium matte paper
• Easily print photos from Facebook, Dropbox, Google Photos and Microsoft OneDrive
• Print photos and get them delivered to your door in just a few days!
• FreePrints is the world’s most trusted and best rated photo printing app
At FreePrints we know how important it is to preserve life’s special moments. Having physical photos of your favorite memories means so much more than having them stuck on your phone.
Discover the world’s #1 photo printing app with millions of 5-star reviews worldwide!
What happens to my photos after you print them?
We store your photos, in accordance with our terms of use so that you can use them for other orders in the future if you wish, using FreePrints or our other apps. Your photos are always your photos; only you will have access to them. And we use best-of-breed security solutions to ensure that your photos are always protected. More specifics are available in our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
About FreePrints:
In a mobile world, all of our most important photos live on our phones and tablets, and yet there was never an easy way to get them printed. After one too many fights with USB sticks, photo kiosks and unreliable websites, we set out to solve this problem: Enter FreePrints. With just a few taps, you can select your favorite photos and have them headed straight to your mailbox. And best of all: It’s free! Millions of customers and countless stories later, we are honored to have touched so many lives.
From our humble beginnings as a photo lab in Midland, Texas, we’ve grown FreePrints into the top-ranked photo printing app in the world. And we’re just getting started! If you like FreePrints, you’ll love our other apps: FreePrints Photobooks® gives you a free photo book every month; FreePrints Photo Tiles®, free wall décor every month; and FreePrints Gifts®, a free personalized gift every month – all for just a nominal delivery charge, with no subscriptions or commitments.

bluejetty:00145537:ios.name: Stream Vision 2
bluejetty:00145537:ios.summary: Pulsar Stream Vision 2 is the official mobile application that connects Pulsar thermal imaging, digital night vision and multispectral devices to your smartphone. Using a secure Wi-Fi connection, the app expands the capabilities of Pulsar d
bluejetty:00145537:ios.description:
Pulsar Stream Vision 2 is the official mobile application that connects Pulsar thermal imaging, digital night vision and multispectral devices to your smartphone. Using a secure Wi-Fi connection, the app expands the capabilities of Pulsar devices by enabling live image streaming, remote control, firmware updates, media management and cloud storage directly from your mobile device.
The Pulsar Stream Vision 2 app turns your smartphone into a powerful companion tool for operating your optic device in the field, allowing you to monitor images, adjust settings and manage recordings quickly and conveniently.
Live streaming from your Pulsar device
View a real-time image from your Pulsar thermal imaging or digital night vision device directly on your smartphone screen. The app works as a remote viewfinder that allows you to monitor what your device sees while capturing photos or recording videos.
This feature is ideal for:
• hunting 
• wildlife observation 
• outdoor exploration 
• night surveillance
Remote control of device settings:
Stream Vision 2 allows you to control and adjust settings on your Pulsar thermal or digital night vision device remotely.
Using your smartphone you can:
• change device settings 
• start or stop recording 
• adjust viewing modes 
• manage device functions
All changes appear instantly in the live viewfinder, allowing fast adjustments while using the device outdoors.
Photo and video browser
Browse all photos and videos recorded on your Pulsar device directly from the app.
You can:
• view recorded media 
• download photos and videos to your smartphone 
• organise your recordings 
• share captured moments with friends
Your outdoor footage is always accessible directly from your mobile device.
Firmware updates for Pulsar devices
Keep your Pulsar optic device up to date with the latest improvements and features.
The Pulsar Stream Vision 2 app allows you to:
• check available firmware updates 
• download new firmware versions 
• install updates directly from your smartphone
Updating firmware ensures your device always runs with the newest capabilities and performance improvements.
Free Stream Vision 2 Cloud storage
After registration in the app, users receive free space in Stream Vision 2 Cloud storage for photos and videos.
Cloud storage allows you to:
• securely store your recordings 
• synchronize files across devices
• access photos and videos from smartphones, tablets or PC browsers
Your recordings remain safely stored and available anywhere.
Stay updated with the latest news
The built-in newsfeed keeps you informed about the latest developments in thermal imaging and night vision technology.
Receive updates about:
• new Pulsar products 
• firmware improvements 
• technology innovations 
• important news from Pulsar and Yukon
Supported Pulsar devices
Stream Vision 2 supports a wide range of Pulsar devices.
Full compatibility list: https://pulsarvision.com/products/software-and-applications/stream-vision-2/
Note: Some features are available only when a supported device is connected to a smartphone via Wi-Fi.

bluejetty:00193712:android.description:
Evil enemies have invaded your medieval kingdom—they’ve kidnapped the princess and locked her in the dungeon! As the greatest Idle King Tycoon in the world, your quest is to lead your army into battle with monster bosses while managing and expanding your kingdom and castle.
Dark dungeons, evil enemies, and unique troops await you in your medieval realm! Plan a unique battle strategy, fight in an idle war, defend your castle, and defeat bosses. Unlock all the islands, from Green Goblins to Venomous Vampires, and locate the six magic keys in the game.
Game Highlights:
- Play actively as a hero or choose to automate your workflow and collect idle income, even when you are offline!
- Get rich quick and grow your medieval kingdom and castle!
- Enjoy this addicting king tycoon simulation game and level up!
- The automatic battle system in the game uses idle gameplay to help you steadily earn extra gold coins.
- These gold coins can be used to enhance your knights’ and mercenaries’ attack and speed to destroy the evil goblins.
Ready to expand your medieval kingdom and strengthen your castle? 
Enter the world of King Royale: Idle RPG Tycoon game. You are the King Tycoon—take on the challenge, make the best battle strategy in this quest to rescue the princess from the dungeon.
Features:
- Manage your medieval kingdom and castle, and become the best Idle King Tycoon.
- Unlock new skills and heroes to help you beat the bosses.
- Level up your favorite heroes and skills in this idle RPG game.
- Set your fight strategy by combining the king’s equipment, knight skills, and heroes.
- Defeat all the enemies, earn gold, and grow your medieval kingdom and castle.
- Adventure through different continents to find all the magic keys in the game.
- Become a King Tycoon: recruit the best managers in the kingdom to increase your fielders’ and collectors’ motivation.
- Yield gold actively or automate your workflow to increase your idle income and become the richest King Tycoon!
- Win huge treasure chests daily and fortify your medieval castle.
Immerse yourself in the medieval world of castle and kingdom management. This Idle King Tycoon game offers a unique blend of idle, tycoon, and RPG elements that will keep you hooked. Whether you're strategizing in battles or managing your medieval castle, there's always something exciting happening.
Are you already a fan of King Royale: Idle RPG Tycoon game? If so, like us on Facebook, follow us on Twitter and Instagram, join our Discord Community, and visit our website https://kingroyale.de for the latest news from the kingdom.
Having problems with the game or want to share a great idea? 
Email us at: support@wicketgaming.com
Privacy Policy: https://kingroyale.de/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00169239:ios.description:
Portland TriMet Transit — Your Smarter Way Around Portland
Get real-time TriMet bus, MAX Light Rail, and Portland Streetcar updates — all in one simple, accurate app built for Portland commuters.
“This app makes getting around Portland so much easier. The live times are always right, and the trip planner helps me connect perfectly between MAX and the bus.”
Why Portlanders love Portland TriMet Transit:
• Live TriMet bus, MAX Light Rail, and Portland Streetcar tracking
• Stop and schedule alerts
• Trip planner with step-by-step directions
• Live and offline route maps
• One-tap “Get Me Home” journeys
• Customizable widgets for quick access
Never miss your stop again — with Get Off Alerts, Portland TriMet Transit tells you exactly when to hop off. Track your bus, train, or streetcar on the map in real time, check crowding levels, and stay informed about detours, delays, or service changes.
Whether you’re commuting downtown, riding the MAX to Hillsboro, or catching the Streetcar to the Pearl District, Portland TriMet Transit keeps you connected every step of the way.
Coverage Includes:

bluejetty:00065540:ios.description:
Stop screenshotting dinner ideas. CookBook turns recipes from Instagram, TikTok, websites and photos into meals you can plan, shop and cook.
CookBook is a smart recipe keeper loved by thousands of home cooks. Save recipes from anywhere, organize them into a private digital cookbook, plan meals, create grocery lists, track nutrition and cook with clear steps across iPhone, iPad, Mac and web. Start free, with a 14-day trial.
SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
Import recipes from Instagram, TikTok, websites, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest and links. Use the AI recipe scanner to turn photos of handwritten recipe cards, cookbook pages, screenshots and clippings into editable recipes.
ASK COOKBOOK
Ask CookBook is your AI cooking companion for dinner ideas, recipe creation, ingredient swaps, leftover inspiration, meal planning help and cooking questions. Ask what to cook with what you have, how to adapt a recipe or how to make a dish suit your diet.
ORGANIZE YOUR DIGITAL COOKBOOK
Keep every recipe easy to find with tags, favorites, ratings, notes, filters and search. Find recipes by name, ingredient, tag, source, cook time or nutrition.
PLAN MEALS
Use CookBook as a flexible meal planner for days, weeks or months. Plan from recipes you already love, scale servings, add notes and make weekly meal prep easier.
SHOP SMARTER
Create smart grocery lists from recipes or meal plans. CookBook merges ingredients, sorts groceries by aisle and syncs your shopping list across devices.
COOK WITH CONFIDENCE
Scale servings, convert units, use cooking timers, keep your screen awake and follow clean, readable recipe steps while you cook.
TRACK NUTRITION
Calculate recipe nutrition, view estimated calories and macros, and plan meals around your goals.
WORKS ACROSS DEVICES
Plan on your computer, shop on your phone and cook from your tablet. CookBook syncs your private recipe library across devices and the CookBook Web App.
BEST FOR HOME COOKS WHO:
• Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, websites and food blogs
• Replace screenshots, bookmarks and notes with one recipe manager
• Use a meal planner with automatic grocery lists
• Scan family recipes, handwritten cards and cookbooks
• Organize recipes with tags, filters and favorites
• Get AI recipe help while keeping control of their own recipes
QUESTIONS
What is CookBook?
CookBook is a private recipe keeper, recipe manager and meal planner for saving, organizing, planning, shopping and cooking from your own recipes.
How do I import recipes from Instagram?
Save the recipe to CookBook and turn it into a clean, editable recipe with ingredients and steps.
Can I import recipes from TikTok?
Yes. CookBook can help you import recipes from TikTok and other social recipe sources into your private recipe library.
Can I scan handwritten recipes?
Yes. CookBook can scan handwritten cards, cookbook pages and printed recipes into editable digital recipes.
Does CookBook make shopping lists?
Yes. Add recipes to your meal plan or shopping list and CookBook creates a smart grocery list sorted by aisle.
Does CookBook help with meal planning?
Yes. CookBook includes flexible meal planning for days, weeks and months, with shopping lists created from your planned meals.
Is CookBook private?
Yes. CookBook is a private digital cookbook for your own recipe collection, meal plans and shopping lists.
QUESTIONS OR FEEDBACK?
Email team@cookbookmanager.com - we'd love to help!
PRICING & TERMS
CookBook is free to download. Store 20 recipes and use 20 smart imports free. Yearly plans include a 14-day trial where eligible. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in App Store account settings. Unused portions of a free trial or subscription period are non-refundable.
Terms: https://www.cookbook.company/policies/terms
Privacy: https://www.cookbook.company/policies/privacy

CorrigoPro puts you in the hands of your customer and makes you their service go-to.
A powerful new app that connects business owners with commercial service providers through the CorrigoPro Network, CorrigoPro is the only app you need to:
bluejetty:00187877:ios.description:
CorrigoPro puts you in the hands of your customer and makes you their service go-to.
A powerful new app that connects business owners with commercial service providers through the CorrigoPro Network, CorrigoPro is the only app you need to:
- Connect with your customers via their smartphone
- Receive requests for service from your customers and respond immediately by tapping the app and adding some text and/or photos - CorrigoPro does the rest
- Provide real-time status updates to your customers
- Grow your business. Be seen by thousands of local customers searching for your services
- Promote your business directly to customers via their smartphone
- Control all of your company’s communications: get everything in one place
- Intelligently prompt you to check-in/check-out or pause work orders when you enter or exit a virtual boundary setup around a service location, known as a geofence. 
Your customers no longer experience phone tag, waiting on hold, dropped calls, no callbacks, endless searches on the web or that old paper directory. CorrigoPro puts an end to all of the frustrating, time-consuming and annoying activities of placing a service request the old way and replaces them with a simple app connected directly to your and your customer. With CorrigoPro, everything you need to receive, monitor and complete a service request is in the palm of your hand and in the hand of your customer.
* The geofencing feature tracks your location in the background and may affect your battery life. Your location is only shared with Corrigo and your customers when you check-in/check-out or pause a work order.

bluejetty:00045951:ios.name: ParcelBox - Package Tracker
bluejetty:00045951:ios.summary:
Tracking your shipments has never been more seamless and convenient than with ParcelBox. Never lose sight of your packages again. Download ParcelBox today and take the stress out of shipment tracking.
Our powerful, all-in-one tracking plat
bluejetty:00045951:ios.description:
Tracking your shipments has never been more seamless and convenient than with ParcelBox. Never lose sight of your packages again. Download ParcelBox today and take the stress out of shipment tracking.
Our powerful, all-in-one tracking platform allows you to monitor all your domestic and international packages from multiple carriers in one place. No more switching between different tracking websites or searching through emails for tracking numbers—ParcelBox simplifies the process and ensures you’re always up to date on your deliveries.
With ParcelBox, you gain access to real-time tracking updates, ensuring you always know where your package is and when it will arrive. Whether you’re waiting for an important document, an online order, or a gift for a loved one, ParcelBox provides detailed tracking information at every stage of the journey. Our advanced system automatically detects the correct carrier based on the tracking number and keeps you informed from pickup to final delivery.
We support over 2500 global postal and courier services, including USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, Royal Mail, Canada Post, Australia Post, Deutsche Post, China Post, Japan Post, and many more. No matter where your package is coming from or where it’s going, ParcelBox ensures you have accurate, up-to-the-minute tracking details.
ParcelBox is designed for convenience, allowing you to save multiple tracking numbers and receive automatic updates for each shipment. The app’s intuitive interface makes it easy to check all your deliveries in one place without unnecessary distractions. Unlike other tracking services, ParcelBox is built with a clean, ad-free experience, ensuring that you get only the most relevant and important tracking information without any clutter.
Our system is especially useful for online shoppers who frequently order from various e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, eBay, AliExpress, Walmart, Etsy, ASOS, and many others. ParcelBox seamlessly integrates tracking information from these retailers, ensuring that you never lose track of your online purchases.
Key Features of ParcelBox:- Real-time tracking for both domestic and international shipments
- Support for over +2500 global courier and postal services
- The ability to save multiple tracking numbers for ongoing shipments
- Instant notifications about any status updates or delays
- A clean, ad-free, and user-friendly experience
- Detailed tracking history, so you can review past shipments anytime
ParcelBox is the ultimate tool for individuals and businesses looking to stay in control of their shipments without hassle. Whether you are tracking a single package or managing multiple deliveries, ParcelBox ensures you have the most reliable and accurate tracking information at your fingertips.
Privacy Policy: https://gentlemens.tech/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://gentlemens.tech/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00177974:ios.name: Tree Games for Kids
bluejetty:00177974:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00177974:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
Tree House is an exciting game that helps educate children about animals living in a forest, in a fun & engaging way. Children get to meet cute characters & learn about their food, shelter & bedtimes as they perform different tasks on each level. 
Kids will get to know about the life of tree-dwelling creatures such as:
 - A little worm
 - An owl
 - A spider
 - The squirrels
 - A hedgehog
 - A mole
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00157951:ios.description:
Meet Lumux, your AI chatbot for everyday questions, writing, research, documents, and creative ideas. Ask a question, add a PDF or photo, or start with a ready-made prompt. Turn a rough thought into a useful draft, a clearer explanation, or an image you can build on.
CHAT WITH AI
Ask follow-up questions and keep working in the same conversation. Explore ideas, explain difficult concepts, plan a project, or get help finding the words you need. Choose from the available AI models to suit your task. Use a quick conversation for a first draft, then ask follow-up questions to develop your ideas.
WRITE, REWRITE, AND TRANSLATE
Draft emails, messages, reports, essays, stories, and job application text. Adjust tone, improve grammar, shorten a long passage, or expand an outline. Summarize text and translate between languages with prompts tailored to your goal.
ASK QUESTIONS ABOUT PDFS AND PHOTOS
Upload a PDF and ask for a summary, key points, or an explanation of a passage. Add a photo to a supported chat to ask about its content. Doc Master works with PDFs containing selectable text. Use document and image tools to make information easier to understand.
CREATE IMAGES AND DESIGN IDEAS
Describe a scene or concept and generate an AI image. Explore illustrations, logo concepts, tattoo inspiration, and visual ideas for a personal or creative project. Refine your prompt to try another direction.
SEARCH AND RESEARCH
Use the web search tool for questions that need current information. Ask follow-up questions, compare explanations, and check the sources provided. Use AI to organize a research starting point.
GET HELP WITH MATH AND LEARNING
Ask for a step-by-step explanation of a math problem or a concept you are studying. Start from text or a supported photo. Explore 16 practical AI lessons in 16 languages, available to read offline. Each lesson includes an example, a prompt to adapt, steps to try, checks, and a short question. Practise with the matching tool in the app.
PLAN AND CREATE CONTENT
Find ideas for social posts, captions, video scripts, and marketing copy. Use guided prompts for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other channels. Brainstorm a business idea, outline a presentation, or work through an everyday planning task.
VOICE INPUT AND CONVERSATION HISTORY
Dictate your question instead of typing when speech recognition is available. Return to saved conversations to continue an idea or review an earlier answer.
QUICK ACCESS ON IPHONE
Use App Shortcuts to open a chat or lesson. Add a Home Screen widget to reach chat and learning, and return to your tools from the app menu. Online AI tools require an internet connection.
ADAPTS TO IPHONE DUO
Use compact and expanded layouts on iPhone Duo, with readable chat text and flexible input controls.

bluejetty:00182477:ios.description:
Design? Fashion? Travel? Comedy? Yes! Aimee's Interiors has it all.
Meet charming Aimee Cooper, a young American woman from the Midwest who is about to make it big in the interior design world. Work alongside Aimee and become a go-to decorator for celebrities as well as laypeople. Challenge home design boundaries and create the most glamorous interiors in this new relaxing home renovation game for FREE!
Sharpen your decorating skills by designing homes, cafes, outdoor bars, living rooms, and many more visually stunning three-dimensional rooms. Discover trending home design styles, varying from the Mediterranean, Scandinavian to Japandi.
Travel with Aimee around the world, from Paris to Hawaii, and design properties ranging from luxurious mansions to farmhouse Fixer Uppers. Enjoy delightful stories, meet funny characters, and renovate their homes. Lots of good taste, humor, and drama are waiting for you!
Features:
Relax through play and express your creativity in each new Episode
Discover trending designs and get inspired to create your own decorating style.
Renovate fresh, glamorous spaces and learn about different interior design styles.
Travel around the world and create custom designs for each country
Experience a story filled with funny and heartfelt dialogue!
Solve challenging blast puzzles to uncover Aimee's exciting story, unlock hidden areas, and decorate new spaces in each Episode. Relax, sit down, and enjoy this exciting story!
If you like to watch HGTV property renovation, home design shows, like Fixer Upper and Property Brothers, then Aimee's Interiors is a perfect virtual interior design game for you
Aimee's Interiors will be updated with more blast puzzles to solve and more fun story chapters regularly! Already played and enjoyed the game? Stay tuned for updates and drop us a review!

bluejetty:00084269:ios.description:
The only payment link you'll ever need to send and receive payment.
Note from the creator:
The story of paylinkz started when I realized that anytime I needed to send money or pay for a service that was rendered to me - I would ALWAYS ask the question "what payment app do you have?". I noticed that some had Venmo, others had CashApp, and some had PayPal and Zelle combined. It came to my realization that some people had a strong preference for the payment app that they preferred. After all, we live in 2022 and no one ever carries cash on them.
The whole process of asking for usernames, figuring out the proper app to open on your phone, and then making sure that the right username has been entered seemed clunky and needed improvement. As a software engineer and an entrepreneur at heart, I went straight to work to build a unified platform that makes it easy to add all your payment profiles into one place.
The goal here is to switch the question from "what payment app do you have?". to "Send me your paylinkz URL" and to remove the friction from sending and receiving money.
I hope you find a lot of value in it.
Please see the following for agreements 
https://paylinkz.app/terms
https://paylinkz.app/privacy

bluejetty:00080439:ios.description:
Starting solids? See exactly how to serve 200+ first foods at every age, track what your baby eats, and introduce allergens with confidence. Baby-led weaning, purees or a mix of both: this app supports the way your family wants to feed.
HOW TO SERVE EVERY FOOD, BY AGE
Eggs, chicken, strawberries, broccoli: every food shows how to cut and serve it at 6, 9 and 12 months, with real photos, common choking risks and how to lower them. No more guessing whether a piece is too big or too small.

See the key nutrients in each food, including iron, one of the most important nutrients once babies start solids.

bluejetty:00098851:ios.description:
Enter the Captivating ASMR Universe of Happy Screw Trip 3D! A 3D puzzle adventure blending strategy and spatial logic, designed for players who crave mental challenges! Sort colorful screws, master intricate layouts, and embark on a journey of creativity and accomplishment—perfect for unwinding or pushing your cognitive limits!
Gameplay Essentials:
1. Analyze & Plan: Study screw arrangements across pillars and devise your strategy. 
2. Color Coordination: Transfer screws to matching zones—precision is key to avoid deadlocks!
3. Spatial Mastery: Navigate obstacles and optimize space to unlock advanced techniques.
Why Happy Screw Trip 3D Stands Out?
- Universal Appeal: Casual players or puzzle enthusiasts—flexible difficulty levels cater to all skill sets!
- Brainpower Boost: Sharpen logic, spatial reasoning, and strategic planning through evolving challenges.
- Play Your Way: No timers, no pressure. Enjoy smooth drag-and-rotate controls with realistic physics.
- Strategic Tool Kits: Expand storage with "Capacity Boxes", unlock flexible layouts via "Multi-Slot" tools—combine creatively to dominate stages!
- Diverse Level Design: 100+ unique stages with randomized elements for endless replayability!
- Minimalist Aesthetics: Clean visuals and calming soundscapes enhance focus and relaxation.
Download Happy Screw Trip 3D Now and Redefine Puzzle Mastery! Whether for a quick brain teaser or an immersive session, this game is your gateway to strategic joy. Start your journey as the ASMR screw master today!

bluejetty:00036868:ios.name: OneLabel - Product Scanner
bluejetty:00036868:ios.summary: OneLabel is a science-based product scanner that helps you understand what’s really inside your food and personal care products. Instantly scan barcodes to detect additives, allergens, controversial ingredients, and potential health risks —
bluejetty:00036868:ios.description:
OneLabel is a science-based product scanner that helps you understand what’s really inside your food and personal care products. Instantly scan barcodes to detect additives, allergens, controversial ingredients, and potential health risks — and get clear, unbiased insights to help you choose better for yourself and your family.
Whether you’re avoiding gluten, allergens, endocrine disruptors, or simply trying to live healthier, OneLabel gives you transparency, confidence, and control in seconds.
◆ WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH ONELABEL
1. Instant Barcode Scanner
Scan food, cosmetics, and personal care products to instantly see their health impact — in less than one second.
2. Ingredient Checker
Confusing labels made simple. OneLabel breaks down ingredients into clear explanations, highlighting:
* Additives & preservatives
* Allergens (gluten, dairy, soy, nuts, etc.)
* Endocrine disruptors & carcinogens
* Vegan & FODMAP suitability
3. Science-Based Product Ratings
Each product is evaluated using objective criteria:
* Nutritional quality
* Presence of additives
* Ingredient safety & formulation quality
No ads. No brand partnerships. No sponsored scores.
4. Healthy Alternatives
If a product isn’t ideal, OneLabel helps you discover better alternatives aligned with your dietary needs and lifestyle.
5. Cosmetic Safety Scanner
Scan or search cosmetics and personal care products. OneLabel deciphers complex INCI lists, flags potentially harmful components, and explains them in plain language — like having a digital cosmetologist in your pocket.
◆ SCIENCE IS OUR INFLUENCER
OneLabel ratings are built on real science, not marketing.
Our in-house team of biologists and physicians analyzes over 25,000 ingredients using the latest research in toxicology, nutrition, and dermatology.
AI-powered analysis combined with human curation ensures speed without sacrificing accuracy.
Carcinogens, allergens, endocrine disruptors — we track what matters.
◆ A MASSIVE PRODUCT DATABASE
* 3+ million food & cosmetic products
* New items added continuously
* Scan products from stores you already shop at:
Sephora, Ulta, Amazon, Target, Whole Foods, Kroger, and more
◆ WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE ONELABEL
* Unbiased & ad-free
* Science-driven, transparent scoring
* Food and cosmetic analysis in one app
* Clear explanations — no medical jargon
* Designed for real, everyday decisions
OneLabel doesn’t tell you what to buy — it helps you understand why.
◆ PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION FEATURES
* Unlimited scans
* Unlimited food & cosmetic searches
* Ad-free experience
* Favorite products & tracking
* Access to all educational content
TAKE CONTROL OF WHAT YOU CONSUME
OneLabel empowers you to make informed, confident choices every day — at the grocery store, in the bathroom, or online.
Scan smarter. Choose better. Live healthier.
Premium Subscription Details:
Some features require a paid auto-renewable subscription (OneLabel Unlimited), including:
• Unlimited Scans
• Detailed Product Analysis
• Ad-Free Experience
A 7-day free trial may be available for new subscribers. After the free trial period ends, the subscription automatically renews at the applicable price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or current billing period.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage and cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://onelabel.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://onelabel.app/terms-of-service.html
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00071367:ios.description:
Connect the field to the office with Simpro Mobile and enhance the efficiency of your team.
Achieve end-to-end operations management with Simpro Premium, a complete job management software solution for your business. 
The Simpro Mobile app gives field staff the ability to do more on the job. Update job details, access site and asset history, view timesheets and present quotes with ease. 
FIELD SERVICE FEATURES:
Enhance your field processes with Simpro Mobile, an end-to-end field app. Streamline field service workflows, manage customer assets, increase first-time fixed rates and enhance the customer experience.
* Live scheduling updates
* Record travel time and time spent on-site
* Access scheduled and assigned, as well as search for any pending or progress jobs.
* See who else is scheduled to be on-site for the job
* Status changes, such as a completed job card, will trigger workflow processes for office staff
* Offline functionality
* Invoice and accept payments in the field, with different options including cash or credit card payments (Square Payments integration available depending on location)
* Click-to-call site and job details
* Pre and post-audits for enhanced safety
* Pause work to stop the clock at any time
* Comprehensive asset management
* Inventory management
* Add notes, photos and other attachments with immediate sync to office
* Capture staff and customer signatures and email a signed job card directly to any contact
* High accuracy GPS navigation
TIMESHEET FEATURES:
Build a workforce of time-savvy staff. Easily track costs throughout project and service work, and provide scheduling information to field staff to maximise productivity.
* Clock on and off daily
* Create new time blocks for quotes, jobs and activities
* Use pre-defined travel schedule rates (eg after hours or long distance) to categorise travel time
* Add or edit billable and non-billable work hours in real-time or retrospectively
* Update records in real-time or retrospectively for billable and non-billable work
* Easily spread time between multiple cost centres based on hours or percentage of working time
* Access site, customer and schedule notes along with other key details such as activities, job descriptions and cost centre information
* Copy time blocks for employees, contractors and plant equipment
* View multiple weeks including past, current and upcoming scheduled time.
* Compare work scheduled and completed to identify and rectify unaccounted blocks of time or conflicts
CUSTOMER QUOTE AND SALES FEATURES
Upsell and close more sales in the field with Simpro Mobile.
* Add images, videos and manuals to create visually appealing quotes on the fly
* Offer multiple quote options such as basic, intermediate and premium
* Incorporate memberships and other services with standard pricing and savings displayed
* Apply add-on pricing for discounted rates such as for multiple or same-day services 
* Email quotes and invoices to the customer

You can easily print photos and documents in your smartphone!
This App can help you to print photos and documents in the smartphone, by sending them via Wi-Fi connection to the Multicopy machine in 7-Eleven stores in Japan.
You can scan your physical document to save it electronically in your smartphone!
This App can also save images in your smartphone, scanned by the Multicopy machine.

bluejetty:00186815:ios.summary:
