bluejetty:00186815:ios.description:
Beginner or advanced, become a chess master, without ever being disturbed by ads.
Do you want to master the most prestigious, the classiest game ever, while having fun?
It's EASY! For starters, there are no ads to distract you. There's no account to create, and you don't even need to be connected to the Internet.
So, how does it work?
If you are a beginner, let yourself be guided by the introductory lessons included. The lessons are SHORT and EASY. Right from the start, you begin playing by moving pieces, and you learn the rules of the game while having fun. The first 40 lessons are free.
Once you know the rules, you start playing real games! The coach shows you the moves a Grandmaster would pick. Not just one move, but THE 4 BEST MOVES.
Sounds too simple? But think about it... How did you learn to speak as a child? Did you take grammar and spelling lessons? Of course not. You listened to the adults talk and then you went for it! Because that's how you learn!
This app allows you to do just that, AND IT WORKS!
From the very first games, you start learning effortlessly. You immediately enjoy playing, and after a while you notice that the right moves come to mind naturally, as if they were obvious.
Gradually, you deactivate the suggestions and play by yourself. At the end of each game, the coach shows you the good and bad moves you've made. You can better understand what happened, and you can even try out other moves to improve.
If this sounds unbelievable, you should read the user reviews for our app. It has one of the highest satisfaction ratings on the App Store, in all countries.
FOR BEGINNERS, THIS APP...
• contains introductory chess lessons that are suitable even for children. The first 40 are free.
• shows you all the possible moves of a piece when you touch it.
• explains why certain moves are forbidden.
• can suggest 4 to 6 excellent moves at any one time. The green button lets you show or hide these suggestions.
• can tell you when you can mate your opponent, so you can look for the winning move by yourself.
• can warn you when your opponent is about to play a dangerous move.
• provides many trainer levels of increasing difficulty.
• knows and applies perfectly all the official rules of chess.
• is a very competent teacher of a very high level.
• analyzes your games and shows you how to improve.
FOR EXPERTS:
• Both USCF and FIDE rating scales are supported.
• This app has one of the strongest chess engines for mobile devices (3040 USCF Elo).
• On current devices, as incredible as it sounds, it plays at the world champion level.
• The chess engine displays its thinking, up to 20 moves ahead.
• You can analyze a game by replaying it. The app indicates bad moves by coloring them red. The 4 best moves in each position are shown in green.
• This app supports variations: you can test other moves and then return to your original game.
OTHER FEATURES INCLUDE:
• The coach can comment on the game as you play (optional).
• When the game is over, the coach can analyze it and show you how to improve.
• Several beautiful visual themes are included, which you can customize.
• 4 playing styles are included, from «cautious» to «suicidal», which you can combine with all available levels.
• Includes an opening book of more than one million moves.
• Many customization options are available (graphics, sounds, engine output…).
• ...and much more...

bluejetty:00168732:ios.summary: Meet Claude, your AI problem solver and thinking partner. Claude works with you to write, research, code, and tackle complex problems and hard questions with depth and precision. It enhances your thinking and expands what you're capable of,
bluejetty:00168732:ios.description:
Meet Claude, your AI problem solver and thinking partner. Claude works with you to write, research, code, and tackle complex problems and hard questions with depth and precision. It enhances your thinking and expands what you're capable of, right from your phone.
AI WRITING ASSISTANT 
Turn rough ideas into polished work. Whether you're crafting social media posts, professional emails, or complex reports, Claude refines tone, structure, and clarity, iterating with you until your voice comes through. Get writing support that understands what you're trying to say, even when you're still figuring it out.
AI CODING AND PROGRAMMING HELP 
Claude handles production-level development work. Review code, debug complex issues, and explore new languages with an AI coding assistant that explains the "why" behind every solution. Work through problems in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and dozens of other languages—from quick scripts to multi-step architecture.
As a versatile coding assistant, Claude plans multi-step tasks, pulls in relevant context, and adapts its approach as your project evolves. Write programs through natural conversation and use Claude to identify and fix errors faster. It scales from a single function to enterprise-level development.
RESEARCH AND DATA INSIGHTS 
Go deeper on the questions that matter. Claude searches the web, compiles findings with accurate citations, and surfaces what's actually useful. Connect Google Drive, Gmail, and Calendar to bring your own context into the conversation. Whether you're conducting business analysis, building reports, or exploring new ideas, Claude thinks through problems with you, from the first question to the one you didn’t know to ask.
VISUAL ANALYSIS 
Upload any photo, PDF, or screenshot for instant analysis. Claude extracts text, interprets charts and graphs, evaluates UI layouts and technical diagrams, and explains what it sees. Get thoughtful feedback on app designs and data visualizations. Generate SVG code for graphics and illustrations, right from your phone.
NO TYPING NEEDED 
Think out loud. Use Claude as your AI voice assistant to have conversations in multiple languages—perfect for brainstorming sessions or working through ideas on the go.
EXPAND WHAT YOU CAN DO 
Take on projects outside your usual expertise. Whether you're learning something new, navigating unfamiliar territory, or need a thoughtful second opinion, Claude helps you take on the hard questions you otherwise don’t have time or bandwidth for.
Claude helps you: 
▶ Develop and refine content with AI writing
▶ Work through meeting notes to surface key insights
▶ Build reports and marketing content iteratively
▶ Explore complex math problems with step-by-step reasoning
▶ Plan projects, structure ideas, and build flowcharts together
▶ Analyze PDFs, screenshots, and visual content for deeper patterns
▶ Think through problems hands-free with voice dictation
TRUSTED AND RELIABLE 
Claude is designed to be reliable, accurate, and collaborative. It’s built by Anthropic, an AI research company dedicated to building safe and dependable AI tools. Powered by Claude Fable, Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku, it brings advanced reasoning, creativity, and problem-solving capabilities to your most important challenges.
TRY CLAUDE FOR FREE
Join millions of users who trust Claude for their work on the problems that matter. Whether you're coding, writing, researching, or tackling business challenges, Claude helps you think deeper and reach further.
Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms 
Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

bluejetty:00131801:ios.summary:
TwistedWave is a very fast and easy to use audio editor and recorder.

UNIQUE TO TWISTEDWAVE

bluejetty:00131801:ios.description:
TwistedWave is a very fast and easy to use audio editor and recorder.
Even when working with huge files, it will remain very fast and fluid, and will never run out of memory.
UNIQUE TO TWISTEDWAVE
• Very fluid, even with very large files
• Unlimited undo / redo history, happens instantly
RECORD AUDIO
• No duration limit other than the available storage
• Up to 24 bit / 96 kHz audio if your audio interface supports it
• Record stereo audio with the built-in microphone (iPhone XS or more recent)
• Record studio quality audio with an external microphone
• Record audio from other music applications with Audiobus
APPLY EFFECTS
• Precision Time Stretching & Pitch Shifting technology licensed from ZTX
• All the AudioUnit extensions (AUv3) available on the App Store can be used with TwistedWave
• Cut, copy / paste audio around
• Fade in / out
• Reverb
• Delay / echo
• Distortion
• Equalizer (parametric, or iPod EQ)
• Dynamics processor, can be used as a compressor or a noise gate
• Peak limiter to amplify audio without causing distortion
• Amplify or normalize the audio to a given level
• Filters (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, low-shelf, high-shelf)
• Convert the sampling rate (with SoX' very high quality resampler)
• Reverse. Play the file backwards, mostly for fun!
MANY FILE FORMATS SUPPORTED
• WAV
• M4A (AAC or Apple Lossless)
• MP3 (Encoded with the LAME MP3 encoder for the best quality)
• FLAC
• AIFF
• CAF
MANY IMPORT OPTIONS
• Import songs from the music library
• Import files from the Files app
• Import files from an SD card or USB drive, with the right adapter
• Open files sent from other apps
• Browser access, send a file to TwistedWave from a device on the same WiFi network
MANY EXPORT OPTIONS
• Send your files by
 - Email
 - iMessage
 - SoundCloud
 - Dropbox
 - AudioCopy
 - An FTP or SFTP account
 - Any app that accepts audio files
• Export multiple files in a single ZIP file
• Browser access to allow downloading and uploading files from/to TwistedWave
• File too large? Just send a link. (30 days for free on TwistedWave's servers)
BROWSER ACCESS
Connect to the TwistedWave app from a web browser on another device or computer on the same WiFi network, and:
• Play and download the files directly from a browser
• Send files to TwistedWave by drag and dropping them in the browser

bluejetty:00074195:ios.description:
ePIS reune todas as informações realmente importantes para você acessar o dinheiro de seu PIS!
Tudo de maneira rápida, simples e segura! E além de calcular saldo e calendário de pagamento, você também pode tirar todas as suas dúvidas sobre o PIS.
Recursos
- Calendários PIS/PASEP 2024/2025 - Saiba de acordo com o mês do seu nascimento quando você deve receber seu Abono Salarial
- Calculadora Trabalhista de Abono - Calcule quanto você deve receber de acordo com o seu salário e meses trabalhados;
- Calculadora precisão para descobrir seu PIS;
- Leitor QR code
- Calendário de pagamentos;
- Contagem de dias restantes para o saque;
- Informações sobre crédito em conta;
- Notícias atualizadas;
E muito mais!
Não fique mais desatualizado nem pegue filas enormes para simples informações! Descubra tudo sobre seu PIS aqui no ePIS!
O que é PIS?
O PIS é um programa criado para bonificar quem trabalha de carteira assinada em empresas privadas.
Essa bonificação é paga anualmente para um determinado grupo de trabalhadores: você precisa ter trabalhado ao menos 30 dias no ano anterior, recebendo em média até dois salários mínimos e estar inscrito no PIS por ao menos 5 anos.
O valor máximo pago pelo PIS é de um salário mínimo, para quem trabalhou 12 meses.
O que é PASEP ?
Muito parecido com o PIS, que é voltado para trabalhadores de empresas privadas, o PASEP é um programa específico para funcionários públicos.
Muito Importante!
- Este aplicativo não possui vínculo com órgãos governamentais.
- Não somos um app governamental, e todas as informações são retiradas do site oficial do Governo (https://www.caixa.gov.br/beneficios-trabalhador/abono-salarial/).
- Fazemos uma simulação a partir do site oficial do Governo. Todas as informações disponíveis no aplicativo são originadas de dados abertos de fontes oficiais.
- O aplicativo não armazena nenhuma informação pessoal inserida durante o uso e está de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados brasileira.
Vale ressaltar que nosso aplicativo foi desenvolvido por uma empresa séria e que seguem rigidamente políticas de privacidade dos dados. Leia nossos termos de uso e política de privacidade.
Baixe agora o calendário atualizado PIS 2024 e PASEP e calculadora trabalhista!

bluejetty:00089163:ios.description:
Crafting a standout resume can be challenging, even for those who have navigated the job market before. However, this app takes the stress out of the process, providing a user-friendly and secure platform to create a resume that captures your qualifications and experience.
Your resume is more than just a document; it’s your first impression in the professional world. Whether you're applying for jobs, preparing for interviews, actively job hunting, or submitting your credentials on various job sites, a well-crafted resume is essential for success.
The app offers a variety of features designed to help you build a resume that stands out:
- Expertly Designed Templates: Choose from a selection of templates that have been crafted by professionals to meet industry standards. These templates ensure that your resume is not only visually appealing but also structured for clarity and impact.
- Comprehensive Tips and Examples: To help you present your experience and skills in the best possible light, the app provides detailed tips and examples. Whether you’re writing a summary, listing your work history, or highlighting your skills, you’ll have access to guidance that can elevate your resume from good to great.
- Real-Time Resume Preview: Before you finalize your resume, you can preview it to see how it looks from the employer's perspective. This feature allows you to make last-minute adjustments to ensure everything is perfect.
- Premium Template Options: For those looking to add an extra edge to their resume, premium templates are available through a subscription. These templates offer additional design elements and layouts that can make your resume stand out in a crowded job market.
- PDF Exporting for Easy Sharing: Once your resume is complete, you can save it as a PDF for easy downloading, printing, or sharing. The PDF format is universally accepted and maintains the formatting of your resume, ensuring it looks professional whether viewed on a computer, tablet, or smartphone.
This app not only simplifies the resume creation process but also empowers you to present your professional story in the most compelling way possible. Whether you're just starting your career or looking to make a change, having a polished, professional resume is a key step towards achieving your goals.

bluejetty:00028843:ios.summary:

Play kids dog games and learn to wash
bluejetty:00028843:ios.description:
Has your kid ever wanted to have his own dog? Now toddlers' dreams will come true!
Pet puppy games for kids is a veterinary simulator. Babies can try to be a pet doctor and take care of little animals. 
Play kids dog games and learn to wash fluffy friends' feet, brush their teeth and cut the claws. Give your dog the necessary medication and get rid of germs. Bathe your pets in the baby dog games and save them from fleas.
Our app is in kids puzzle games format!
Your babies of 2+ yrs will be able to play a mini-game and to put all the pieces together to get a complete picture, to put a bandage on the dog's paw and to cure it.
~~~ Features ~~~
• 8 exciting mini-games on puppies brushing, caring and washing;
• Easy learn of basis of doggy games on taking care of pets;
• Learning the animal care tools;
• Development of kids fine motor skills with grooming gameplay;
• Fascinating interface and simple gameplay;
• The kid can use the app independently.
~ Mini dogs games for kids
In our learning toddler games for 2 year old kids, there is a possibility to try yourself as a vet, a stylist, a fashion designer and learn more about taking care of pets. Wash your dogs in a warm bath, brush their teeth and fur. Give some medicine and cure the disease.
~ Visit an animal hair salon
Make your little puppy more beautiful in toddler animal games! The child can make a stylish hairdo for his pet and then pick up interesting looks and accessories. Animal dress up game is a good way to develop a kid's sense of fashion. Choose what your pupies will be like and make them glamorous!
~ Learn the necessary toolkits
In kid dog games we provide your baby with all necessary instruments to take care of little puppies. Your toddlers can use a soft toothbrush to clean dog's teeth, cut the nails with a clipper or go to the bathroom and wash his pet with a smelling delicious shampoo.
~ Develop fine motor skills in preschool games
Toddler dog game for pre-k kids are great for training your little ones' fingers. Our infant games are designed in such a way that the child will have to press, drag, select, twist a lot. Children of 3+ years can enjoy their playtime in baby puppy games for preschoolers with no internet!
~ Simple interface and fun gameplay
Our application for girls and boys is easy to use and has a fairly simple interface, due to which the children will be able to play kids animal games on their own, without the help of parents. Now your kids can not only have a good time as a pet vet, but learn more about responsibility and how to take care of animals correctly.
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get bonuses:
1. new kinds of dogs.
2. new mini-games.
3. new accessories.
Make your life easier with premium access: 
- Check its advantages, by getting a free three-day trial. After 3 days, the trial will automatically turn to the weekly paid subscription.
- The paid subscription is divided into the 3 types: weekly, monthly, and year.
- A week paid subscription costs $9.99. Month - $19.99. Year - $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy https://brainytrainee.com/privacy.html 
And Terms of use https://brainytrainee.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00031274:ios.summary: Arrow is the #1 workout and nutrition tracker built for changing your body. Log your lifts, meals, and weight in one app, get calorie and macro targets that adapt to your real results, and see whether training and diet are actually adding u
bluejetty:00031274:ios.description:
Arrow is the #1 workout and nutrition tracker built for changing your body. Log your lifts, meals, and weight in one app, get calorie and macro targets that adapt to your real results, and see whether training and diet are actually adding up, whether you're cutting, bulking, or just looking to maintain.
TRAINING AND NUTRITION IN ONE LOOP
Changing your body is one problem, not two. Your lifts create the stimulus, your food decides what your body does with it, and your weight trend tells you whether the plan is working. Most apps track one piece. Arrow connects all three.
• Adaptive TDEE: Arrow estimates your real daily energy expenditure from your weigh-ins and food log, not just a formula, and keeps your calorie and macro targets adjusted as your body responds
• Scale Weight vs. Trend Weight: every weigh-in is plotted against a rolling trend, so you can tell a water swing from true gain or loss before you change your plan
• Oil detection: if a scanned meal was likely cooked in oil, Arrow asks before you log, so hidden calories don't slip past your numbers
• Arrow Score: one number built from Strength (PRs and volume), Nutrition (calories, macros, weigh-ins), and Consistency (workouts and meal logs), weighted for your goal. A cut and a bulk are scored differently.
• Estimated daily deficit or surplus and a four-week projection
• Arrow Coach flags when a sudden scale jump or drop is likely water, not fat
NUTRITION TRACKING THAT'S FAST AND HONEST
• Smart Scan: photograph your plate and get the foods, calories, and macros
• Describe a meal in plain words or by voice, scan a barcode, or look it up in the database
• Heads Up before you log a scanned meal, and a meal score when you do
• Edit any target yourself. Arrow never locks you into its numbers.
• Recent foods, saved meals, custom foods, and copy-a-previous-day for meals you eat on repeat
• Optional meal and post-workout reminders
WORKOUT TRACKER BUILT FOR THE GYM
• Log sets, reps, and weight in a few taps, no clutter mid-set
• Plan your own routines or generate one from your goal, equipment, days, and session length
• Flip any exercise card to see your history and personal records
• Rest timer, dropsets, cardio and activity tracking
• Custom exercises, swap exercises mid-workout, reorder on the fly
• Lock Screen Live Activity and Dynamic Island keep your workout in view
• Close the app mid-session and resume where you left off
ARROW COACH
Coach reads training and nutrition together: a recap of your week after workouts and on your Stats screen, a Heads Up on meals before you log them, and a call-out when a weight swing is likely water. Every note ends with what to do next.
PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
• Muscle diagram shows which muscles you hit this week and how hard
• Volume, PR, and lift progress over time
• Week Overview calendar for training and nutrition days
• Apple Health steps on your Profile and in Performance
• Arrow Wrapped: your year in review
TRAIN WITH FRIENDS
• See your friends' workouts (and their meals, if they share them) in your feed
• Share workout cards to Instagram Stories
OPTIONAL GAMIFICATION
Want extra motivation? Turn on levels, streak multipliers, and trophies. 
SUBSCRIPTION
Access to Arrow requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

bluejetty:00068804:ios.description:
Unit Converter: convert any measurement, currency or size in one tap.
IN SHORT
A fast, offline unit converter that turns any measurement, currency or clothing size into the answer you need — with live exchange rates and a built-in calculator. If you can use a calculator, you can use this.
WHO IT'S FOR
Cooks, contractors, DIY-ers, students, travelers and anyone who needs a quick, precise conversion. Also handy for engineers, nurses and online shoppers comparing international sizes.
WHAT YOU GET
• 18+ categories in one place — weight, length, temperature, volume, speed, area, time, data, energy and more.
• Live currency conversion — real-time exchange rates, updated automatically.
• A real calculator built in — type an expression and convert the result instantly.
• Works offline — every unit (except live rates) converts with no connection.
HOW IT WORKS
1) Pick a category from the icon grid.
2) Tap the two units you want and type a value — or a full calculation.
3) Read the precise result instantly, to the number of decimals you choose.
KEY FEATURES
• Currency — live forex rates for USD, EUR, GBP, JPY and more, plus crypto.
• Weight & mass — oz, lb, kg, g, mg, stone, metric tons.
• Length & distance — miles, km, yards, meters, feet, inches, cm, mm.
• Temperature — Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, Réaumur, Rankine.
• Volume — cups, tbsp, tsp, pints, gallons, liters and metric volumes.
• Clothing & shoe sizes — men, women, kids and babies, across countries.
• Plus speed, area, pressure, data, energy, fuel and angle.
WHY IT HELPS
Most people find the unit they need in a couple of taps and never open a second app. Rates stay current, so a EUR→USD check is accurate to the day.
FAQ
Q: What is it, in one line?
A: A unit converter that turns any measurement, currency or size into a precise result using a built-in calculator.
Q: Does it work without internet?
A: Yes — all units convert offline. Only live currency rates need a connection to refresh.
Q: Can it convert currencies in real time?
A: Yes, exchange rates update automatically so conversions reflect the current market.
DOWNLOAD AND CONVERT
Pick a category and get your first conversion in seconds.
Naturally, this app helps with unit conversion, the metric system, imperial units, currency exchange, cooking measurements and clothing sizes.

bluejetty:00131774:ios.description:
The in-depth meteorological reasoning and details behind your local weather forecast, straight from the experts at NOAA/NWS.
Deep Weather provides the deep, detailed meteorological reasoning behind your forecast, along with the various factors that are likely to influence it. Knowing this deeper weather information arms you with the knowledge to anticipate weather changes and adjust your plans accordingly.
Deep Weather respects your privacy. Deep Weather doesn't track or store your location information, or any other data about you. (See privacy disclosure below). Deep Weather has no ads that distract and clutter up your weather information. Rather it relies on optional Pro subscriptions from our loyal users to pay the bills.
Deep Weather provides you with a deeper understanding of your weather forecast by giving you weather details not commonly found in other apps in a convenient, easy-to-read package. 
Deep Weather automatically compiles an easy-to-read version of the most recent National Weather Service Area Forecast Discussion, advisories and warnings for your location. 
The National Weather Service Area Forecast Discussions provide detailed information and background about the weather patterns and observations that are part of the most recent forecast model. They represent the "Story behind the weather story," a glimpse behind the scenes of your current forecast, and provide lots of weather forecast detail not found anywhere else.
Included sections:
Aviation Weather
Fire Weather
Climatology
Marine Weather
Beach Forecast
Watches, Warnings
Short Term Forecast
Long Term Forecast
To help provide a more visual picture, Deep Weather also provides easy access to a curated list of the most up-to-date weather graphics: National Forecast Chart, Surface Analysis, IR Satellite, Current Radar, Pacific and Atlantic Ocean surface analysis, 500mb graphical forecasts and more.
For Pro subscribers/owners, Deep Weather includes live animated radar rendered from National Weather Service source data.
In addition, Deep Weather provides localized 7-day extended forecasts from the National Weather Service for any location in the United States and its territories.
Deep Weather provides great value in helping you anticipate and adjust to changes in the weather that you might not have been aware of if limited to other weather sources. By understanding the factors and assumptions that are part of the official forecast and how changes in those factors could affect the outcome, you are armed with a much deeper and more flexible understanding of the weather around you. This is highly valuable in aviation, sailing, long distance hiking and any other outdoor endeavor where changes in the weather can have great impact.
Use the map view to select any National Weather Service Forecast Office and receive the latest forecast discussion for that area. 
The discussion is broken up into sections for you, and the text itself formatted in a much more easily read format than the raw original.
These discussions and weather graphics are amended and updated several times per day, so you can follow how the weather forecast is changing in real time, as well as gain a deeper understanding of the thought that goes into forming the forecast.
Privacy Policy: http://www.rateofclimb.com/deepweather_privacy.html
EULA/Terms of Use: http://www.rateofclimb.com/deepweather_terms.html

Deep Weather provides great value in helping you anticipate and adjust to changes in the weather that you might not have been aware of if limited to other weather sources. By understanding the factors and assumptions that are part of the official forecast and how changes in those factors could affect the outcome, you are armed with a much deeper and more flexible understanding of the weather around you. This is highly valuable in aviation, sailing, long distance hiking and any other outdoor endeavor where changes in the weather can have great impact.

Use the map view to select any National Weather Service Forecast Office and receive the latest forecast discussion for that area. 

The discussion is broken up into sections for you, and the text itself formatted in a much more easily read format than the raw original.

These discussions and weather graphics are amended and updated several times per day, so you can follow how the weather forecast is changing in real time, as well as gain a deeper understanding of the thought that goes into forming the forecast.

bluejetty:00014963:ios.name: Advanced Reading Therapy
bluejetty:00014963:ios.summary:
If your reading skills have been impacted by a stroke or brain injury, this app can help you improve. Practice reading with engaging exercises that include text and audio support.
** Try for FREE by downloading Advanced Language Therapy Li
bluejetty:00014963:ios.description:
If your reading skills have been impacted by a stroke or brain injury, this app can help you improve. Practice reading with engaging exercises that include text and audio support.
** Try for FREE by downloading Advanced Language Therapy Lite **
Advanced Reading Therapy uses technology to assist struggling adult readers to make sense of paragraph- and multi-paragraph-level passages. Self-ratings encourage metacognitive awareness, comprehension questions test accuracy, and hints enable greater success and independence. Score reports make it easy to see progress (and write progress notes) along the three graded levels:
* Level 1: Shorter passages of 50 words or less, written around a Grade 0 – 1 reading level. Three questions after each passage test comprehension.
** Level 2: Medium passages of 50-150 words, written around Grade 2 – 3 reading level. Four questions appear to see how well you understood.
*** Level 3: Harder passages get you ready for the texts you want to read. 150 – 600 words and Grade 3 – 6 reading level with five questions each. 
Adult readers will enjoy these functional and entertaining passages as they get back to reading the pages and screens in their own lives. Speech-language pathologists will love having so many modern reading passages with carefully-crafted questions at hand to teach strategies.
Built-in audio controls let you listen to a single word, go sentence-by-sentence, or hear the whole article – whatever you need. You’ll get over 200 reading rehabilitation exercises in 15 categories! 
Features:
• Text-to-speech available on touch
• Adjust font size, spacing, and rate at any time
• On-screen audio recording to listen to yourself reading aloud
• Self-rating of comprehension encourages metacognitive awareness
• Inference and prediction question encourage thinking outside the text
• Huge variety of topics to appeal to mature readers
• E-mail reports for easy data tracking
• Unique categories such as Jokes, Inferences, First Chapters, Text Messages, and Functional Passages
• Look back at the passage any time, or have the relevant text highlighted with a Hint 
Tactus Therapy offers a wide variety of apps to help with reading comprehension. Advanced Reading Therapy is the next step in your rehab after mastering the single words in Comprehension Therapy, the phrases & sentences of Reading Therapy, and the complex sentences of Advanced Comprehension Therapy. All of our apps work together to help you reach your reading goals. Find the right apps for you with our App Finder at tactustherapy.com/find

bluejetty:00045204:ios.description:
Alan Jackson is the founder and vision behind Lemonade, enticing Californians with the simple allure of beautifully prepared salads, hearty braised meats, satisfying sandwiches, decadent desserts, and of course, thirst-quenching lemonades. A California native, Alan named the restaurant “Lemonade” because of the bright and comforting feeling you get when you simply say the word. The original sunny day spot!
An accomplished chef, Alan decided to ditch the upscale dining scene to launch the first Lemonade in West Hollywood in 2008, craving to create a chef-driven, contemporary approach to fine food. . . done fast. Alan’s confident yet relaxed concept has curated a loyal following and nurtured Lemonade into a neighborhood favorite.
In 2009, Ian Olsen came on board to join Alan as Partner, forging a dynamic relationship that has helped to redefine the fast-casual dining experience for today’s food-savvy diners. Ever-growing, Lemonade now has 27 locations throughout Los Angeles and surrounding areas, Orange County, San Diego, and the Bay Area.

1) Register your credit/debit card(s) in the app.
2) Shop as usual.
3) We’ll buzz your phone when you earn a reward. No need to fish your phone out, check-in, or scan anything. Just pay as usual.
4) Rewards show up on your phone for you to use. It's like magic!

bluejetty:00065388:ios.summary: Travelers believes in making sure our customers understand the value of safe driving. IntelliDrive® is a program for Travelers auto insurance customers. This app will measure your driving and provide updated driving performance and feedback
bluejetty:00065388:ios.description:
Travelers believes in making sure our customers understand the value of safe driving. IntelliDrive® is a program for Travelers auto insurance customers. This app will measure your driving and provide updated driving performance and feedback after each trip. Your auto policy will be rated at renewal based on obtaining sufficient driving information from the app. There are just a few steps to get the app set up, and then it will run in the background.
IntelliDrive® top features:
• Easily monitor your driving performance with the new enhanced dashboard.
• Challenge yourself and your family to put the phone down while driving with the new Distraction Free Streak feature.
• Check out the new Improve section to find information about safe driving and ways you can improve your score.
• A revamped Trips section makes it easier to find and understand the details of each trip. 
• Compare each driver’s overall performance by exploring our Driving Performance section.
To learn more about IntelliDrive®, please visit https://www.travelers.com/Intellidrive
Note: The IntelliDrive® program is not available in all states. Contact Travelers or your insurance agent for more information.

bluejetty:00100747:ios.description:
Meet kitUP: Take 15 minutes a day to discover great books and podcasts to help you improve your life and yourself.
Your life may be hectic; filled with work, school, or social activities. But with kitUP, you can efficiently utilize your 15 minutes, whether by reading or listening. Designed to foster both reading habits and personal development, kitUP helps you save time and enhance your knowledge.
More than 5 million people have joined kitUP to reach their best versions. How about joining this personal development journey yourself?
_____________
WHAT DOES IT INCLUDE?
* Access to personalized plans and challenge lists
Access dozens of plans such as a 28-day personal development plan, relationship plan, financial freedom plan, procrastination plan, and more.
* + 1500 books and content that will change your life
Read or listen to the most important ideas from non-fiction books
* Discover your interests
Browse through curated content tailored to your interests in categories such as personal development, economics, politics, biographies, parenting, science, mindfulness, psychology, technology, health, sports, nutrition, sexuality, relationships, meditation, and more.
We're delighted to be with you on your journey of growth! If you want to learn more about your favorite books, podcasts, trending topics, and areas of development, don't forget to download the app and follow us on social media!
HOW DOES IT WORK?
You can download the mobile application for free. Premium membership offers with unlimited access to all content are available. You can start your subscription through the mobile application via the Appstore or on the kitup.net website. Your subscription will be renewed unless canceled, and you can cancel your subscription at any time from where you initiated the subscription. Canceling your subscription means turning off automatic renewal. However, you will continue to have access to all subscription features for the remaining duration of the current period.
You can reach our help center at https://support.kitup.net. 
Terms of Use: https://q.kitup.net/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://q.kitup.net/privacy

• 3D Touch for iOS Devices

bluejetty:00095259:ios.description:
Need to control your home console but can’t find your controller? This app offers a quick, convenient way to navigate menus and control media playback right from your phone.
Designed for ease of use, it connects to your console over Wi-Fi—no sign-in or setup required. Perfect as a backup remote for casual use or for those moments when your main controller isn’t handy.
Features:
Simple and intuitive remote layout
Fast connection over Wi-Fi
Supports menu navigation and media controls
Works with popular modern game consoles
No extra hardware or sign-in needed
Disclaimer:
This app is developed independently and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any console manufacturer. References to compatibility are for the user’s information only and follow third-party brand guidelines.
Pro Subscription
Unlock the full app experience with a Pro subscription. Includes a free trial for new subscribers. Subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings at any time. Unused portions of a free trial period are forfeited upon purchase.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://imyapps.com/terms_conditions
Privacy Policy: https://imyapps.com/privacy_policy

bluejetty:00039079:ios.description:
*****************************************************
◆◆　１３００万ダウンロード突破！　 ◆◆
App Storeの各種ランキングで【1位】を獲得!!
カードジャンル：【1位】
カジノジャンル：【1位】
*****************************************************
いつでも！どこでも！だれとでも！オンライン対戦！
ローカルルールが50以上！みんなでやってたあのルールもきっとある！！
LINE、Twitter、Mailからも簡単友達招待！合言葉を伝えて離れた仲間と手軽にオンライン対戦！
●通信キャリアによる「通信の最適化」について
通信キャリアによる「通信の最適化」の際に、通信エラーが発生する場合があります。
こちらが原因の場合は、Wi-Fiを使用する、または「通信の最適化」の解除を行なってください。
「通信の最適化」の解除の方法が通信キャリアによって異なりますので、各キャリアへお問い合わせください。
■オンライン対戦を極める数々のシステム
◇対戦人数は最大5人
2人から最大5人までの対戦が可能です。
◇ルールマッチングシステム
・「ルールマッチング」システムで自分のルールとより近いプレイヤーと対戦が出来ます。
◇チャット機能搭載
・通常のチャットの他によく使うチャット文は定型文に編集登録することもできます。
※誹謗中傷の恐れのある全国対戦ではチャットは使用できません。
◇身近な友達と合言葉対戦
身近にいる友達とも同じ合言葉を入力することで対戦することが出来ます。
◇全国のツワモノと友達登録
・全国対戦モードで遊んだプレイヤーに友達申請や承認することで何度でも対戦することができます。
また、逆に苦手なプレイヤーはブロックすることも可能です。
・早く上がったプレイヤーは、対戦中のカードを覗くことが出来ます。
※設定で覗けなくすることも出来ます。
◇大富豪へのこだわりが満載!
・カードをスライドすることでも場に出すことが出来る直感(フリック)操作!
・最上級の雰囲気を醸し出す、こだわりのライティング!
■３つのゲームモード
◇全国対戦
全国のプレイヤーとランダムで対戦します。
全国対戦の遊ぶことでランキングポイントが加算され全国のプレイヤーとランキングを競うことができます。
◇友達と対戦
身近な友達や全国対戦で登録したプレイヤーと対戦することが出来ます。
・合言葉を決めて対戦
友達同士で決めた合言葉でマッチングして対戦することができます。
・友達登録済みのプレイヤーと対戦
友達に登録したプレイヤーとマッチングして対戦することができます。
友達と対戦では、有料版を購入しているプレイヤーが参加している場合は無料版のプレイヤーのハートが０になっても続けて遊ぶことができます。
※マイナスとしてハートの数に計上されます。
◇一人で練習
オフライン（通信しない）でコンピューターと対戦することができます。
※『全国対戦』や『友達と対戦』では常時通信しますので、通信状態の良い場所でプレイしてください。
■ローカルルールが50以上!
◇細やかなカスタマイズであなたがあの頃遊んだ大富豪で対戦!
・革命、階段革命、革命返し、Joker使用革命、革命選択クーデター、オーメン、ナナサン革命
・階段、階段枚数、階段の強さ、エンペラー
・縛り(2枚or3枚)、縛り回数、激しば、両しば、片しば、数縛り
・8切り、4止め、砂嵐、救急車(99車)、ろくろ首
・11バック、強化11バック
・2(3)あがり禁止、8切りあがり禁止、11バックあがり禁止、Jokerあがり禁止、スペ3あがり禁止
・スペ3返し
・都落ち、下克上
・スタート(スペードの3、クローバの3、ハートの3、ダイヤの3、大貧民)
・Jokerの枚数(0枚~2枚)
・パス制限
・席替え
・あがり流し
・カード交換
・天変地異
・ダウンナンバー
・7渡し
・10捨て
・9リバース、12リバース
・5スキップ、13スキップ
…等々
さあ、最高の「大富豪ONLINE」をお試しあれ!
■有料版について
月額400円の有料版にすることで、以下の機能が有効になります。
・ハートのプレイ制限が無くなります。
・サーバーが混んでいる際に、接続が優先されます。（必ず接続を保証するものではありません。）
・オプション設定でバナー広告を非表示にすることができます。
・「友達と対戦」では有料版のプレイヤーが参加していると、他の無料版のプレイヤーのハートがなくなっても対戦を続けることができます。
iOS版では、期間終了日の24時間以上前に自動更新の解除がされない場合、契約期間が自動更新されます。自動更新の課金は、契約期間の終了後24時間以内に行われます。
iOS版で有料版の購入は、iPhone,iPadの機種変更時に無料で復元できます。
iOS版の自動更新の停止方法
1. AppStoreアプリの最下部にある「おすすめ」を選択してください。
2. Apple IDをタップし、「Apple IDを表示」を選択してください。
3. 購読の中にある「管理」から「大富豪Online」を選択してください。この画面から次回の自動更新タイミングの確認や、自動更新の解除/設定ができます。
注意点
・アプリ内で課金された方は上記以外の方法での解約できません
・当月分のキャンセルについては受け付けておりません。
・iTunesアカウントを経由して課金されます。
■利用規約
https://www.sorairo.jp/rule_dfo.html
■その他注意事項 
・禁止行為について
公序良俗に反したアイコン、ユーザ名を本アプリで使用することは、本アプリの利用規約に定めるところの禁止行為であり、確認されたプレイヤーには、アカウント停止等の措置を取らせて頂きます。
また、そのようなユーザーを見つけた場合には「ブロック」を行なってください。
※「ブロック」されたプレイヤーの情報は運営チームにて確認しております。
「ブロック」は「対戦終了画面」の「申請」、または、「友達画面」の「検索」「最近対戦したプレイヤー」より行えます。
・ライフについて
本アプリは、ライフ5つ分まで無料で遊ぶことが出来ます。
ライフがなくなっても回復（1ライフ15分）するとまた遊ぶことが出来ます。
ライフを気にせず続けて遊びたい方は、アプリ内からライフ制限のない有料版（月額400円）をご購入ください。
・セーブについて 
セーブは自動でも行っています。 
セーブ中にアプリを終了、または電源を切ると、 
セーブデータが破損することがあります。 
タイトルに戻ってからアプリを終了するようにお願いします。 
また、電池残量が十分にある状態でのプレイを推奨いたします。 
・通信について 
本アプリは、ゲームプレイ中に通信を行っており、通信環境の悪いところでは対戦出来ません。
通信状況の良い場所でのプレイを推奨いたします。 
・時刻設定について
本アプリはサーバーと通信することで時刻を取得しており、お持ちの端末の時刻とサーバーとの時刻が異なりますとプレイすることが出来ません。 
日付と時刻は、一般設定より自動設定にされることをお勧めいたします。 
予め、ご了承の上ダウンロードをお願いいたします。 
・その他 
本アプリのルール、テキストは、断りなく変更になることがあります。 
※iOS7.0以上の機種のみ動作致します。
ただし、一部の機種ではご利用になれない場合がございます。
※本アプリのバージョンアップ等に伴って、推奨端末や対応ＯＳのバージョンを変更する場合がございますが予めご了承ください。
※ＯＳのバージョンアップにより、本アプリに問題が出る場合がございますが予めご了承ください。
【お願い】
不具合に関しましては、弊社ホームページ、もしくはゲーム内の「問い合わせ」からお問い合わせください。
レビューにアップされましても、情報が足りず対応は致しかねます。
出来る限り、お客様の要望を組み込み、より楽しいゲームを目指したく思っておりますのでご協力頂ければ幸いです。

bluejetty:00015798:ios.description:
What will your child learn today? In this animal sounds learning game, your toddler can explore six different categories: over 90 kinds of cute animals, insects, fruits, and vegetables. Kids will learn about domestic and wild animals, listen to animal sounds, and explore the world around them!
MEET THE CUTEST WILD & DOMESTIC ANIMALS:
FARM
Meet the lovable residents of the farm – a pink pig, a cuddly goat and a friendly puppy!
SAVANNAH
Go on a journey into the endless savannah. The kingly lion, spotty giraffe, stripy zebra, and other amazing wild animals want to play together!
FOREST
A brown bear, a gray bunny, and a fluffy squirrel live in the forest. They can't wait to meet the little explorer and introduce themselves!
GARDEN
Be sure to look around the garden because many wonderful creatures hide there: a green caterpillar, a gorgeous butterfly, a tiny ant, and many other adorable insects!
FRIDGE 
Many fruits and vegetables are concealed in the kingdom of ice and cold! A juicy tomato, a crispy carrot, and a sweet apple – find & learn them all!
BONUS GAME – ""SHOW WHERE?""
Listen to how different names are pronounced, choose correct images, and watch fun animations!
This app is a simple game and rich educational material at the same time! Did your child learn all the words? Now, you can let them learn animal names in a foreign language!
Press the Language button on the Settings screen to choose any language from the list and set the foundation for your child's multilingual development:
- English
- Spanish
- German
- Russian
- Italian
KEY APP FEATURES:
• More than 90 sounds and animations
We cooperate with professional voice-over actors to make every word sound clear and correct, for children to learn new words and memorize them easily. Besides, colorful animations and funny animal sounds will amuse your little one!
• Learning in a playful way
Bright pictures and captivating missions will attract the child's attention, helping to develop fine motor skills, improve memory, attention, and perseverance.
• Easy controls
The user-friendly interface allows your baby to use our learning application without any help from grown-ups. At the same time, purchases and settings are reliably protected from the accidental clicks of a curious toddler!
• Play offline with no ads!
Your little ones won't need an Internet connection to entertain themselves! Play anytime and anywhere – on a long journey or in a boring queue. The app is 100% safe for kids to use, as there are no intrusive ads.
Access 25+ educational apps for kids with an Amaya Plus subscription! Ignite your child's imagination and develop their essential skills with our game collection. Play offline, anytime, anywhere. Connect up to 3 devices for seamless fun. Join now and embark on an exciting learning journey for your little ones!
ABOUT US:
Our friendly team has been creating fun games for kids for over 10 years! To develop apps with the best kids' learning games, we consult the top children's educators and design vibrant, user-friendly interfaces that kids love to use. 
We love to make kids happy, and we also like to read your emails! If you need help, have questions, or want to say ""hi,"" please get in touch at info@amayasoft.com

bluejetty:00115801:ios.description:
Block Nova! — An 8×8 Block-Matching Symphony Under the Starlit Sky
As night falls and stars begin to twinkle, a meditative block adventure awaits you. Set against a tranquil night sky, Block Nova! delivers pure 8×8 block-matching gameplay, offering a dual relaxation experience for your eyes and soul.
In this elegantly minimalistic world of blocks, each colorful piece shines like a celestial gem. With gentle swipes of your finger, watch blocks align and vanish gracefully, accompanied by soothing light effects and delightful soundscapes—transforming each move into a visual concerto. While honoring classic block-matching roots, the game breathes new life into the genre with its smart AI battle system, turning solitary play into a thrilling strategic duel.
Game Features
• Classic 8×8 Block Matching – Simple yet profound core mechanics for pure stress-relief
• Local Same-Screen Battle: No Wi-Fi, no sign-ups — just rotate your device!
• Daily Challenges – Test your wits against intelligent AI opponents
• Starry Visual Theme – Deep blue nightscapes with shimmering particle effects
• Offline Play – Enjoy anywhere, anytime—zero network pressure
Block Nova! has no cluttered leaderboards or frantic timers—only the pure joy of cascading blocks. Whether unwinding during work breaks or seeking serenity before bed, your personal starlit board awaits.
Begin your cosmic block-matching journey now! Let Block Nova! deliver lasting fun through its simplest rules. Under this 8×8 starry sky, everyone will find their own perfect rhythm of play.

bluejetty:00145578:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00145578:ios.description:
CDL Practice Test — CDL Help
Prepare with confidence for your CDL permit test.
CDL Help is a CDL practice test app for the Class A and Class B commercial driver's license. Study 2,500+ practice questions with detailed explanations — offline, in 10 languages.
PRACTICE TESTS
Core CDL tests:
• General Knowledge — vehicle rules, safe driving, cargo, vehicle inspection. Required for all CDL applicants.
• Combination Vehicles — coupling and uncoupling, rollover prevention, inspection. Required for Class A.
• Air Brakes — system parts, dual air brakes, checks and correct use.
Endorsement tests:
• HazMat (H) — hazardous materials, placards, emergency response.
• Tanker (N) — loading and unloading, liquid surge, tanker driving.
• Doubles & Triples (T) — coupling more than one trailer, safe driving, inspection.
Also in the app: pre-trip inspection questions, and US road signs with a quiz.
STUDY TOOLS
• Complete version (the exam essentials) or Expanded version (extra questions from the CDL handbook)
• Flashcards for quick review
• Reading mode: the question, the correct answer and the explanation together
• Text-to-speech: hear questions read aloud in English
• Bookmark questions to review later
• Practice the questions you missed most
• Shuffle questions
• Timed mock exam
• Set your exam date and get a daily study plan with a countdown
• Progress by topic: questions answered and accuracy
• Your state's CDL handbook in the app — many explanations link to the page they come from
• Detailed explanations based on federal FMCSA regulations
LEARN CDL AND ENGLISH TOGETHER
Federal rules require commercial drivers to read and speak English (49 CFR 391.11).
Study in your language and switch any question to English with one tap. You learn the CDL rules and the English words for them at the same time.
When you can read road signs, talk with inspectors and fill in reports in English, you protect yourself, your CDL and everyone on the road.
Languages in the app: English, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Arabic, Portuguese, Korean, Turkish, Ukrainian, Uzbek.
Some tests and features require an in-app purchase.
Download CDL Help and start studying today.
Terms of Use: https://www.cdlhelp.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.cdlhelp.com/privacy-policy

apple-macos:1510144108.name: MKStreamer

MKStreamer helps you to locally stream every common video format (.mkv, .avi, .wmv and a lot more) with a click of a button.

- AirPlay any video to Apple TV
- Stream all your movies to Smart TV and Chromecast 
- Watch movies on all your mobile devices

- Automatically load available subtitles
- Adjustable performance to optimize CPU and disk usage
- Stream multiple videos
- Alternate audio tracks and multilingual subtitles
** Stream your movies to Apple TV, Smart TV and Chromecast **

** Scan QR code or share stream link **
On iOS and iPadOS you can simply point the camera to the QR code. The Camera app helps you to start watching the movie with a simple click
MKStreamer uses HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) protocol, an adaptive bitrate streaming communications developed by Apple Inc.
There are freely available HLS players on every major platform.
Important note:
- Devices can only play streams if they are connected to the same local network as your Mac. The connection can be wireless, using WiFi or wired, using Ethernet.
